izzyondroid:com.mubarak.mbcompass.name: MBCompass
izzyondroid:com.mubarak.mbcompass.summary: Compass, GPS tracker & offline maps. No ads, no tracking.
izzyondroid:com.mubarak.mbcompass.description:
MBCompass is a free and open-source compass and navigation app without ads, in-app purchases, or tracking. Lightweight, focused, and built for real use.
 Compass - Accurate compass with true north and magnetic north - Sensor fusion (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer) for stable readings - Real-time magnetic field strength (µT) - Auto-alert when accuracy drops low enough to matter
 GPS & Maps - Live location on OpenStreetMap - Offline maps via Mapsforge point MBCompass to a folder containing any .map file and toggle between online and offline - Toggle between OSM tiles and offline maps in Settings
 Track Recording - Record routes with start, pause, resume, and background support - Smooth polyline rendering on the map - Track stats: distance, duration, average speed, elevation gain/loss, min/max altitude, elevation profile - Star and sort saved tracks - Export as GPX : compatible with OsmAnd, Garmin, and any standard mapping tool
 App - Light, Dark, and AMOLED themes - Custom bottom navigation bar - Landscape orientation supported - Screen stays on during navigation - Runs on Android 6.0+ - Under 2 MB including offline map support
 Privacy - No analytics, no crash reporter, no ad network - No Google Play Services dependency - Location processed on-device only - Source: https://github.com/CompassMB/MBCompass
 Not just a compass. Not a full navigation app. MBCompass sits in between, direction, live map, track recording, and offline maps without unnecessary complexity.

fdroid:app.marmalade.stt.name: Marmalade STT
fdroid:app.marmalade.stt.summary: Private, offline speech-to-text for your keyboard. Your voice stays on device.
fdroid:app.marmalade.stt.description:
Marmalade STT turns your speech into text on your phone. Use it as the voice input of your keyboard (FUTO Keyboard, HeliBoard, FlorisBoard and others), and of apps that ask Android for speech input. Your voice never leaves the device.
 Private. Speech is recognized on the phone. Audio is never saved or uploaded
 Offline. After a one-time download of a speech engine, it works without a connection
 Live text. Shows your words in real time as you speak, on most engines
 Knows when you're done. Smart Turn, the default for the speak-now popup, waits until you sound finished, so a pause to think rarely cuts you off
 Multilingual. 100 languages, with the best engine for yours picked automatically
 Clean output. Filler words removed, numbers as digits, your own replacements and verbal snippets
 Free and open source. No ads, no accounts, no analytics
 PRIVATE BY DESIGN 
 No analytics, no tracking, no crash reporting, no accounts, and no server of ours. The internet is used only to download the speech engines you choose, from GitHub, and every file is checked against a pinned SHA-256 hash. Android backup is turned off, so nothing is copied to the cloud.
 YOU DECIDE WHEN IT STOPS 
 In the speak-now popup and other apps, Marmalade uses Smart Turn v3 technology by default to detect when you have finished speaking. No hands required. Does it cut you off too early? Switch to stopping at a pause, or set an end word instead. On the keyboard it listens until you tap, or it can use Smart Turn too.
 CLEAN TEXT 
 Optional cleanup fixes capitals, and in English removes filler words, turns "new line" and "period" into the real thing and writes numbers as digits. Replacements for names the engine gets wrong, and snippets for text you type often, work in any language.
 WORKS WITH YOUR KEYBOARD 
 Turn on "Marmalade voice typing" and your keyboard's mic key opens a small Marmalade panel that types what you say. It works with FUTO Keyboard, HeliBoard, FlorisBoard, AnySoftKeyboard, Unexpected Keyboard, AOSP's keyboard and others with a voice key.
 AN ENGINE THAT SUITS YOUR PHONE 
 The setup guide recommends a speech engine for your language and for your phone's memory and speed, with the option to download and try out other models.
 LANGUAGES 
 Fast engines cover English, Bulgarian, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Italian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Maltese, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swedish, Ukrainian, Japanese, Hindi, Arabic and Vietnamese. Chinese and Korean get Qwen3-ASR, lighter than Whisper. You can also pick it for its 28 other languages, English included. Other languages work through Whisper Large v3 Turbo, with more delay.
 OPEN SOURCE 
 Marmalade STT is MIT licensed. If you'd like to support it, Settings → Support links to GitHub Sponsors; the app is the same either way.

fdroid:com.cappielloantonio.notquitemy.t.name: Tempo
fdroid:com.cappielloantonio.notquitemy.t.summary: An open-source and lightweight music client for Subsonic
fdroid:com.cappielloantonio.notquitemy.t.description:
Tempo is an open-source and lightweight music client for Subsonic, designed and built natively for Android. It provides a seamless and intuitive music streaming experience, allowing you to access and play your Subsonic music library directly from your Android device.
Features
- Subsonic Integration: Tempo seamlessly integrates with your Subsonic server, providing you with easy access to your entire music collection on the go.
- Sleek and Intuitive UI: Enjoy a clean and user-friendly interface designed to enhance your music listening experience, tailored to your preferences and listening history.
- Browse and Search: Easily navigate through your music library using various browsing and searching options, including artists, albums, genres, playlists, decades and more.
- Streaming and Offline Mode: Stream music directly from your Subsonic server. Offline mode is currently under active development and may have limitations when using multiple servers.
- Playlist Management: Create, edit, and manage playlists to curate your perfect music collection.
- Gapless Playback: Experience uninterrupted playback with gapless listening mode.
- Chromecast Support: Stream your music to Chromecast devices. The support is currently in a rudimentary state.
- Scrobbling Integration: Optionally integrate Tempo with Last.fm to scrobble your played tracks, gather music insights, and further personalize your music recommendations, if supported by your Subsonic server.
- Podcasts and Radio: If your Subsonic server supports it, listen to podcasts and radio shows directly within Tempo, expanding your audio entertainment options.
- Transcoding Support: Activate transcoding of tracks on your Subsonic server, allowing you to set a transcoding profile for optimized streaming directly from the app. This feature requires support from your Subsonic server.

fdroid:com.deepanjanxyz.notepad.description:
Elite Memo Pro brings text notes and freehand drawings together in one place.
Write notes with titles and checklist items, or sketch on a drawing canvas with pen, marker, highlighter, selection, and eraser tools. Choose a canvas background and use blank, ruled, grid, or dotted guides. Undo and redo drawing changes.
Keep notes organized with labels, colors, and pins. Search note titles, text, and tags, with colorful match highlighting, or filter by label and color. Switch between grid and list layouts, and sort notes by last modified, created date, title, or color. Archive notes to set them aside, or move them to Trash where they can be restored or permanently deleted; trashed notes are cleared automatically after 30 days.
Set a reminder for a note to receive a notification at the scheduled time. Choose light, dark, or system appearance. An optional app lock can request biometric authentication or the device credential when the app opens.
Pin checklist notes to your home screen with a widget and tick items off without opening the app. Share a note as plain text, and back up or restore all your notes to a JSON file in Downloads.
Notes and labels are stored in the app's local Room database.

fdroid:com.marlinid.marlin.name: Marlin
fdroid:com.marlinid.marlin.summary: Identify marine species on the spot and keep a personal sightings life list
fdroid:com.marlinid.marlin.description:
Marlin: Marine Species ID & Life List
Ever spotted a fish, ray, or jellyfish while diving or snorkeling and wondered what it was? Marlin helps you identify marine life on the spot, learn more about it, and build your own personal life list of every species you encounter.
Spot it, look it up, and add it to your life list — built for everything that lives in the ocean.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
Identify species near you
See which marine species are commonly recorded near your current location, or anywhere you choose, powered by real observation data from the iNaturalist community.
Search and learn
Look up any marine species by name, or explore by classification, tapping through families and groups to discover related species. Each species page brings together photos, a range map, a seasonality chart, a Wikipedia summary, and IUCN Red List conservation status.
Build your life list
Log every sighting with notes, photos, and a precise location. Your life list keeps a running record of every species you've encountered, ready to revisit any time.
See your sightings on a map
"My Map" plots every sighting you've logged, color-coded by group (fish, sharks and rays, mollusks, jellyfish, marine mammals, and more), so you can see where and what you've found at a glance.
Make it yours
Choose a light, dark, or system theme, and set a manual location for logging sightings from a past trip.
PRIVACY BY DESIGN
Marlin doesn't ask you to create an account. There is no tracking, no analytics, and no advertising. Your life list, photos, and notes stay on your device, under your control, with manual export/import whenever you want it.
Whether you're a diver, snorkeler, beachcomber, or simply curious about what's living in the water near you, Marlin turns every encounter into something you can identify, learn from, and remember.

fdroid:de.blau.android.name: Vespucci - an OSM Editor
fdroid:de.blau.android.summary: Vespucci is the most comprehensive editor for OpenStreetMap on Android.
fdroid:de.blau.android.description:
Vespucci is an advanced open source tool for editing OpenStreetMap data, it is not a map viewer or a navigation app. You will need an OpenStreetMap account to use it.
You can download the map data for a specific area and edit the map. After editing, you can upload it directly to the OSM servers.
Any accidental change can be undone and all changes are listed for review before upload. Tag-autocompletion, JOSM compatible presets, links to the translated map-features pages and even auto-completing nearby street names help to find the right tags to use.
We recommend disabling auto-updates for Vespucci so that you can upload your edits before app updates.
More information and documentation can be found on vespucci.io and in the on-device help.
Please do not report problems or ask for support on the google playstore, see why we can't provide support and accept issues on the play store review section . You can report issues directly from the app without a github account or go directly to the issue tracker .
OpenStreetMap, OSM and the magnifying glass logo are trademarks of the OpenStreetMap Foundation . The Vespucci app is not endorsed by or affiliated with the OpenStreetMap Foundation.

apple-itunes:6810597247.name: Portal Browser
apple-itunes:6810597247.description:
Portal Browser is a web browser that lets the pages you open talk to your Bluetooth devices.
If you have a device that speaks Bluetooth LE and a web app built to drive it, this browser lets you use the two together on your phone or tablet.
HOW IT WORKS
Open any https page and use it the way you always do. If the page asks to connect to a device, a chooser appears showing the site that is asking and the devices nearby. You pick one. The page gets that device and nothing else. A web app you link can remember it, so you only pick it once.
There is no directory and no list of approved sites. You type an address, the same as anywhere else.
WHAT ELSE IS IN IT
Tabs, private browsing, find on page, history, and the address bar down where your thumb already is.
Web apps you use often can be kept as linked apps. Each one has its own storage on your phone or tablet and opens full screen, with no address bar.
Site icons, history and pairings are stored on your phone or tablet and nowhere else.
PRIVACY
This browser collects nothing. There is no account, no analytics and no advertising code in it. Everything it remembers is on your device and goes when you delete the app.

apple-macos:338828953.name: ShopSavvy - Shopping Assistant
apple-macos:338828953.description:
ShopSavvy compares prices for any product across tens of thousands of stores and sorts them lowest first. Scan a barcode or search by name, see the prices we find online and at nearby stores, and get an alert when the price drops.
Results are always sorted by price. No store can pay to rank higher.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Scan barcodes and QR codes: point your camera at a product in a store and see what it costs elsewhere before you buy.
- Search any product: type a name or model number and compare prices without scanning.
- Compare prices: every offer we find, lowest first, with stock status where the store shows it.
- Price history: see how a product's price has moved, so you can tell a real sale from the usual price.
- Price drop alerts: watch a product and get a notification when its price drops, or when it falls below the price you set.
- Back-in-stock alerts: hear about it when a sold-out product is available again.
- Deals: browse deals posted and voted on by other shoppers, with the newest popular ones on top.
- ShopSavvy Live: during big sales like Black Friday and Cyber Monday, follow deals as they drop, each one checked against that product's own price history so you can tell a real deal from a markup.
- Widgets: keep watched products and deals on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.
- Shopping assistant: chat about a product, compare options and get help choosing.
FREE, WITH ADS
ShopSavvy is free to download and use. The free app shows ads. ShopSavvy Pro removes them and refreshes prices faster.
Comparing prices since 2008. 40M+ app downloads since 2008. 4.4 stars on the App Store from 10,000+ ratings.
Website: https://shopsavvy.com
Terms of Use: https://shopsavvy.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://shopsavvy.com/privacy

apple-macos:6760477758.name: Matí - Calendar
apple-macos:6760477758.description:
Matí is a calendar for people who want to see what's actually on their plate, without shuffling apps or wading through meetings they didn't ask for.
Built natively for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, Matí reads the calendars and reminders you already have on your device (iCloud, Google, Exchange, Outlook) and gives you a clean, fast place to plan your time.
WHAT YOU GET
• Day, Week, Month, Quarter and Year views, plus a focused Agenda
• Tasks: your Apple Reminders in Today, Upcoming and Anytime, next to your events
• Weather in your calendar, from Apple Weather
• Office Days: track return-to-office days and hours, with optional arrival detection
• Coworkers' time off folded into one "Out" row
• Hide individual events from shared calendars without deleting them
• Propose times, collect RSVPs and share a booking page with people who don't use Matí
• Quick add in plain language: "Coffee with Jane at 2pm tomorrow"
• Event templates, events from a photo, and calendar subscriptions by URL
• Widgets for the Home Screen, Lock Screen and Control Center, an Apple Watch app, a Focus filter, Siri Shortcuts and Spotlight
• Custom themes, accent colors and alternate app icons
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your calendar stays on your device. Matí syncs your preferences, hidden events and templates through your own private iCloud account. There are no analytics, tracking or advertising SDKs. Booking, proposals and RSVPs are optional: when you use them, only what's needed to deliver them (your name and email, and your guests' replies) goes to Matí's server, and you can delete it from the app at any time.
WORKS WITH YOUR EXISTING CALENDARS
Matí doesn't replace your calendar accounts; it gives you a better view of them. Add or remove accounts in Settings → Calendar → Accounts and Matí picks them up automatically.
---
Have feedback? Email mati@torresrobert.com or visit torresrobert.com/mati/support
Privacy: torresrobert.com/mati/privacy
Terms: torresrobert.com/mati/terms

fedora-packages:cloudy/cloudy.name: cloudy
fedora-packages:cloudy/cloudy.summary: Spectral synthesis code to simulate conditions in interstellar matter
fedora-packages:cloudy/cloudy.description: Most of the quantitative information we have about the cosmos comes from spectroscopy. In many cases the light we analyze was produced by atoms in the first generations of stars and galaxies. The spectra are produced by dilute gas where such properties as the gas kinetic temperature, chemical state, level of ionization, and level populations, are determined by a host of microphysical processes rather than by a single temperature. Analytical solutions are seldom possible and computer solutions are needed to understand their physical properties. Numerical simulations make it possible to understand complex physical environments starting from first principles. Cloudy is designed to do exactly this.

fedora-packages:docopt-cpp/docopt-cpp.name: docopt-cpp
fedora-packages:docopt-cpp/docopt-cpp.description: docopt creates beautiful command-line interfaces Isn't it awesome how getopt (and boost::program_options for you fancy folk!) generate help messages based on your code?! These timeless functions have been around for decades and have proven we don't need anything better, right? Hell no! You know what's awesome? It's when the option parser is generated based on the beautiful help message that you write yourself! This way you don't need to write this stupid repeatable parser-code, and instead can write only the help message-the way you want it. This is a port of the docopt.py module (https://github.com/docopt/docopt), and we have tried to maintain full feature parity (and code structure) as the original. This port is written in C++11 and also requires a good C++11 standard library (in particular, one with regex support).

The load balancing framework relies on well-known and widely used Linux Virtual Server (IPVS) kernel module providing Layer4 load balancing. Keepalived implements a set of checkers to dynamically and adaptively maintain and manage load-balanced server pool according their health. High availability is achieved by VRRP protocol. firefox-addons:2707951.name: Definer: Word Translator, Ask AI, Popup Dictionary
firefox-addons:2707951.summary: Select text to translate, define, or ask AI. A word translator and dictionary extension for webpages, PDFs, and EPUBs.
firefox-addons:2707951.description:
Read the articles and books you want in another language, with help close to the text. Definer is a popup dictionary and word translator that brings definitions, contextual translation, pronunciation and AI explanations beside your selection. Get a quick answer, explore an interesting expression or keep something useful for later learning.
KEY FEATURES
📖 Dictionary meanings, examples, synonyms and related words
🌍 Translate selected words, phrases and passages in context
🎧 Text to speech, pronunciation recordings and video examples
🤖 AI explanations, writing help and reusable prompts
🔎 Image search, Wikipedia and your own dictionary sources
📚 PDF and EPUB Reader with a personal library
🗂 Lookup History, editable vocabulary and Anki export
🖱 Open a lookup beside your text
Select text with the mouse, then click the small round Definer icon that appears. You can also use a keyboard shortcut or the Definer command in the right-click menu. Prefer looking up words with a double-click? Enable double-click lookup in the popup settings.
🌍 Understand the sentence and explore the word
A translation helps you follow the passage; a dictionary helps you get to know the expression. Translator's In Context section translates the surrounding sentence or paragraph and highlights your selected expression. Compare alternative translations to find the wording that fits the passage. Open the dictionary for meanings, usage examples and related words, then compare those examples with the sentence you are reading. Follow a related term into another lookup when you want to explore further.
📖 Use your preferred dictionaries
Add a website dictionary as a Custom source or import a supported Offline Dictionary file. Keep a trusted learner's dictionary or specialist reference alongside the included resources.
Choose the language of the answers as well as the language of the text. Keep dictionary explanations in your study language beside a translation into your own language, or choose another result language for a particular resource.
🔎 See what the words refer to
When a passage mentions an unfamiliar musical instrument, a translated name may still leave you guessing. Look at pictures from Open Images' openly licensed cultural collections, then open Wikipedia to learn about its history or role. Explore pictures, background information and definitions in the same lookup.
🎧 Connect the written phrase with its sound
Listen to a word or selected passage with text to speech. Compare pronunciation recordings from Wiktionary, or use YouGlish to hear the expression in videos. A phrase you recognize on the page may sound quite different in conversation: hearing its stress and rhythm gives you something concrete to listen for next time.
🤖 Reuse the kind of AI help you need
Ask why a tense is used, what makes a remark sarcastic or how to make your own sentence more natural. Follow up on the part of the explanation you want to understand better. AI can also summarize selected text or help revise its grammar and tone.
Save your usual instructions as prompts: one for grammar at your level, another for a more polite reply. These prompts appear as separate tasks, each with its own conversation for that lookup. Return to the grammar explanation after working on the reply, then reuse either prompt with the next passage.
🗂 Build editable vocabulary and flashcards
Save the information that made an expression useful to you: dictionary meanings and examples, a contextual translation or a helpful AI conversation. Organize it in Collections by book, language or subject, then edit the content in your own words.
Recipes let you choose how available results become study material. A custom card can put an example on the front and combine a dictionary meaning with a translation on the back. Once that layout suits your study method, reuse it for later discoveries instead of rearranging each card by hand.
📚 Continue a book in the PDF and EPUB Reader
Open course materials, papers and ebooks in Definer's Reader and use your chosen lookup sources inside the document. Books stay in a local library with your reading position, ready for the next session.
In an EPUB, move between chapters and adjust the text size. In a PDF, search for a passage, highlight it or add a note. PDF annotations save to the library copy, and you can download an annotated copy to keep or share.
🖥 Optional Desktop app for Windows and Linux
For text in an image, screenshot, app or game, the separate Definer Desktop app adds screen OCR and text recognition. Start Word from its tray menu and click a word, or start Region and drag around a passage. Configured shortcuts offer another way to start. The recognized text opens in Definer's lookup tools, ready for a translation, definition or AI question.
❓ FAQ
Can useful phrases be saved after finishing a chapter?
Yes. With History recording enabled, reopen recorded lookups in History to revisit their available results and original page context. Choose the expressions worth keeping and save from those results when you are ready. You can finish the chapter before deciding what belongs in your vocabulary collection.
How can saved vocabulary be exported?
Send flashcards to desktop Anki through AnkiConnect, export Markdown files for notes, choose CSV for a spreadsheet or use JSON for structured data. You can export selected items or whole Collections, so a particular project can travel with the material you chose for it.
🛠 QUICK HELP
If Definer stops responding, restart your browser. If the lookup popup does not appear, check that your chosen activation action is enabled and that Definer is enabled for the current site. You can also click Definer in the browser toolbar, type a word or phrase and press Enter for a manual lookup.
For a continuing problem, email definer@lumetrium.com with your browser name, the affected page and a short description of what happened.
📬 CONTACT & COMMUNITY
Questions, bug reports or ideas: definer@lumetrium.com 
Discussion and updates:
 https://www.reddit.com/r/lumetrium_definer 
Guides and customization examples:
 https://lumetrium.com/definer/wiki

firefox-addons:763140.name: AccessURL
firefox-addons:763140.summary: Share access to websites without giving away your username and password. Share access with an Access URL instead.
firefox-addons:763140.description:
Securely share access to online accounts with colleagues, family, and friends without revealing your password. AccessURL gives you a secure URL that shares your online account, lets you control how long you want to share your account for, and lets you revoke access later.
AccessURL also lets you securely ask for access to websites via URL or email. The other person can share their account in one-click, without revealing their password.
Use AccessURL to:
- Share your Facebook account with your friend, without telling her your username and password
- Get your friend to proofread that paper you're writing
- Let your colleague send that email for you
- and so much more
Security is very important. That's why AccessURL encrypts session data with AES-256. That's also why AccessURL lets you set an expiration on Access URLs.
Only send Access URLs to people you personally know and trust. Only use it for websites which allow you to share accounts. 
You can also use AccessURL to ask for access to websites from someone you know. 
Note: AccessURL currently does not support Incognito mode. If you'd like to test it out, use two copies of Firefox on the same computer or try it with multiple computers.
If you have any questions, reach out to support@accessurl.com.

Play classic solitaire card games with Solitaire City advert free - one of the first 500 apps on the original iOS App Store that launched in 2008!
Enjoy your favorite solitaire games such as Klondike, Double Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Spiderette, Tri-Peaks, Scorpion, Pyramid and many more. This paid version of Solitaire City is completely advert free, contains no In-App Purchases, no tracking and doesn't collect any analytics data. Your privacy is important to us! If you've played thousands of games with the free version of Solitaire City then your scores, statistics and customizations will now be automatically transferred to this paid version so there's no excuse not to upgrade now! Solitaire City is a Universal App! Buy once and play it on all your iOS devices with tablet enhanced high resolution graphics on iPads and detailed HD graphics on all devices that have Retina displays.
Nearly 70 Solitaire Games and Variations
Enjoy one of the largest solitaire collections available:
• Klondike Solitaire (6 variations)
• Spider Solitaire One, Two and Four Suits
• FreeCell Solitaire (7 variations)
• Double Klondike Solitaire (3 variations)
• Spiderette Solitaire One, Two and Four Suits
• Tri-Peaks Solitaire (2 variations)
• Scorpion Solitaire One, Two and Four Suits
• Alternations Solitaire (4 variations)
• Three Shuffles and a Draw
• Demon/Canfield Solitaire (4 variations)
• Poker Squares (4 variations)
• Pyramid Solitaire (4 variations)
• Cribbage Squares (3 variations)
• Golf Solitaire (4 variations)
• Casket Solitaire (2 variations)
• Eliminator Solitaire (3 variations)
• Yukon Solitaire (3 variations)
• La Belle Lucie
• Demon Fan
• Shamrocks
• Fan
• Super Flower Garden
• Baker's Dozen Solitaire
• Blind Alleys Solitaire (2 variations)
• Accordion Solitaire (2 variations)
Solitaire City is played against the clock for points. The faster you complete a game, the higher your score. Think you have an epic score? Then take a look at the numerous Game Center leaderboards to see how it compares with players from all around the world.
A unique training system is included that teaches you the game rules and points out valid moves as you play. No more confusing rules to read. Learn new solitaire games as you play!
Solitaire City Features:
• No adverts or In-App purchases
• Universal iPhone and iPad solitaire app
• Smooth tap or drag card gameplay
• Classic Klondike solitaire (patience)
• Windows Solitaire rule numbers.
• Beautiful HD graphics for all Retina displays
• Enhanced HD graphics on iPad
• Play solitaire in portrait or landscape
• Rotate your device during play
• Stunning card animations and visual effects
• Fast timed scoring system
• Game Center leaderboards & achievements
• Interactive solitaire training system
• Hint / Suggest Move button
• Detailed solitaire statistics
• Listen to your music while playing
• Fun sound effects and customizable sound themes
• Custom card backs and backgrounds
• Use photos from your album as card backgrounds or card backs
• Multiple card deck styles
• Replay the same solitaire deal anytime
• Unlimited undo moves
• Automatically saves your game
• Left-handed and right-handed play options
Notes:
• Three Shuffles and a Draw and La Belle Lucie appear under the Fan Games section.
• Enable Confirm New/End Game in Settings if you want confirmation before ending a game.
• Prefer playing solitaire in bed? Lock the screen orientation to portrait or landscape in Settings.
• You can either drag cards onto other cards or use the Tap to Move feature - tap on a card to highlight it grey and then tap where you want it to move to. You can turn Tap to Move off from the Solitaire City Settings screen if you always drag cards.
Try our other games "Yatzy Master", "10 Pin Shuffle" and "Silly Saucers", also available on the App Store.

bluejetty:00098236:ios.name: Mastermind: Self Improvement
bluejetty:00098236:ios.summary: Struggling with consistency or direction? Mastermind offers a personalized habit-building system to help you transform your life in 90 days. More than just a habit tracker—it's your personal development companion designed for lasting change
bluejetty:00098236:ios.description:
Struggling with consistency or direction? Mastermind offers a personalized habit-building system to help you transform your life in 90 days. More than just a habit tracker—it's your personal development companion designed for lasting change.
HOW MASTERMIND WORKS
1. Personalized Assessment
Complete our psychology-based quiz covering Focus, Discipline, Physical Health, Confidence, Wisdom, and Relationships. Mastermind creates a custom habit sequence tailored to your current performance and goals.
2. Progressive Habit Building
Start with manageable daily habits that automatically scale in difficulty. Each week introduces new challenges while building on your existing progress, preventing overwhelm and ensuring sustainable growth.
3. Daily Coaching & Insights
Receive personalized daily insights and micro-adjustments based on your progress. Smart prompts adapt to your performance levels, providing strategic guidance when you need it most.
4. Real-Time Progress Tracking
Monitor your improvement across all life dimensions with detailed analytics. See your percentile ranking compared to others in your demographic and watch it climb week by week.
WHY MASTERMIND WORKS
Science-Based Approach
Built on behavioral psychology and proven habit formation research. Our progressive overload system uses the same principles that help professional athletes achieve peak performance.
25+ Evidence-Based Habits
Choose from morning, daytime, and evening routines including meditation, exercise, reading, sleep optimization, social media limits, journaling, and relationship building—all timed for maximum impact.
Gamified Progress System
Earn XP points, unlock achievements, and celebrate milestones. Your personal progress tree grows with every positive choice, making self-improvement genuinely addictive.
Beautiful, Intuitive Design
Clean interface optimized for daily use with quick-add functionality, dark mode, and seamless device syncing. Built for busy schedules and real-world consistency.
PERFECT FOR
Anyone who has struggled with consistency in self-improvement, tried other habit apps without lasting results, or seeks a systematic approach to personal development. Whether you're a professional seeking peak performance or someone ready to make serious positive changes.
WHAT OUR USERS ARE SAYING
"Finally, a habit app that actually understands my psychology. The personalized approach makes all the difference."
"I've tried dozens of habit trackers. Mastermind is the first one that's helped me build habits that actually stick long-term."
"The progressive difficulty scaling is genius. I never feel overwhelmed, but I'm always being challenged to grow."
"Seeing my percentile ranking improve week by week keeps me incredibly motivated. It's like having a personal scoreboard for life."
———————
SUBSCRIPTIONS AND TERMS
Mastermind offers full access to all features, including personalized daily quests, custom insights, and mastery tracking, through a premium subscription plan.
If you choose to purchase a subscription, payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store settings.
Before subscribing, you’ll be able to preview your personalized plan and explore limited features. A subscription is required to unlock the full experience.
Mastermind is not a substitute for professional advice or treatment. It provides general guidance to support self-improvement, productivity, and personal growth. Please consult a qualified professional if you are seeking medical, psychological, or therapeutic support.
Use of the app is subject to your own discretion and unique needs.
Privacy Policy: https://www.withmastermind.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://www.withmastermind.com/terms

bluejetty:00025643:ios.summary:

Easy-to-Use App Features:

bluejetty:00025643:ios.description:
Drift into Deep Sleep and Relaxation with Sleep Dose - White Noise & Rain. 
Create a peaceful environment to sleep and relax. Help early risers stay in bed, disruptive sleepers stay asleep longer.
Easy-to-Use App Features:
- Mix multiple soothing sleep sounds.
- True binaural beats for sleep and healing: 2 Hz Delta Waves, 528 Hz...
- All color noises to block out distractions are green noise, brown noise, red noise, and pink noise...
- 50+ unique white noise: rain sounds, waterfall, fan noise, airplane cabin...
- Background audio support so you can use other apps while listening.
- Integrated Sleep Timer that fades out noise after the set time.
- 1-Tap to play: simply effective and not hindered.
- Without any distracting digital looping.
- Play on speakers, AirPods, or HomePod.
- Control from the lock screen.
- Relaxing Dark Mode.
 Sleep Dose creates a unique relaxation and sleep-start process:
① More scientific classification of white noise, allowing you to quickly find the sound you want;
② More intuitive display of the mixed white noise combination allows you to quickly confirm your choice;
③ When mixed white noise is played, it will enter an almost full-screen dynamic background, giving you a signal of relaxation and sleep.
Whether you want to use it at home or in travel. Enjoy sleep & relax!
What is white noise?
White noise is sound that includes all frequencies audible to the human ear—between 20 hertz and 20,000 hertz—played at an equal intensity or amplitude, measured in decibels. White noise is more than just recordings of ocean waves and rain sounds. White noise is a collection of sounds that has the same intensity through the audible range, creating a uniform sound perfect for masking loud disruptions. In other words, white noise “smooths” out your audible environment for sleeping, studying, focusing, and more!
OVER 50+ white noise sleep sounds:
* Green Noise
* Rain Sounds
* Fan noise
* Healing Music
* 528 Hz Healing Frequency
* Nature Sounds
* Rain sounds
* Water sounds
* Campfire sounds
* Air Conditioner
* Fan
* Airplane Cabin
* Driving in the Rain
* Birds and Chimes
* Cat Purring
* Crickets
* Croaking Frogs
* Light Rain
* Medium Rain
* Rain on Tent
* Distant Thunder
* Rolling Thunder
* Ocean Waves
* Winter Wind
* Brown Noise
* White Noise
Why buy a portable noise maker or sound machine when you can use the devices you already own?
ReSleep works great when played directly from your iPhone or iPad speaker.
Sleep Dose is your better choice! Give your family and friends a better sleep.
SUBSCRIPTION
Sleep Dose offers monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscription options to get unlimited access to all content in the app. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy policy: https://betterfeel.me/privacy-policy
Terms of service: https://betterfeel.me/terms

bluejetty:00073000:ios.description:
WeRIDE Micro provides convenient, affordable, and on-demand shared rides in the cities of Avondale and Goodyear, within a distinct zone in each city. All trips in each cities must take place within their respective zones. Service hour details vary by city; the latest can be found at WeRideAZ.com
WeRIDE Micro is a shared ride service that pairs multiple passengers heading in the same direction in a single vehicle. By entering your pickup and drop-off locations in the WeRIDE Micro App, you will be matched with a vehicle going your way.
The regular adult fare is $2.00 per ride. Seniors over the age of 60, veterans, disabled and students currently registered at EMCC and Franklin Pierce pay a reduced fare of $1.00 per ride. Children 5-years of age and under ride free with a fare-paying passenger age 16-years and above.
Customers that prefer to pay cash for their trip can do so on board the vehicle. Drivers can only accept the exact fare and will NOT be able to provide change.
WeRIDE Micro vehicles are ADA-friendly and seat up to 5 passengers. Bike Racks are available on all of the vehicles. Children under 5-years of age and/or under 65 pounds will need to ride in a car seat provided and secured by the accompanying adult.

- Expense Splitting
Automate expense tracking and payments among roommates. Never lose track of who owes what. Perfect for college students and shared homes.
- Task Management
Assign and schedule tasks seamlessly. Receive real-time notifications for upcoming and completed tasks, ensuring a clean and organized home.
- Activity Log
Maintain a transparent log of all household actions. Keep track of completed activities for a well-managed home environment.
- Invites and Group Management
Easily invite roommates or family members using a simple code. Intuitively manage group settings to suit your living arrangement.
- Free with No Ads
Enjoy all these features without any cost and zero ads. Dwell is your go-to roommate organizer and expense manager, completely free of charge. 
- Dwell+
Try out our premium offering, Dwell+, for more advanced features like homescreen widgets, task checklists, custom app icons, and more.
Download Dwell today and transform your shared living experience. For any help or to provide feedback, reach out to us at support@heydwell.com.

bluejetty:00045526:ios.description:
BCS preparation and BCS LIVE model test with Live MCQ™ IOS App.
Test your preparation with real competitors through Live model tests for BCS exam.
*** NO ADS ***
*** Live MCQ™ is managed by BCS Cadres and Assistant Director of Bangladesh Bank ***
CrackTech is introducing VEC (Virtual Exam Center) for the first time in Bangladesh, through its first product Live MCQ™ for BCS Preliminary exam preparation and other government jobs.
Exams Covered: BCS, Bank, Govt. Jobs, NTRCA, Primary Teacher, Bar Council, Nurse and Midwifery, etc.
BCS is the most competitive exam in Bangladesh. To succeed on the BCS preliminary exam you have to be at the top 5%. But you don't know your position before the final BCS preliminary exam as you never give model tests with thousands of your competitors ever.
With Live MCQ™ you can:
- Attend Model Tests throughout your BCS preparation period **LIVE** with thousands of students at a time.
- Prepare for a few days by following the routine and giving the model tests.
- Be able to know your position with the “Same MCQ Question” against your competitors.
- Know your detailed results for every exam without any effort and time.
- You can always go back to the old questions and learn from them.
- And, prepare yourself for the final exam by being in the competition and improve yourself step by step.
Live MCQ is determined to –
• Provide you the best quality questions in Bangladesh for every BCS Model Test.
• Keep every BCS model test question unique by avoiding repetition and “Copy Paste” free.
• Prepare the BCS questions according to the syllabus of the relevant exam (BCS, Govt. Jobs etc.) and also considering the up-to-date information.
• 24/7 hours support through our Email (contact@livemcq.com) and phone (+8801701377322).
Key Features of Live MCQ – 
Live MCQ BCS model test with real competitors.
Absolutely Ads Free.
Continuous BCS MCQ model tests throughout the preparation period.
Premium quality BCS questions!
Detailed Subject wise results for every test.
BCS Preliminary Question bank of old model tests for future preparation.
Easy and simple interface without any unnecessary animation or effects.
No registration, Safe One click Gmail/Facebook login.
We believe that this will help you a lot to prepare yourself better for the final BCS Preli exam.
With best wishes and a lot of love.
- CrackTech Limited, Bangladesh.

bluejetty:00100374:ios.description:
Transform your body, build real strength, and feel confident with Military Calisthenics Women — a home workout app designed specifically for women 40+ who want to burn fat, build muscle, and reshape their body without any equipment.
This program targets common problem areas like “marriage belly,” thin arms, and overall body tone, helping you look and feel strong instead of just skinny. With structured calisthenics workouts, you can achieve real strength, endurance, and body confidence from the comfort of your home.
Why Military Calisthenics Works:
• Build Muscle & Strength
Military-style bodyweight exercises focus on total-body strength, targeting arms, core, legs, and glutes. Progressively challenging routines help you build functional strength, tone muscles, and improve posture.
• Burn Fat Effectively
Structured workouts combine high-intensity movements and endurance training to maximize calorie burn and accelerate fat loss.
• Sculpt & Tone Problem Areas
Focus on the areas that matter most — waist, arms, and hips — to achieve a leaner, more defined silhouette.
• Boost Endurance & Confidence
Daily training sessions increase stamina, energy levels, and overall body resilience, helping you feel empowered in every aspect of life.
Features You’ll Love:
· 28-Day Personalized Plan
Daily routines tailored to your fitness level and goals. Each session is structured to gradually increase intensity and deliver real results.
· No Equipment Needed
All workouts are designed to be done at home with just your bodyweight — perfect for busy lifestyles.
· Beginner-Friendly Guidance
Step-by-step instructions, clear video demonstrations, and progressive plans make it easy to start at any fitness level.
· Full-Body Focus
Exercises target arms, core, glutes, and legs, helping you develop strength, endurance, and a balanced physique.
· Track Your Progress
Visualize improvements with daily tracking, streaks, and performance metrics to stay motivated.
· Flexible & Convenient
Short, effective sessions fit into any schedule — even 10–15 minutes a day can make a difference.
· Expertly Designed Workouts
Routines are created to maximize results while minimizing risk of injury.
Take the first step toward a stronger, fitter, and more confident you. With Military Calisthenics Women, your 28-day transformation is just a few minutes a day — start building strength and reshaping your body today!
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS:
• The app offers a 7-day free trial.
• Any unused portion of the free trial is forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
• Payment will be charged to the credit card linked to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
• Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage your subscription anytime in Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.workoutinc.net/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.workoutinc.net/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00161092:ios.description:
OCTANE AUV3 Plugin
OCTANE, designed by producers for producers, is the new go-to audio plug-in for producers. With tons of presets and effects ready to go, OCTANE is designed to set the vibe for any music producer and find the sound for your next hit in seconds!
EFFECTS
+ Reverb
+ Delay
+ Filter
+ Distortion
+ Trance Gate
+ 2 Arpeggiators
+ Distortion
+ Stereo Image
+ More...

LAYERS

+ Tuning
+ Arpeggiator
+ Reverse
+ Ring Modulation
+ Tremolo
EQUALIZER
Need to get the sounds and frequencies just right? No problem! You can do just that with our 6-Band Equalizer
DYNAMICS
Make your 808’s hit harder and bring your sounds to the forefront of your production with our Dynamics tab.
+ Exciter
+ Compressor
+ Expander
LO-FI

Cross-Platform

bluejetty:00157870:ios.name: VanMoof

Get the most out of your VanMoof bike with the official app.

bluejetty:00157870:ios.description:
Get the most out of your VanMoof bike with the official app.
It’s all at your fingertips. Lock or unlock your bike, check the battery level, and find where you parked it – all from your phone. Keep an eye out for regular updates geared to take your VanMoof riding experience to the next level. 
What can you do with the VanMoof app?
No matter where you are in the app, it will assist you with your smoothest ride yet:
Home
* No keys are needed, your bike smartly recognizes you. Unlock your bike with just a tap or create a personal unlock code to easily unlock your bike without your phone.
* Check how much battery your bike has (and Powerbank if you have one).
* View your current speed, distance, and ride duration on your in-app live dashboard.
* Adjust your bike settings instantly on the home screen. You can change your motor assistance, gears, lights, bell sound, and other bike sounds.
Rides
* Look back at every trip with a detailed ride overview. 
* You can view every journey, including the time, distance, maximum and average speed, if you stopped, and how much battery it cost. 
* See how you compare to other VanMoof riders in your city and across the World.
Garage
* Find all of your bike information, change your bike settings, and view your MyVanmoof profile.
* Share your bike with your friends and family.
* Mark your bike as missing and send in the Bike Hunters.
* If your bike has Apple Find My, you can see the current status.
Supported bike models
* VanMoof S6 & S6 Open
* VanMoof S5 & A5
* VanMoof S4 & X4
* VanMoof S3 & X3
* VanMoof S2 & X2
* VanMoof Electrified S & X
* VanMoof Smart S & X
* VanMoof Smartbike
Disclaimer: App features are dependent on your bike model.

bluejetty:00064980:ios.description:
Highpoint Community Bank's mobile app is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you

To use the Highpoint Community app, you must be enrolled as a Highpoint Community digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00080434:ios.description:
Leica LUX is a professional camera app that brings the iconic Leica Look – and its signature color, style, and feel – to your iPhone. Developed in-house by Leica, it gives you the unique visual character of Leica cameras in a powerful mobile experience.
FLEXIBLE PHOTOGRAPHY
Leica LUX simplifies the photographic process to capture life's moments with clarity. Whether you're shooting landscapes, street scenes, or intimate portraits, Leica LUX offers countless creative opportunities. Photographers of every skill level can craft masterpieces, using automatic mode for spontaneous snapshots or diving into the manual settings to tweak every detail.
LENS SIMULATIONS
Stunning simulations of legendary Leica lenses bring prestige and personality to your mobile photography. Each lens has a distinct visual style, from the Summilux-M 28mm f/1.4 ASPH to the Noctilux-M 50mm f/1.2 ASPH, with more lens options coming soon. The custom software engine also creates authentic-looking bokeh directly on your iPhone. 
ICONIC LEICA LOOKS
Leica LUX was developed in accordance with the acclaimed color science of Leica, offering the same color corrections and film presets as found in Leica cameras. These Leica Looks include Leica Classic, Leica Contemporary, Leica Black & White, and Leica Vivid. More than 15 looks are currently available, giving your images rich textures, emotional nuance, and inimitable drama.
AUTOMATIC AND MANUAL CONTROL
Leica LUX allows you to expand your creativity, choosing between an intuitive automatic mode or full-fledged manual control. Manual photographers can adjust the exposure compensation, shutter speed, ISO, white balance, focus mode, RAW output, and more.
SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS
Leica LUX Pro expands the Leica experience for photographers looking to get the most from their images. Choose from a $6.99/month or $69.99/year package. These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary. Subscriptions are automatically renewed. Go to your account settings in the App Store to manage your subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://leica-camera.com/node/9954/iframe

bluejetty:00013196:android.name: Rhythm Piano Music Tiles
bluejetty:00013196:android.summary:
Rhythm Piano Music Tiles 2
The Perfect Fusion of Music and Challenge
I. Core Gameplay
Rhythm Piano Music Tiles 2 is a rhythm-based offline game where players tap descending black tiles onto the judgment line in sync with the music to compl
bluejetty:00013196:android.description:
Rhythm Piano Music Tiles 2
The Perfect Fusion of Music and Challenge
I. Core Gameplay
Rhythm Piano Music Tiles 2 is a rhythm-based offline game where players tap descending black tiles onto the judgment line in sync with the music to complete combos. With minimalist visuals and dynamic soundtracks, the game transforms musical rhythm into fingertip thrills. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned rhythm gamer, you'll discover tailored challenges in its progressively layered beats.
II. Diverse Music and Visual Spectacle
Featuring a vast library of songs spanning classical piano, pop hits, EDM, and indie tracks, each track is paired with a unique visual theme—from celestial keyboard light trails to cyberpunk neon stages. Synchronized audio-visual experiences immerse players in concert-like atmospheres. Iconic melodies like Canon in D and Twinkle Twinkle Little Star deliver fresh, innovative performances.
III. Precision Controls and Advanced Techniques
While the mechanics seem simple, mastery requires skill. Players must master combo timing, long-press swipes, and multi-tap sequences to conquer complex high-difficulty charts. Rapid-fire tiles test hand speed limits, while sudden "acceleration segments" challenge mental resilience. Compete globally through daily challenges and real-time multiplayer battles against up to 4 players.
IV. Personalized Experience and Social Interaction
The game supports custom music uploads, allowing players to convert local tracks into personalized soundtracks. Share these with friends via the community hub. Built-in modes like Master Mode offer endless combo challenges, while Co-op Mode enables duo play for high-difficulty duets. The AI-powered Rhythm Classroom analyzes player performance, providing targeted training advice to transform novices into rhythm masters.
V. Technological Innovation and Immersive Experience
Powered by advanced touch feedback technology, Rhythm Piano Music Tiles 2 achieves millisecond-level responsiveness, enhanced by vibration feedback and stereo sound effects that replicate real piano key sensations. A dynamic difficulty system adjusts chart intensity in real time, balancing fluidity and challenge. Offline mode ensures instant access, letting players enjoy musical healing during fragmented moments.
VI. Game Features:
 · Simple graphics, intuitive controls—everyone can play piano!
 · Breathtaking rhythms that push hand-speed limits.
 · Online multiplayer battles with up to 4 players on-screen.
 · Share records with friends and compete globally via leaderboards.
 · High-quality sound design for concert-like immersion.
 · Progressive challenges with great rewards to boost self-improvement.
Conclusion
Rhythm Piano Music Tiles 2 transcends traditional rhythm games—it's a bridge connecting players to art. Through precise rhythm control, diverse music, and innovative gameplay design, it redefines the possibilities of rhythm gaming. Whether you're chasing high scores or seeking musical relaxation, this game lets you find your unique rhythm through fingertip motion.
Download now and embark on your piano conquest journey!

bluejetty:00183527:ios.name: UniWyo Mobile Banking
bluejetty:00183527:ios.summary: The UniWyo Mobile Banking App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your UniWyo accounts, including some external institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized a
bluejetty:00183527:ios.description:
The UniWyo Mobile Banking App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your UniWyo accounts, including some external institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you're looking for when searching through your finances.
Deposit Checks: No need to go to a local branch to deposit your checks. Deposit them right from the app.
Pay Bills: Pay people and businesses right from your account – even set up scheduled payments so you can set it and forget it.
Contact Us: Locate ATMs or branches and contact UniWyo customer service right from the app.

bluejetty:00120556:ios.description:
IMPORTANT NOTE: THIS IS NOT A SUBSCRIPTION! AFTER THE 30 DAYS, IT JUST STOPS WORKING. You don't have to cancel it...YOU AREN'T GOING TO BE CHARGED. If Speak for Yourself is the right choice, purchase the full version!
It’s FINALLY here! This is the answer to everyone who has been hesitant to purchase the full version of Speak for Yourself without being able to try it. 
SFY-Lite 2.0 (and above) gives you access to the full Speak for Yourself app capabilities* for a 30 day FREE trial! 
SfY-Lite includes access to the almost 5000 word vocabulary, full programming capabilities, the unparalleled search feature, history feature, Hold That Thought, and voice options. By doing this, AAC users, SLPs, other professionals, and family members are able to use the intuitive programming and features of Speak for Yourself and access the library of almost 11,000 Smarty Symbols®.
SFY-Lite is not intended to be an individual's permanent AAC language system. It was designed to determine if an individual is able to access the button size, activate the buttons, and use Speak for Yourself to improve communication. 
The free trial will only last for 30 days. After the 30 days, it will go back to the static main screen where it started. HOWEVER, you will be able to access your history data and your vocabulary file, even after the trial ends. That means that any of your programming and customization will be saved so that you can transfer it into the full version. 
Speak for Yourself was designed by two ASHA-certified speech-language pathologists (SLPs) with an extensive knowledge of AAC devices and implementation. We're very excited to give EVERYONE the ability to have the full functionality of Speak for Yourself in their hands and homes for free! You have nothing to lose and every reason to take 30 days and give it a try. With the release of a new and improved SFY-Lite, we invite you to join us in our mission to change the world...one voice at a time.
*The only features that are not available in SfY-Lite are Acapela premium voice offered in the full version as in-app purchases and multi-user capabilities (the full version can hold 40 different user vocabulary files).

bluejetty:00161497:ios.description:
Testes, Dicas, Exercícios e Especialistas em saúde e bem-estar emocional.
Quantas vezes você já se encontrou frente a um desafio emocional no seu dia a dia, precisava de ajuda mas não sabia onde procurar? O Zenklub é o lugar onde, a um clique de distância, você encontra novas formas de lidar com seus obstáculos, por meio de reflexões, técnicas ou, até mesmo, sessões com especialistas como psicólogos, terapeutas holísticos, psicanalistas e coaches.
Receba conteúdo que te ajuda efetivamente a lidar melhor com assuntos como falta de propósito, relacionamentos, carreira e autoconhecimento. Faça testes para avaliar seu nível de ansiedade, depressão ou saber como anda a qualidade do seu sono. Aprenda exercícios como técnicas de respiração e mindfulness para aliviar seu estresse, além de mecanismos para lidar com suas angústias.
Tudo isso a qualquer hora e de onde você estiver. 
Você também pode agendar sessões a partir de R$ 60 por chat ou vídeo-sessão com um de nossos +150 especialistas em psicologia, terapia alternativa, coaching, psicanálise ou mindfulness. 
Junte-se à nossa comunidade e descubra como Se Conhecer Faz Bem.
-----------
Benefícios para você conquistar seu bem-estar emocional:
- Direito a recibo das sessões para reembolso no seu plano de saúde
- Especialistas disponíveis agora para você fazer uma sessão
- Horários todos os dias, incluindo sábado e domingo
- Pagamento fácil por cartão de crédito ou pix
- Variedade de especialistas: psicólogos, coaches, psicanalistas e terapeutas alternativos
Funcionalidades para uma experiência incrível:
- +10 testes de comportamento e saúde em áreas como ansiedade, depressão, sono, resiliência, habilidades sociais ou inteligência emocional
- +50 exercícios em temas como motivação, foco, relacionamento amoroso, angústia e mindfulness
- Dicas diárias para acompanhar você na sua semana
- Fale por chat para conhecer o especialista primeiro
- Sessões por chat, áudio ou vídeo
Mais alguns temas que você pode explorar no Zenklub:
- Autoestima
- Propósito
- Personalidade
- Morar no exterior
- Carreira
- Pânico
- Angústia
- Inteligência emocional
-----------

-----------

All Real-Time!

Alerts.

Parameters for being on a list:
Day Volume>1k
Realtime Stock Screener app for iOS is free and get the US market stocks
based on stock volume and technical analysis also you can check fundamentals, delayed stock charts
and stock news of each stock in the NYSE or NASDAQ.
This stock trading tool is very useful for day trading and swing trading low float stocks.
You can scan realtime premarket movers and stocks which move after market close.
If you do online stock trading then you will like this free stock scanner which allows you
to see livestock movers with real-time stock quotes
Also, this market stock app is one of the best stock scanner for iOS, but you have to
know how stock trading works and also have your own online broker like thinkorswim, ameritrade,
robinhood, etrade or ibkr.
This Real-time stock screener is very similar to Trade Ideas, TradingView, Finviz, Stocktwits,Yahoo Finance,
Zacks stock research and other desktop stock market apps.
In Realtime Stock Screener you can find stocks using various criteria.
Criteria can be premarket stock with stock news released before market opens.
In fact it can be used as a stock advisor or market analyst.
Also you can watch stock market movers on Gainers Tab.
Market US stock finder also have Pulse Tab showing realtime market state with main
market companies Amazon, Facebook, Miscrosoft, Tesla, Google.
Also it shows futures gold price, spy stock market index and volatility market stock etf
Also, US stock market app could be used as a stock market tracker to check all stocks with recent news.
In one place there are an option to check livestock news, stock chart, fundamentals, and sec stock reports
Realtime stock scanner also have low float stock list(Stocks with shares float less than 10mln shares) which
allows you to analyse stocks for swing trading or daytrading.
Main Screener options:
Premarket(6.15am-9.30am) -Shows all real-time stock market movers before market opens gainers and losers
Gainers & Losers (9.00am-4pm) - Shows Gainers and Losers from market opens til market close
Unusual Volume starts at 9.50am - Shows all stocks with unusual activity or volume.
Afterhours(4.15pm-8pm) - Shows all real-time stock market movers after market close gainers and losers with fresh news

bluejetty:00082382:ios.summary: Welcome to Creative Art – a revolutionary Creative Art game that promises an unparalleled aesthetic journey. This innovative game merges the tranquility of coloring with the challenge of jigsaw puzzles, designed to help you unwind and enjoy
bluejetty:00082382:ios.description:
Welcome to Creative Art – a revolutionary Creative Art game that promises an unparalleled aesthetic journey. This innovative game merges the tranquility of coloring with the challenge of jigsaw puzzles, designed to help you unwind and enjoy the immersive experience of creating stunning picture puzzles. Delve into the serene landscapes and enchanting imagery of Creative Art, where every puzzle piece brings a new story to life. Enjoy this unique blend of art and puzzle games for free!
In Creative Art, you'll discover a world filled with captivating hidden images that come to life as you piece together the jigsaw puzzle. This game reimagines traditional jigsaw puzzles, offering a soothing escape for those in need of relaxation. Each puzzle is crafted to be both calming and visually breathtaking, transforming the conventional jigsaw puzzle into an artful experience.
Creative Art is more than just a puzzle game; it’s a tranquil retreat. Once you start playing this mesmerizing game, you'll find it hard to stop. Say goodbye to stress and boredom as you engage with the countless pictures waiting for you to color and assemble. Each painting is meticulously designed to be aesthetically pleasing and conceptually ingenious, providing a perfect blend of relaxation and challenge.
If you love playing relaxing and stress-relief jigsaw puzzles, Creative Art is the game for you! In this game, you’ll need to find the perfect spot for each jigsaw piece. As you complete the puzzles, you’ll bring beautiful scenes to life and enjoy the satisfaction of finishing each artwork.
Our anti-stress puzzles feature a wide array of captivating stories. Every jigsaw picture is uniquely crafted for this art game, offering multilayered artworks from various artists. These hand-drawn pictures, each with their own original style and technique, make Creative Art a truly distinctive and engaging experience.
Creative Art provides an opportunity to take a break and enliven your daily routine with its original jigsaw puzzles. The game might seem simple at first glance, but some pieces are cleverly hidden, adding an extra layer of challenge. The intuitive yet challenging tile-matching mechanic enhances your gaming experience, making these free art games even more intriguing. Enjoy jigsaw puzzles anytime and anywhere with Creative Art!
Discover the magic of Creative Art with these exciting features:
* Enjoy peaceful jigsaw puzzle games with a unique gaming experience.
* Experience the perfect fusion of art coloring and jigsaw puzzles.
* Solve free jigsaw puzzles, complete Daily Challenges, and earn unique trophies.
* Participate in seasonal events, tackle challenging puzzles, and receive exclusive animated postcards.
* Explore anti-stress puzzles featuring fascinating hand-drawn art from various artists, each with their unique styles and techniques.
* Watch stunning pictures come to life as you complete these calming jigsaw puzzles.
* Use helpful hints to guide you when you get stuck on a puzzle.
Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Creative Art and experience the visual magic of color jigsaw puzzles. Relax and enjoy this captivating blend of art and puzzle gaming. Dive into the serene and artistic universe of Creative Art today!

bluejetty:00024560:ios.description:
Blood Sugar & Diabetes Tracker: Your Comprehensive Health Management Solution
Take control of your health with the Blood Sugar & Diabetes Tracker app, designed to make tracking and managing your health simple, efficient, and accessible. Whether you’re monitoring blood sugar levels, medications, A1C, or weight, this app provides the tools you need for better diabetes management and overall health tracking.
Supporting both mg/dL (American system) and mmol/L (British system), our app ensures global compatibility for your blood sugar log conversions.
Core Features
* Blood Sugar Tracking: Record and analyze your daily and monthly blood sugar levels.
* Medication Tracker: Manage and log your medications using a user-friendly medication library.
* A1C Tracker: Monitor your A1C levels for long-term diabetes management.
* Weight Tracker: Keep track of your weight and analyze trends for better health.
* Detailed Reports: Generate easy-to-read reports to share with your doctor or monitor your progress.
* Reminders for Logs: Stay consistent with your health tracking using custom reminders. 
* Notification Popups: Get timely alerts to ensure you never miss important updates or logs.
* Dark Mode Support: Reduce eye strain with our sleek and stylish dark mode.
* View & Generate Reports Instantly: Generate and view detailed health reports with ease.
Why Choose Blood Sugar & Diabetes Tracker?
Our app is designed for anyone looking to stay on top of their health. Whether you’re tracking your progress, managing medications, or aiming to improve your A1C and weight, we’ve got you covered.
Download the Blood Sugar & Diabetes Tracker app today and start your journey toward better health and smarter diabetes management!
Disclaimer: Blood Sugar & Diabetes Tracker gives healthy lifestyle recommendations based on your blood sugar track record and data about your habits. It is not a substitute for healthcare professionals and does not provide medical advice. Reminding users to seek a doctor’s advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions. you must follow your doctor's advice
Privacy Policy : https://crosscode.dev/blood-sugar-diabetes-tracker-privacy-policy/
Term & Condition : https://crosscode.dev/blood-sugar-diabetes-tracker-terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00090905:ios.name: NEXIT
bluejetty:00090905:ios.summary:
Discover a new way to explore, plan routes, and navigate with an all-in-one revolutionary app for exploration and driving worldwide!
All navigation apps tell you where to drive, but only Nexit tells you where to stop. Nexit is an intuitive
bluejetty:00090905:ios.description:
Discover a new way to explore, plan routes, and navigate with an all-in-one revolutionary app for exploration and driving worldwide!
All navigation apps tell you where to drive, but only Nexit tells you where to stop. Nexit is an intuitive road-trip app that predicts where you’re going and shows you what lies ahead. 
Find places, businesses, and deals to see what’s coming up, or search using multiple parameters. Nexit is the driving copilot you’ve always wanted, right on your phone.
The smartest map you’ll ever use:
- Find the perfect route with Nexit’s high-powered AI.
- Find everything you need along your route - no need to go out of your way
- Save money and find the best deals along your route or around you.
- Fully customize your journey and search for any stop you want
- Nexit’s innovative Travmatch feature changes the navigation game. If the parents want a steakhouse, the kids want ice cream, or you need to visit a pharmacy, the high-tech Travmatch will find them all along your route.
- Apply search filters like ‘vegan’ and ‘pet-friendly’ so everyone in your car can be included
- Revolutionize the way you travel and find free Wi-Fi, clean restrooms, and even brands near you in your city with Nexit’s Explore Mode
The app that revolutionized highway navigation has also transformed city exploration. With Explore Mode, you can now navigate on foot and easily locate nearby amenities. Search for multiple results at once by brand and amenity. Need an ATM, a supermarket, and a specific restaurant? Nexit will find them nearby!
Whether you’re driving, riding, or exploring, Nexit makes it easy to find the best places with the best deals to visit, whenever and wherever you want.

Introducing the ultimate Seashell Identifier App, designed for nature enthusiasts and collectors alike. This app allows users to easily identify various seashell species by simply taking a photo. With its vast database, it can quickly recognize a wide range of shells, providing users with detailed information about each species.
Simply open the app, take a photo or upload an image of your favorite seashell, and the app will return all the relevant information and images related to the seashell you're interested in
Key Features:
Seashell Identification
Take a photo or upload an image for the app to identify the seashell. It will provide all the relevant information and images about the seashell you're interested in.
Create Your Own Seashell Collection 
Our app helps you build a personalized collection of your favorite seashells. You can customize your collection by adding, editing, or removing shells. After identifying a seashell, you can easily save the details into your collection.
Create Wallpapers
The app offers a variety of beautiful pre-set wallpapers, and you can also save images of the seashells you're interested in to set up your own personalized wallpaper.

- Driver’s License Release option allows noncustodial parents to submit Deferral Forms MRA, MRD, MRC, and MRE.

- Payment History option allows users to view payments made in the last 12 months.
- Scheduled Appointments allows users to view case related appointments.
- Frequently Asked Questions provides users to access general information about the DCSS program
- Notifications and Alerts allow users to receive valuable information about their case.

bluejetty:00074608:ios.name: Remoter Pro (VNC, SSH & RDP)
bluejetty:00074608:ios.summary: Remoter Pro is the complete Remoter remote access toolkit for iPhone and iPad, with VNC, RDP, SSH, Telnet, RemoterFusion, tunneling, audio streaming, and password management included. On iPhone Duo, use two remote sessions side by side on t
bluejetty:00074608:ios.description:
Remoter Pro is the complete Remoter remote access toolkit for iPhone and iPad, with VNC, RDP, SSH, Telnet, RemoterFusion, tunneling, audio streaming, and password management included. On iPhone Duo, use two remote sessions side by side on the inner display and keep them in place when folding and unfolding.
Connect to Mac, Windows, Linux, and terminal servers from one app. Use your local network, VPN, SSH tunnels, RD Gateway, or RemoterFusion depending on how your computers are set up. Remoter Pro is built for people who manage multiple machines and want every major Remoter connection option in a single purchase.
Complete Pro Edition
• VNC, RDP, SSH, Telnet, and RemoterFusion included
• iPhone Duo support: use two remote sessions side by side on the inner display
• Password Manager for reusable server credentials
• Multiple simultaneous connections
• Advanced URL invocation support
• Network computer discovery with Bonjour and NetBIOS
• Wake-on-LAN support
• Saved server cards with custom ordering
• Fullscreen mode, portrait and landscape orientations, fit width, fit height, and 1:1 zoom
• 8bpp, 16bpp, and 32bpp color depth support
VNC and Screen Sharing
• VNC protocol 3.8 support
• Compatible with macOS Screen Sharing, UltraVNC for Windows, and common Linux VNC servers
• RemoterFusion support for easier Mac setup, sound/music redirection, and connections without port forwarding or dynamic DNS
• UltraVNC MS Login authentication
• Server-side scaling and multiple monitor support
• Send Clipboard: copy text from your device to the remote computer, then paste it there
RDP and Windows Remote Desktop
• Windows Remote Desktop connections
• Remote Desktop Gateway support
• Network Level Authentication (NLA) support
• RDP over SSH
• Clipboard paste, plus remote copy when supported by the server or RemoterFusion
• Font smoothing
SSH and Telnet
• SSH and Telnet terminal sessions
• VNC over SSH and RDP over SSH
• Custom SSH port tunnels
• Public-key authentication
• SSH key management for generating, importing, copying, and using keys
• Record and run macros
Input and Control
• Precise virtual trackpad with right-click, dragging, and scrolling
• Hardware mouse, trackpad, and external keyboard support
• Apple Pencil-aware pointer input
• Pinch to zoom and drag to scroll
• Special keys including Esc, Tab, Alt, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, F1-F12, Control-Alt-Delete, Command, and Windows key
• International keyboard mappings for German, Swiss-German, Russian, French, Danish, and Spanish
Remoter Pro is localized in English, German, Spanish, Italian, Norwegian, Czech, and Slovak.
Support: support@remoterlabs.com

bluejetty:00014790:ios.description:
Professionally prepared income taxes done for you. Taxfyle assesses your tax position to automatically match you to a credentialed tax professional specializing in your tax position within seconds.
Most people find tax filing time consuming, overly complicated and/or expensive. Taxfyle is here to remedy these problems. The tax app allows you to upload documents via photos and the cloud. From there your tax pro will take care of the rest and in app message you if there are any questions. 
With Taxfyle you can also confidently file your taxes knowing that your information is secure. Our in app messaging and data sharing is encrypted at rest and in transit. Also, we will never share your information without your consent.
Taxfyle only works with credentialed tax professionals to file your taxes. These are people like enrolled IRS agents (EA) or licensed certified public accountants (CPA). The average tax pro on Taxfyle has 14 years of experience so you can rest assured that you’re receiving the highest quality tax service. 
How about after tax season? After tax season you’ll have access to all your documents year round. Applying for a mortgage? No worries, open up the app and email your tax return directly from the Taxfyle app. No more requesting and paying for previous year tax returns. At Taxfyle we also believe in free tax advice, so if you ever have a question just log in, click the help button and chat away 24/7. We’ll make sure to help you out. 
Don’t take our word for it:
“Taxfyle is designed to be dead simple”
- Business Insider
“In just a minute, you can be connected to your own accountant”
- Macworld
“The secure tax filing app for millennials”
- Yahoo Finance
“Built to make your tax filing process easier”
- Fiverr
Taxfyle now prepares all business forms: Corporate (C Corp) Form1120, S Corporation (S Corp) Form 1120S, Partnership (LLP or LP or GP) Form 1065, Non-Profit Corporation (Form 990)
We’ve also added some more personal forms: non-resident alien (Form 1040-NR), expatriate or expat or someone living abroad.
Taxfyle is designed with you in mind. If you meet one of the criteria, Taxfyle is here to save you time and headache:
- Own a home
- Independent contractor / freelancer / business owner / Uber driver / Airbnb host / courier
- Own rental property or receive rent income
- Receive a K-1
- Sold stocks or investments
- Received dividends
- Own a foreign bank account or investment
If you own a business, you may want to use Taxfyle if you meet one of the criteria:
- If your business is an LLC, Sole proprietor, Corporation, Partnership, S Corporation, Not-for-profit
- Revenue is between $0 - $20M
- Make a profit or loss
- Maintain inventory
- Sales of business or capital assets
- You have partners or shareholders and you make a distribution or contribution
- You have a foreign parent or investors, or your business is an owner in a foreign company or partnership
- Engaged in rental real estate
- Use accounting software (Quickbooks, Xero, Shoeboxed, Expensify, Mint) to track your books (bookkeeping / record keeping). Or use excel to track income expenses.
- May qualify for tax credits
