bluejetty:00185142:ios.name: Sony TV Screen Mirroring Cast
bluejetty:00185142:ios.summary:
Enjoy anything on the big screen without any hassle. Just wirelessly connect your phone or tablet to your Sony TV. Finally, you can get rid of those annoying and unsafe cables. You don't need expensive hardware either.
In less than 5 minut
bluejetty:00185142:ios.description:
Enjoy anything on the big screen without any hassle. Just wirelessly connect your phone or tablet to your Sony TV. Finally, you can get rid of those annoying and unsafe cables. You don't need expensive hardware either.
In less than 5 minutes you can make your life easier and more comfortable. Get this app and screen mirror, cast or stream anything to your TV from your iOS device. 
This works on any Sony Smart TV from the 2012 models onward. 
In using the app, there will be a couple of seconds of latency (usually between 1 and 3). So this mirroring is not suitable for gaming. 
Enjoy series, movies, sport, live streams, breaking news or web videos. In big size of course! 
How the app works:
1. Make sure that your iPhone or iPad is connected to the same local network as your Sony TV. Don't use multiple VLANs, a VPN or subnets.
2. Launch the Mirror for Sony TV app. It will start looking for your Sony TV(s) on your local network. When a TV is found, please select it. When you use this app for the first time, depending on your model Sony TV, the TV might ask you to "allow" the connection. In that case, take your TV Remote Control and press OK to allow the connection from your TV to your iPhone or iPad.
3. Turn on notifications for this app. We will not spam you, but we will use this to let you know if your TV is working correctly or not. So please, please allow it, otherwise when things don't work as they should, you are left in the dark.
4. Click on Start Mirroring to start mirroring on the TV that is currently selected. After that, you can just go to any other app on your iPhone or iPad and the mirroring just continues to run.
5. To stop mirroring, there are two options. (1) click on the red top bar that you will see on your iPhone or iPad. (2) Go to the Mirror for Sony TV app and click on Stop Mirroring.
Limitations and known issues:
DRM
Some apps block Screen Mirroring. This means that application developers can choose themselves if they want to block Screen Mirroring. For instance, Netflix, Disney and AppleTV+ have decided to block this.
There is a simple test that you can do to see if the app that you want to mirror has blocked Screen Mirroring:
Open that particular app and slide up Control Center on your iPhone/iPad. Then, click on Screen Recording and start recording the screen to your Camera Roll. Watch the app that you want to mirror and at some point stop the screen recording. Then go to your Photos app and watch the video that was recorded. If the recorded video shows the app you want to mirror, it works fine. If the video is empty, then the app you want to mirror does not allow Screen Mirroring.
You can purchase the Mirror for Sony TV Pro Version through an in app purchase.
The Pro Version has the following features:
1. Adds audio to the screen mirroring
2. Provides for free lifetime updates of the app
3. Gives the option to choose higher screen resolutions.
* Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
* Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
* Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
* Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00096441:ios.description:
Your whole GLP-1 treatment in one app: injections, dose, side effects, weight, food, and progress.
OzemPro is the digital journal for people on GLP-1 medication. Every day and every week logged, organized, and ready to review or bring to your doctor.
WHO IT'S FOR
For anyone on Ozempic®, Wegovy®, Mounjaro®, Zepbound®, Saxenda®, Trulicity®, Rybelsus®, semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide, dulaglutide, or any other GLP-1 medication — by pen, by vial and syringe, or in tablet form. Compounded and generic versions included.
Stop keeping your treatment in notes, screenshots, and memory.
KEY FEATURES
• Injections and pens: day, dose, injection site and rotation, with a full weekly history
• Injection reminders: never miss your weekly dose
• My stock: how many doses are left in the pen you're using, with a low-stock alert
• Dose calculator: for vials and syringes, how many units to draw for your dose, with a table to save and share
• Medication level: your estimated concentration through the week, up to the next dose
• Side effects and bowel tracking: nausea, constipation, reflux, bowel movements, and more, with educational guidance on what usually helps
• Weight, BMI, and smart scale: upload a scale screenshot and the app reads body fat, muscle, water and more
• Goal projection: how much is left and when you'll get there, at your current pace
• Plateau check-in: if your weight stalls, see what your logs show and build a 4-week plan
• Personalized plan: calorie, macro, weight, and water goals based on your profile
• Meals by photo, voice, or text: calories, protein, carbs, fat, and fiber
• Meal plan: meals calculated for your goals, with options to swap any dish
• Recipes: step-by-step for every dish in your meal plan
• Supplements and vitamins: a daily checklist of what you take alongside your medication, with reminders
• Water and daily steps
• Intermittent fasting: track your fast, with an alert when you hit your goal
• Journey card: progress photos, measurements, and milestones, with ready-made cards to share on Stories and WhatsApp
• Community: public or invite-only groups, posts, comments, leaderboards, and health news
• AI chat and voice: ask about your treatment routine, with the sources behind every answer
• Widgets and Live Activity: check off today's dose and supplements, see your medication level, log side effects in one tap, and follow your progress
• Apple Health: syncs movement and activity data
• PDF report: bring your complete treatment history to your appointment
NON-AFFILIATION NOTICE
OzemPro is an independent app, not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Novo Nordisk, Eli Lilly, or any pharmaceutical company. Ozempic, Wegovy, Saxenda, and Rybelsus are registered trademarks of Novo Nordisk A/S; Mounjaro, Zepbound, and Trulicity of Eli Lilly and Company. All trademarks belong to their respective owners and appear only as examples of GLP-1 medications, for informational purposes.
IMPORTANT NOTICE
OzemPro is a tracking and educational support tool. It does not provide diagnosis, prescription, medical advice, or treatment, and it is not a substitute for guidance from your healthcare provider. The dose calculator converts volume from the values you enter: it does not set or recommend a dose. Always consult your doctor before any decision about your GLP-1 treatment.
SUBSCRIPTION
Full access requires a monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription. There is no free version with full access to features. Prices are shown in the app before you confirm. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.
Privacy Policy: https://www.ozempro.com/en/politica-de-privacidade
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
OzemPro Terms of Service: https://www.ozempro.com/en/termos-de-uso

bluejetty:00172268:ios.description:
"Naturespace might actually sound more like nature than nature itself. The app recreates thunderstorms, oceans, fields, streams and other wildlife; you practically feel the rain on your shoulders. As a writer who spends an embarrassingly large amount of time indoors, I was impressed by how immersive this particular app was; the sound quality is so stellar that you actually feel like you’re outside." -VICE Magazine
“While the whole idea of these apps and tools is immersion, if you’re really committed to going deep, go Naturespace. You hear the birds in the trees above you as well as what’s before and behind you. This is some of the best sound quality out there..” -**TIME**
Rain. Falling on the leaves three feet above your head. You can hear each individual drop. A soft wind moves through the forest canopy... it's coming from behind you, traveling forward and to your right. Thunder rumbles in the distance, then cracks directly overhead. A bird lands in the pine tree to your left. You can tell exactly which branch.
You are not listening to nature. You are becoming it. Returning to it. It's at that moment when you realize: the most relaxing "sound" isn't a sound at all, it's the vast, open space where natural sounds occur that inherently brings calm.
It is this idea, to capture space accurately, exactly the way the ear hears it, to recreate sound in all dimensions, that has been our vision for over 20 years. 
Welcome to Naturespace.
The Ultimate Non-Verbal Meditation companion and audiobook enhancer: Naturespace plays seamlessly in the background with an independent volume so you can add immersive nature to any spoken word program and actually put you in the scene.
**20 YEARS. 170+ RECORDINGS. ZERO COMPROMISES.**
Two decades hiking into thunderstorms, recording forest fires, capturing waterfalls in Iceland at 4am. No AI. No stock libraries. No corporate playlist algorithms.
Every track is a real place, recorded in real time, engineered for the way humans actually hear. Perfect with AirPods Pro, and transcendent with any headphones.
**YOU ARE THE STORM. THE MEADOW. THE SHORELINE.** No longer confined to a room, you become vast.
- You're lying in tall grass as crickets pulse in waves around you
- You're standing at the ocean's edge as waves crash at your feet and retreat
- You're on a covered porch as a thunderstorm rolls in from the west
- You're beneath towering aspens as wind moves through the canopy 80 feet overhead
- You're drifting down a mountain river, water rushing past both ears
Not listening to nature. Being there. And recognizing it as home.
**OWN IT. DON'T RENT IT.**

**YOU ARE THE STORM. THE MEADOW. THE SHORELINE.** No longer confined to a room, you become vast.

bluejetty:00087761:ios.description:
المؤذن الالكتروني رفيق المسلم كي تحافظ علي صلاتك
مع تطبيق المؤذن الالكتروني الذي يقدم لك الآذان ومواقيت الصلاة بكامل الدقة على حسب موقعك الحالي فيطلب من المستخدم الوصول الي موقعك في بداية التطبيق 
، التنبية بأجمل أصوات الآذان في أوقات الصلاة في شاشة الاذان وهو يشمل كل ما يحتاجه المسلم لأداء العبادات اليومية.
يستخدم المؤذن الإلكتروني خدمة موقعك وموقعك عند بدء تشغيل التطبيق لأول مرة فقط لإظهار و حساب أوقات الصلاة بشكل صحيح لموقعك.
عن طريق تحديد الموقع يقوم التطبيق بحساب اوقات الصلاة الخاصة بموقعك و هذه المعلومات تستخدم داخل التطبيق فقط ولا يتم جمعها او مشاركتها مع اي شي.
خصائص ومميزات التطبيق :
- (مواقيت الصلاة) تظهر بالشاشة الرئيسة بشكل ساعة المسجد الالكترونية
-(شاشة الاذان) تعرض الاذان عند حلول وقت الصلاة
- (إتجاة القبلة) تحديد اتجاه القبلة .
- (الاذكار اليومية) التي يحتاجها المسلم في جميع أوقاته.
- (التقويم الهجري والميلادي) في مكان واحد للتسهيل على المستخدم.
- (إمساكية شهر رمضان الكريم) مع منبه وقت الإفطار والسحور.
- (رفيق المسلم) الصباح والمساء واذكار بعد الصلاة والاذكار الموقوتة التي وردت في الكتاب والسنة.
- (خاتم القرآن) يُعينك على ختم القرآن بطرق فعالة ومحفزة.
- (لغات متعددة) يدعمها التطبيق حتى يصل لكل مسلم فساهم بنشره.

bluejetty:00079701:ios.description:
Feel anxious or overwhelmed? Draw it out — and feel better in 15 minutes.
LINA is the #1 art therapy app for anxiety and stress relief. Guided drawing sessions, AI insights into your art, and no skills needed.
Compatible with iPhone, iPad, and Apple Pencil.
SCIENCE-BASED ART THERAPY ACTIVITIES
In just 15 minutes, you’ll:
• draw
• reflect
• receive insights and gentle recommendations based on your artwork
These practices help you:
– calm anxiety and emotional overload
– build self-love and inner safety
– strengthen self-esteem
– soften the inner critic
– reconnect with inner strength and support
– develop mindfulness and self-awareness
– release negative thought patterns
FREE CANVAS
A space with no rules.
Draw whatever feels right.
Express what words can’t.
Use suggested drawing prompts to inspire your art.
REFLECTION ORACLE CARDS
Ask a question.
Pull a card.
Receive symbolic wisdom that helps you see the truth you already carry inside.
Associative oracle cards are widely used in art therapy as a gentle tool for insight, emotional clarity, and subconscious exploration — especially when you feel stuck or overwhelmed.
A CREATIVE ALTERNATIVE TO TALK THERAPY
Art therapy works by gently bypassing the rational, overthinking mind and engaging the part of you that already knows how you feel.
When you draw, your nervous system naturally slows down.
Your attention moves from thoughts to sensation.
The inner noise softens.
This is why simple drawing can feel like silence, meditation, or a deep exhale.
On a psychological level, art therapy activates areas of the brain linked to emotional regulation, self-awareness, and integration.
On a human level, it feels like coming back home to yourself.
Drawing becomes a creative ritual — a quiet moment where you reconnect with your inner world, your intuition, and your sense of meaning.
A space where your true self can speak without worlds.
Download LINA today and experience a softer, deeper way to care for your mental well-being.

bluejetty:00072169:ios.description:
Welcome to Celestis, a breathtaking city of floating islands, friendly talking animals, tons of natural beauty, scenic vistas, and curious local characters. Unfortunately, your visit comes at a time when the local attractions also include a devastating curse, cluster earthquakes, and a massive, destructive serpent! Your arrival, of course, was somewhat mysterious itself, and you may find that much about this world feels oddly familiar, but you’ll surely catch on quickly with the helpful fox as your guide!
After all, it’s up to you to unravel a great mystery and save the city in the sky in this all-new Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!
TRY THE FREE TRIAL VERSION, AND THEN UNLOCK THE COMPLETE ADVENTURE IN THE GAME!
Bridge to Another World: Clouds includes:
• Face the oppressive Administrators as Victor and fight to end the Celestis curse at last!
• Never get lost with the strategy guide!
• Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games.
• Collect special characters and morphing objects throughout the game! 
• Enjoy concept art, screensavers, and music from the game!
Discover more from Friendly Fox Studio:

Privacy Policy: https://friendlyfox.studio/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00041857:ios.name: Paradise Paws: Merge Animals
bluejetty:00041857:ios.summary:
Save every animal in Paradise Paws — A Merge Adventure!
Prepare to inherit a once thriving Animal Sanctuary. This merge game wants you to find and discover all the secrets of the island, and figure out who left this place to you. Restore
bluejetty:00041857:ios.description:
Save every animal in Paradise Paws — A Merge Adventure!
Prepare to inherit a once thriving Animal Sanctuary. This merge game wants you to find and discover all the secrets of the island, and figure out who left this place to you. Restore the grounds of the Sanctuary and care for and save all of the endangered animals. Push back on the greed of corporate developers and preserve the land for your furry and four legged friends. Only you and your BFF Lizzy can save the animals and this beloved sanctuary.
Put a stop to those evil real estate developers and create a thriving home for all of your adorable new friends!
YOU WILL…
Merge Everything: Combine plants, land animals, sea creatures and treasures to make new discoveries! Rescue and nurture a variety of adorable creatures! Be sure to feed the babies so they can grow!
Restore the Sanctuary: Unlock new areas and clear the destruction from the Hurricane! Solve challenging merge puzzles to restore animal habitats and unlock new areas!
Rescue Endangered Animals: Hatch eggs, care for young creatures, and help the sanctuary flourish. The animals need your help to thrive!
MERGE and MATCH to Save the Animals!
MERGE to match three or more items (Bigger merges, better rewards!) and evolve them into more valuable resources or creatures!
Feed and care for the animals to help them grow, and they will help care for the Sanctuary, harvesting essential resources for you to merge and use as you rebuild the Sanctuary!!
EXPLORE and RESTORE the Animal Sanctuary!
Discover new areas in the sanctuary filled with creatures, rare treasures, and hidden secrets. Every new merge brings you closer to restoring the sanctuary!
Evolve animals and plants to uncover new species and habitats. Your merging skills will help save the animals and the Sanctuary!
TAKE ON QUESTS to Unlock Rare Creatures!
DECORATE and Customize Your Sanctuary!
Use your creativity to design and organize your sanctuary layout. Be sure to leave some balls near the area where your Zebras sun themselves as they enjoy being playful too!.
Help the animals rebuild their habitats by merging items to restore their homes!
Adventure awaits and the animals are depending on you!
Download Paradise Paws now and start saving the creatures today – a fun, puzzle-filled adventure from the makers who brought joy to millions of players worldwide!

TEPPEN, which has been in operation since 2019, will end its service on March 30, 2026 at 20:00 (PT).
will end its service on March 31, 2026 at 3:00 (UTC).

There’s only one way to Rise to the Top – playing TEPPEN!
TEPPEN is the Ultimate Card Battle game where units you command operate in real time, featuring dynamic action with over-the-top attacks blowing up your screen.
With astonishing graphics and a cutting-edge battle system, TEPPEN is the card game to end all other card games!
Create your dream showdown!
Use popular characters from the Monster Hunter, Devil May Cry, Street Fighter, Resident Evil, Mega Man X, Mega Man Battle Network, Mega Man Zero, Darkstalkers, Ōkami, Sengoku BASARA, Strider, Ace Attorney, Dead Rising, Breath of Fire series, Red Earth series, Onimusha series, Ghosts 'n Goblins series, DINO CRISIS series, Cannon Spike series, Bionic Commando series, Cyberbots series, Lost Planet series, Rival Schools series, and Dragon's Dogma series in a cool way!
------------------------
◆Game Introduction◆
------------------------
◆Story
Eight iconic Capcom Heroes have been bound by fate, and must battle through the Land of Illusion to find the truth. Journey with them across an inventive story mode that seamlessly melds Capcom’s universes.
◆Game Modes
Hero Stories, where you can enjoy each character (Hero)’s tale.
Adventure, where you explore maps and challenge bosses.
Ranked Matches (Versus), where rankings are updated each month.
Grand Prix (Versus), where you can participate in limited-time elimination battles
...and so much more!
◆Battle System
With TEPPEN’s quick-paced battles, you could take part in the fight for your life wherever you are, whenever you want, and not miss a beat.
Get hooked on killer card action as you expertly wield Heroes, Unit Cards, and Action Cards!
◆Battles
Overwhelm your opponent with Hero Arts (Special Moves) and gain control of the battlefield in epic real-time battles!
Take advantage of Active Response (turn-based battles) and keep your opponent on their toes!
------------------------
◆Game Highlights◆
------------------------
◆Dream Teams
Battle with your favorite Heroes from a variety of legendary game series!
◆Quantity AND Quality
Not only are many of your favorite Heroes here, they all look amazing with eye-catching artwork and gorgeous animation!
◆Game Series and Heroes
Street Fighter Series: Ryu, Chun-Li, Akuma
Monster Hunter Series: Rathalos, Nergigante, Felyne
Mega Man X Series: X, Zero
Darkstalkers Series: Morrigan Aensland
Devil May Cry Series: Dante, Nero
Resident Evil Series: Albert Wesker, Jill Valentine, Ada Wong
Ōkami Series: Amaterasu
Sengoku BASARA Series: Oichi
Strider Series
Ace Attorney Series
Dead Rising Series
Breath of Fire Series
Red Earth Series
Onimusha Series
Ghosts 'n Goblins Series
DINO CRISIS Series
Cannon Spike Series
Bionic Commando Series
Mega Man Battle Network Series
Mega Man Zero Series
Cyberbots Series
Lost Planet Series
Rival Schools Series
Dragon's Dogma Series
◆A Captivating World
Experience a world interlacing multiple titles in Hero Stories, and then go on a journey with characters from those stories in Adventure!
◆Take on the World
Once you're ready, contend with other players around the world in Ranked Matches and vie for dominance!
Price
App: Free
Note: Some in-game items will require purchase. An internet connection is required to play. Data rates may apply.

bluejetty:00165006:ios.description:
Built by an Apple award-winning team, GlassPass is the only marketplace built for glass art. With a community of 200,000, we're the most active platform of glass art enthusiasts. All transactions on GP are protected & secured, for both buyers & sellers, with our proprietary escrow process.
GlassPass is the hub for all things related to the art of glassblowing. We connect glass enthusiasts & collectors, galleries & shops, and glassblowers & makers. Discover new artists, learn about the latest news in glass, attend community events, explore the culture, and more! 
Buyers AND Sellers are protected when using GlassPass's built-in payment system. Pay with any credit or debit card, or ACH/wire transfers, with more options coming. Get paid out via our automated wallet system with Cashapp, Venmo, Zelle/ACH, PayPal, Bank Transfers, even gift cards – we do it all. 
We're made by the community, for the community. 
Why GlassPass?
• The largest & most trusted glass marketplace since 2017
• Pay with any credit or debit card, Apple Pay, ACH/wire transfers, & more coming soon
• Automated Payouts: Get paid directly to your wallet & cash out any time via popular payment apps 
• Binding Offers & Bids: Guaranteed purchases for Buyers & Faster sales for Sellers
• Earn Trusted Seller status after 10 sales to get paid out faster, a badge, & discounts
• In-App Advertising Center for promoting posts
• Buyer & seller protection via in-app payment processing
• Advanced Auction Platform built specifically for glass art
• Most active community of buyers & sellers
• Make offers or set a Buy It Now Price to get the best deals 
• Create custom feeds to only see what you choose
• Follow your favorite artists, friends, and shops
• Learn about the latest news, techniques, and more in the glass art community
• Fastest and easiest way to both buy & sell glass art
• Post your glass art collection to show off your gems that aren’t for sale
Never worry about being scammed again!

bluejetty:00143713:ios.name: 우리카드 우리WON카드
bluejetty:00143713:ios.summary:

[새로운 기능] 
- 우리카드 스마트앱이 더욱 다양한 기능을 담아 우리WON카드 앱으로 업그레이드 되었습니다.
- 홈페이지/모바일앱/모바일웹에서 동일한 경험이 가능하도록 구성하였습니다.
- 모든 페이지마다 하단에 연관/주요 서비스를 위치하여 고객의 접근 가능성을 향상하였습니다.
- 자동로그인, SSO(Single Sign On) 등 특화
bluejetty:00143713:ios.description:
하나하나의 작은 변화들로 새로워진, FULL 디지털서비스 우리WON카드 앱을 만나보세요~
[새로운 기능] 
- 우리카드 스마트앱이 더욱 다양한 기능을 담아 우리WON카드 앱으로 업그레이드 되었습니다.
- 홈페이지/모바일앱/모바일웹에서 동일한 경험이 가능하도록 구성하였습니다.
- 모든 페이지마다 하단에 연관/주요 서비스를 위치하여 고객의 접근 가능성을 향상하였습니다.
- 자동로그인, SSO(Single Sign On) 등 특화 기능을 통해 이용 편의를 제고하였습니다.
 ※ 우리WON카드로 앱이 리뉴얼 되어 간편 비밀번호, 생체인증, 공동인증서 등의 재설정이 필요합니다.
[서비스 소개]
1) MY
- 결제예상금액(이용대금명세서), 이용한도, 보유카드조회, 최근이용내역 등 주요 카드이용정보를 확인할 수 있습니다.
2) 카드
- 카드신청시 주요정보 자동입력 및 중간저장 기능을 제공합니다. 
- 빅데이터를 활용하여 고객 맞춤 카드를 추천합니다. 
3) 혜택
- 개인별 맞춤 혜택과 선호 이벤트를 우선적으로 보여줍니다. 
- 당월 고객님이 받은 혜택(할인금액, 무이자할부, 포인트 등)을 한눈에 보여줍니다. 
4) 금융
- 로그인 없이 본인인증만으로 단기/장기카드대출, 리볼빙 등의 금융서비스 신청이 가능합니다. 
- 우리카드 비회원을 위해 카카오페이 인증으로 신용대출 신청이 가능합니다. 
5) 간편로그인 및 SSO 
- 자동로그인, 잠금번호, 지문/Face ID 등 다양한 로그인 방식을 제공합니다. 
- 우리WON카드 앱과 우리WON멤버스/우리WON마켓 간 로그인 연계(Single Sign On)를 제공합니다.
6) 통합검색
- 상황별 검색 목적에 연관성이 높은 검색결과를 우선적으로 나열해줍니다. 
7) 챗봇 
 - 이제 우리카드 ‘DAB’과 텍스트 입력 없이 음성으로 검색/상담이 가능합니다. 
[이용안내]
 - 안전한 서비스 이용을 위해 임의로 구조 변경된 스마트폰에서는 이용하실 수 없습니다. 
 - iOS 버전 14 이상에서 이용 가능합니다.
 ※ iOS 버전 14 미만인 경우 OS업데이트 후 이용 가능 (OS 버전 확인 : 휴대폰 설정 > 일반 > 정보) 
 ※ 우리WON카드 앱 이용시 출처가 불분명하거나 보안설정이 없는 무선랜(Wi-Fi) 사용은 지양하시고, 이동통신망(3G/LTE/5G)을 이용하시기 바랍니다. 3G/LTE/5G망을 이용하여 어플리케이션 다운로드/이용시 데이터 이용료가 발생할 수 있습니다.
[접근권한 안내]
- 우리WON카드 앱을 이용하기 위해 다음 접근 권한 허용이 필요합니다.
가. 필수적 접근권한 
□ 휴대폰 상태
 - 고객응대 및 부정사용 방지, PUSH설정을 위해 사용합니다. 
나. 선택적 접근권한 
□ 카메라 
 - 신분증 및 QR코드 촬영, 페이히어에서 제공하는 비대면 가맹점 신청(사업자등록증 사본촬영 등), 제휴 서비스 제공을 위해 사용합니다.
□ 알림
 - PUSH 메시지 수신을 위해 사용합니다.
□ Face ID
 - 생체인증을 위해 사용합니다. 
□ 마이크
 - 챗봇 음성인식 기능을 위해 사용합니다.
□ 연락처
 - 꿀머니 선물 기능을 위해 사용합니다.
□ 위치
 - 페이히어에서 제공하는 비대면 가맹점 신청(가맹점 주소지 검증)을 위해 사용합니다.
□ 추적(광고ID)
 - 제휴 서비스 제공을 위해 사용합니다.
□ 사진
 - 제휴 서비스 제공을 위해 사용합니다.
※ 접근권한의 동의설정은 ‘설정> 우리카드’에서 변경할 수 있습니다.
※ 선택적 접근권한은 해당 기능 이용을 위해 허용이 필요하며 동의하지 않아도 해당 기능 외 앱 사용이 가능합니다.
※ 아이폰, 아이패드 외 기타 기기에서는 사용에 제한이 있을 수 있습니다. 
※ 이용시 불편 사항은 우리카드 고객센터(1588-9955)로 문의 부탁드립니다. 
앞으로도 오늘의 혁신으로 내일의 가치를 만드는 우리카드가 되도록 노력하겠습니다.

bluejetty:00031314:ios.description:
LoopNet helps investors and tenants find the perfect property or space for their next investment or business. Whether it’s an office with a view, a high-traffic location for a new restaurant, a turn-key multifamily property for investment portfolios or land for new development, we have you covered. 
Our intuitive search helps you get to the information that matters most and allows you to get an in-depth look at prospective properties or spaces through property and neighborhood videos, high-def photos, and listing details and financials.You can search properties or spaces, track your favorites, quickly contact the broker, and set up alerts for new properties as well as get updates on specific properties you are interested in.
LoopNet helps millions of investors and tenants with their commercial real estate search each month.
Key Features: 
• Search hundreds of thousands of commercial real estate properties and spaces for sale and for lease in any neighborhood or at any address in North America. We cover all property types including office, multi-family, retail, industrial, and land.
• Get an in-depth look at available properties including, price, photos, property and neighborhood videos, financials, space available, satellite images, and street view.
• Use the advanced search filters to find the properties that meet your exact needs using specific search criteria and filtering options including price, space use, building or space size, keyword to really zero in on specialty properties
• Stay ahead of the competition with instant listing alerts for your favorite markets or properties. Be the first to know when a new property hits the market or if there are changes to a property you are interested in using the saved search and favorites feature.
• Request additional information or a tour by sending a request to the property broker or by easily sharing with your own broker.
Find your next deal on the go with the LoopNet app! Download today and stay connected!
Feedback? Contact us at apps@LoopNet.com
LoopNet app is available in the U.S, Canada, UK, France, Spain, and Australia.

bluejetty:00187701:ios.name: Panels - Comic Reader
bluejetty:00187701:ios.summary: Improve your comic reading experience with Panels. Enjoy reading your favorite titles in a clean and delightful interface, with plenty of customization and advanced features — fully DRM-free, with first-class support for OPDS, your own libr
bluejetty:00187701:ios.description:
Improve your comic reading experience with Panels. Enjoy reading your favorite titles in a clean and delightful interface, with plenty of customization and advanced features — fully DRM-free, with first-class support for OPDS, your own library, and your own files.
Key features:
- Universal Compatibility: Support for most common comic types: CBR, CBZ, CB7, PDF and comic ePUB (not text eBook). Support for multiple image formats, including WebP.
- Cross-Device Sync: Synchronize your reading progress across iPhone, iPad and Mac and resume reading exactly where you left off.
- Full iCloud Drive support: store your entire library on iCloud and access it from different devices.
- Library Organization: Effortlessly manage your comic library with intuitive tools for easy navigation, custom folder colors, logos and cover images.
* Themes: support for Light and Dark modes, and many others.
* Reading Presets: Choose from a multitude of reading presets or create your own, including horizontal, vertical, or panel-by-panel guided view.
- Right to Left reading (manga): read any comic with Panels.
* OPDS support: Stream, search and download comics from your OPDS compatible server (Komga, Kavita, Codex, Ubooquity and others).
* Secure your content: Keep files locked using a password or Face ID for your collections and files. Use Incognito mode to keep your reading sessions hidden.
* Live Text and Subject detection.
* Experimental Features: Access experimental features like panel-by-panel navigation.
Panels Store — DRM-free comics from independent creators:
- Browse and buy comics directly inside Panels, no extra apps or accounts.
- 100% DRM-free: every purchase is yours to keep, read offline and back up.
- Creators keep 80% of revenue, so your purchases directly support the people making the comics.
- Purchased issues are added to your library and sync across your devices automatically.
Native support for importing files from:
* iCloud Drive
* Dropbox
* Microsoft OneDrive
- Substack
* OPDS: Komga, Kavita, Codex and others
* Local network shared files and folders via SMB and Embedded web server
- iTunes
- External drives
- Airdrop
- Drag&Drop from other apps
Page Filters:
* Reduce Noise
* Increase Sharpness
* Reduce Moiré
* Crop Borders
* Require an active subscription or a one-time purchase.
• You may purchase an Auto-Renewing Subscription to unlock all the premium features while it\'s active; or a one-off purchase to unlock the current major version features forever.
• Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase
• Read our privacy policy and terms of use: https://panels.app/privacy / https://panels.app/terms

bluejetty:00082398:ios.description:
Your health isn’t a single number, statistic or goal. It’s a product of everything in your daily life. And what happens between doctors’ visits is just as important as the care you receive. To help you navigate it all—from the big moments to the spaces in between—we’ve created CareFirst WellBeing℠.
CareFirst WellBeing is a personalized, digital wellness program that puts the power of health in your hands. You’ll find helpful, easy-to-use tools and resources that can help you and your family address every aspect of your well-being, from physical and emotion to social and financial.
Features include:
CloseKnit
Experience simple, convenient, virtual-first care that’s designed to fit your life effortlessly. Get 24/7 support for all your healthcare needs—from allergies to anxiety, urgent care to surgery—all at no extra cost. 
Challenges
Join a challenge and get a little extra motivation to pursue your health goals. 
Personalized Health
Get insights, content and programs tailored to your goals and interests. 
Blue Rewards
Choose healthy activities that fit with your goals and receive financial incentives for completing them.
Trackers 
Connect your wearable devices by Apple’s Health app or enter your own data to monitor sleep, steps, nutrition and more. 
Health Profile 
Get quick access to important data like your biometrics, vaccine history, lab results and medications.

bluejetty:00062276:ios.description:
"Thanks to this useful app, drawing realistic hands can become a whole lot easier" - ImagineFX
"Pencillers, inkers, and colorists should all give this a look!" - Tony Moore, co-creator of The Walking Dead
If you're an artist and ever wanted just quick and easy drawing reference for hands, heads, or even feet (IAP) without having to awkwardly pose your limbs in front of a mirror, this app is for you!
HANDY® is an artist's reference tool, consisting of several rotatable 3D limbs with a variety of poses useful for drawing. You can also customize and edit your own poses for hands, feet, and skulls.
Fully adjustable 3-point lighting means you can get easy lighting reference when using any of the 10+ included 3D head busts. Handy if you’re painting and need to know what shadows the head casts from a certain angle!
Also available is the Animal Skulls pack. With over 10 different animal species, it's great for anatomical reference or creature design inspiration.
[Foot rigs and Animal Skull pack require additional purchase]
NEW in Handy v5: Edit the materials of models! Selectively turn off their textures, adjust their specularity, or tint them a certain color.
Perfect for comic book artists, painters, or just casual sketchers!

bluejetty:00027188:ios.summary: - "I had the pleasure of being able to try this app out and I promise you: it is worth it. The app offers great techniques that you can personalize what you need directly. If you are having anger issues and you genuinely want to change, thi
bluejetty:00027188:ios.description:
- "I had the pleasure of being able to try this app out and I promise you: it is worth it. The app offers great techniques that you can personalize what you need directly. If you are having anger issues and you genuinely want to change, this app will help. It wasn’t long before many of the techniques on the app made their way into my everyday life. Seriously download this."
- "As someone who struggles quite heavily with anger my outburst, this app truly makes a big difference. it has a easy to use and aesthetically pleasing interface. There are a ton of helpful tools, such as logging anger, meditation, calming sounds & music, and so much more. I highly recommend this app to anyone needing help with anger, or calming down in any situation."
Quit Anger is a mental health and self-care app to help manage and control anger. It can be used by anyone who is coping with anger problems, stress, or anxiety. The app encourages users to maintain an anger log, a CBT inspired diary to help individuals dealing with anger. Users can also select from 25+ different tools and exercises like breathing, mindfulness, muscle relaxation, etc. to help relax and calm down.
Key features:
- Anger Log
It is a CBT inspired diary to record the causes and consequences of episodes of anger. Users are encouraged to keep an anger log to record triggers, emotions, body sensations, thoughts, behaviors, and consequences.
- Tools and Exercises
Users can select from 25+ different tools and exercises to help calm down and relax.
Some of the tools are:
Breathing Exercises
Mindfulness and Meditation
Muscle Relaxation
Relaxing Music
Soothing Sounds
Inspiring Quotes
Calming Phrases
Grounding Techniques
Timeout
- Insights
They help you understand and reflect upon the causes of your anger and see your progress over time. You also get to know which tools help you calm down the most.
- Apple Watch and Siri Shortcuts
Quickly access tools on the go with Apple Watch and also create Siri Shortcuts.
- Learn
A variety of short story styled lessons to learn more about anger.
- iCloud Sync & Backup
Always keep your anger logs secured and protected by automatic backup to iCloud and easily sync across multiple devices.
- Widgets support
Easily access all your tools and exercises with widgets.
You can also easily track your personal progress and wellbeing over time, with Insights on the app or by easily adding the Mindful Minutes you spend with Quit Anger to your Apple HealthKit.
QUIT ANGER PLUS
Quit Anger offers an auto-renewing monthly subscription at $1.99, an auto-renewing yearly subscription at $10.99 and a lifetime purchase at $15.99. Monthly plan offers a 3-day free trial and yearly plan offers a 7-day free trial.
This price is in US Dollars (USD). Pricing in other currencies and countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
The subscription automatically renews unless turned off in your iTunes Account at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your iTunes account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.
Read more about our Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy here:
https://miary.app/quitanger/privacy_terms.html
We are always there for you! 
- If you are facing any issues or have questions, please feel free to email us. Hope you enjoy using our app as much as we do! :)

bluejetty:00186487:ios.description:
VisiGrab is your interactive DSA visualizer — the easiest way to master Python coding, Java, and C++ programming through step-by-step visual animations. Whether you're a computer science student preparing for a code study exam, a self-taught developer getting ready for tech interviews, or an experienced programmer brushing up on data structures, VisiGrab makes learning intuitive and engaging.
Why VisiGrab?
The true value of VisiGrab isn’t just the content itself—which you can find online for free—but the way you experience and process it. 
Studying data structures from raw sources often feels like wandering blindly through a dark cave. VisiGrab acts as your guide, taking you by the hand and leading you smoothly along the winding paths into the light. 
It is also the ultimate tool to overcome imposter syndrome. Many talented programmers feel like frauds simply because they lack a formal background in algorithms. VisiGrab cures this anxiety by making core computer science concepts so intuitive that they finally click. 
As a student or developer, you have a choice: waste weeks digging through tons of unstructured tutorials, or build a rock-solid computer science foundation in just a few days. Time is your most valuable resource, and this study app is designed to save it. By delivering content in an adapted, step-by-step sequence, VisiGrab builds a cohesive mental map in your mind, transforming you into a confident engineer.
Comprehensive DSA Coverage
Data Structures:
• Array, Linked List, Doubly Linked List
• Stack, Queue
• Min-Heap
• Hash Table (chaining & open addressing techniques)
• Binary Search Tree (BST) & Trie
• AVL Tree & Red-Black Tree
• B-Tree
• Graph & Graph Constructor (build your own graphs)
Sorting & Operations:
• Bubble, Selection, Insertion, Merge, Heap, Quick Sort
• Pre-order, In-order, Post-order, and Breadth-first traversal (BFS)
• Inserting and deleting nodes in BST, AVL, and Red-Black Trees
• Depth-first search (DFS) & Dijkstra's algorithm (shortest path)
• Bellman-Ford, Prim's, and Kruskal's Minimum Spanning Tree
• Topological Sort & Union-Find
Code Examples in Java, Python, and C++
Every visual DSA animation is accompanied by its implementation code in Java app format, Python coding, and C++. See the direct link between the code and the visual animation — understand not just what the concept does, but how the program makes it happen. Full source code available on GitHub.
Available in 10 Languages
VisiGrab supports English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Polish, Ukrainian, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese (Simplified) — making it accessible to CS students worldwide.
Perfect for Coding Interview Preparation
Preparing for your next technical interview at a top tech company? VisiGrab helps you visualize and understand the DSA topics most commonly asked in coding interviews. Build a strong foundation in data structures and go into your interview with confidence. Ideal for LeetCode practice, competitive programming preparation, and CS exam study.
Gamified Learning Experience
VisiGrab features a gaming-inspired design that makes studying coding fun and motivating. Interactive controls let you step through each node at your own pace, manipulate data in real-time, and see results instantly.
Key Features
• Interactive visual animations for every binary tree, graph, and structure
• Step-by-step execution — pause, rewind, and control the pace
• Code view with Java, Python, and C++ implementations
• Offline access — study app anywhere, no internet required
• Gamified interface that keeps you engaged
• One-time purchase — no subscriptions, no ads, no recurring fees
Learn DSA Anytime, Anywhere
Whether you're commuting, waiting between classes, or studying at home, VisiGrab turns your phone into a powerful code learning study app. No internet connection needed — your complete DSA course is always available offline.
Download VisiGrab today and start mastering data structures visually!

bluejetty:00063484:ios:0.description:
Welcome to Hay Day, the fun farm simulator game! Build a farm, go fishing, raise animals, and explore the Valley. Farm with friends and decorate your own slice of country paradise.
Farming has never been easier! Grow crops like wheat and corn in this farm simulator, and even though it never rains, they never die. Harvest and replant seeds to multiply crops, then make goods to sell. Feed your animals to produce eggs, bacon, dairy, and more to trade with neighbors or fill truck orders for coins. This farming simulator is perfect for players who love animals, farming, and trade!
Grow your farm simulator empire like a true tycoon. Expand with a Bakery, BBQ Grill or Sugar Mill to sell more goods. Build a Sewing Machine and Loom to create cute outfits or a Cake Oven to bake delicious cakes. 
Customize your farm and decorate with a wide variety of items. Build your dream farm step by step, raising animals, farming crops, and designing your land.
Trade and sell items by truck or steamboat. Trade crops, fish, and fresh goods from your animals, and share resources to gain experience and coins. Become a successful farming tycoon with your own Roadside Shop. 
Expand your farming simulator experience and play with friends. Join a neighborhood, or create your own with up to 30 players. Exchange tips and help each other create amazing farms! Play with friends in this farming simulator to build, trade, and fish together.
Hay Day is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money (including random items). If you don't want to purchase game items for real money, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. A network connection is also required.
Hay Day Features:
Peaceful farm simulator
- Farming is easy on this ranch simulator – get plots, grow crops, harvest, repeat!
- Customize your family farm & make your own slice of paradise
- Trade and sell – become a farm tycoon!
Crops to grow & harvest:
- Crops like wheat and corn never die in this farm simulator
- Harvest and replant, or use crops like wheat to make bread
- Trade and sell your crops to be a farming legend!
Raise animals in-game:
- Meet quirky animals!
- Rear chickens, horses, cows, and more
- Pets like puppies, kittens, and bunnies can be added to your farm
Places to visit:
- Fishing Lake: Repair your dock and cast your lure to fish
- Town: Repair the train station and fulfill visitor orders
- Valley: Play with friends in different seasons and events
- Fishing is key to your farming adventure – fish, farming, and trade all in one game.
Play with Friends & Neighbors:
- Trade crops and fresh goods
- Share tips with friends and help them complete trades
- Compete in weekly neighborhood derby events to win rewards!
Download now and build your dream farm in the most fun farming simulator!
Neighbor, are you having problems? 
Visit https://supercell.helpshift.com/a/hay-day/?l=en or contact us in-game by going to Settings > Help and Support. 
Notice of Access Permission:
[Optional permission]
Hay Day may request permission via in-game pop ups to access your camera and send you notifications.
Camera: For in-game scanning of QR codes
Notifications: For sending notifications related to the game
Consent is optional and you can use the app and play the game regardless of whether or not you consent. You may refuse to give consent within the game. However, certain app features may not work properly if you refuse optional access permissions.
The IGRS Rating for this game is 13+.
Privacy Policy:
http://www.supercell.net/privacy-policy/ 
Terms of Service: 
http://www.supercell.net/terms-of-service/ 
Parent's Guide: 
http://www.supercell.net/parents/

bluejetty:00138919:ios.description:
Dive into “Pocket Necro”, a dynamic action-packed RPG game set in a whimsical modern-day fantasy world.
Your mission? To crush the demonic hordes and defend your territory. Choose your skills wisely, summon your loyal minions, and prepare for a humorous yet thrilling adventure!
Game Features:
Crush Demons!
Ready your weapons and strategic skills to face waves of demons. From fiery imps to colossal fiends, each battle is a test of your tactical prowess and determination to protect your realm.
Summon Your Minions:
Assemble a diverse army of minions, each with unique abilities and personalities. From spell-casting mages to sturdy skeletal knights, select your squad and lead them into battle against encroaching evil forces.
Defend Your Castle:
Your mansion isn't just your home; it's your fortress. Ward off the most powerful demons and protect your sanctum from being overrun.
Progress & Choose Your Skills:
Progress through an engaging storyline filled with challenges and rewards. As you advance, choose from a broad range of skills to enhance your strategies and strengthen your minions.
Upgrade Your Arsenal:
Invest in your arsenal and empower your minions with superior weapons and magical artifacts. Each upgrade enhances your team's fighting abilities, crucial for surviving tougher foes.
Explore Various Environments:
Journey through enchanted forests, shadowy caves, and mystical landscapes plagued by demonic entities. Each environment offers unique strategic challenges and hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.
Battle Various Monsters and Demons:
Face a plethora of monstrous creatures and vile demons in epic battles. Learn their weaknesses, devise counterstrategies, and lead your minions to victory in each encounter.
Why Play Pocket Necromancer:
- Engaging RPG elements mixed with strategy and action.
- Hilarious interactions and storyline that keep you entertained.
- Diverse environments that offer new adventures and tactics.
- Continuous updates and improvements based on player feedback.
As darkness threatens your world, only you and your minion army stand in the way of the demonic forces. Download "Pocket Necromancer" now and become the hero you were destined to be!
Embrace the challenge, enjoy the adventure, and crush the demons to protect your mystical abode!

Your mission? To crush the demonic hordes and defend your territory. Choose your skills wisely, summon your loyal minions, and prepare for a humorous yet thrilling adventure!​
​
Game Features:​

Crush Demons!
Ready your weapons and strategic skills to face waves of demons. From fiery imps to colossal fiends, each battle is a test of your tactical prowess and determination to protect your realm.​

Summon Your Minions:
Assemble a diverse army of minions, each with unique abilities and personalities. From spell-casting mages to sturdy skeletal knights, select your squad and lead them into battle against encroaching evil forces.​

Defend Your Castle:
Your mansion isn't just your home; it's your fortress. Ward off the most powerful demons and protect your sanctum from being overrun.​

Progress & Choose Your Skills:
Progress through an engaging storyline filled with challenges and rewards. As you advance, choose from a broad range of skills to enhance your strategies and strengthen your minions.​

Upgrade Your Arsenal:
Invest in your arsenal and empower your minions with superior weapons and magical artifacts. Each upgrade enhances your team's fighting abilities, crucial for surviving tougher foes.​

Explore Various Environments:
Journey through enchanted forests, shadowy caves, and mystical landscapes plagued by demonic entities. Each environment offers unique strategic challenges and hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.​

Battle Various Monsters and Demons:
Face a plethora of monstrous creatures and vile demons in epic battles. Learn their weaknesses, devise counterstrategies, and lead your minions to victory in each encounter.​

Why Play Pocket Necromancer:
- Engaging RPG elements mixed with strategy and action.
- Hilarious interactions and storyline that keep you entertained.
- Diverse environments that offer new adventures and tactics.
- Continuous updates and improvements based on player feedback.​

As darkness threatens your world, only you and your minion army stand in the way of the demonic forces. Download "Pocket Necromancer" now and become the hero you were destined to be!​

Embrace the challenge, enjoy the adventure, and crush the demons to protect your mystical abode!​

bluejetty:00144803:ios.name: StyleHint: Style search engine
bluejetty:00144803:ios.developer: 株式会社ファーストリテイリング
bluejetty:00144803:ios.summary:
UNIQLO and GU's official app to search for styles and fashion. 
Explore outfits from around the world and discover new ways to style yourself using items from UNIQLO and GU. 
*=========================*
What you can do with StyleHint
*===
bluejetty:00144803:ios.description:
UNIQLO and GU's official app to search for styles and fashion. 
Explore outfits from around the world and discover new ways to style yourself using items from UNIQLO and GU. 
*=========================*
What you can do with StyleHint
*=========================*
- Search for outfits using items from UNIQLO and GU
- Use photos either taken with your camera or saved to your device and search styles from around the world 
- Check for the latest fashion trends and outfits from around the world
- Purchase an item you like
- Share your outfits 
* Items that can be purchased through StyleHint are limited to UNIQLO and GU items. We will be increasing the number of brands gradually. 
*=========================*
Function details of StyleHint
*=========================*
[Explore outfits]
Search for outfits using items from popular brands such as UNIQLO and GU. 
Filter location, period and gender to easily find your favorite outfit.
Search by combining multiple keywords such as brand, season and trend words (ex. “UNIQLO outfit” “dress outfit” “fall outfit”)
[Search for styles to wear]
Equipped with a search function that utilizes image recognition technology.
Snap a photo or select a photo from your camera roll and search to coordinate outfits. 
You can also snap a photo and find similar items. 
[Explore fashion trends from around the world]
Favorite an item or style you like. 
Follow your favorite user to get more styling inspirations. 
[Purchase an item you like online]
Similar products from UNIQLO and GU are displayed when you snap a photo and can be purchased right away at our online store. 
* Items that can be purchased through StyleHint are limited to UNIQLO and GU items. We will be increasing the number of brands gradually. 
[Share your outfits easily]
Select a photo from your camera roll and make a post. 
StyleHint will automatically tag your clothes and identify similar items available from UNIQLO and GU. 
*=========================*
Popular brands
*=========================*
UNIQLO, GU
*=========================*
Popular search keywords
*=========================*
UNIQLO outfit / GU outfit / men's outfit/ women's outfit / kids outfit / mom outfit
spring / summer / autumn / winter
skirt outfit / wide pants outfit / dress outfit / fleece outfit / down jacket outfit / maternity outfit / simple outfit
fashion / fashion online store / women’s fashion / men's fashion / kids clothing
*=========================*
Recommended to those who want to
*=========================*
- Find new ways to style everyday outfits
- Find inspirations from those with a great sense of style
- Find ways to style accessories such as hats and scarves
*Campaigns are not sponsored by Apple Inc.

bluejetty:00174474:ios.description:
Trouble with finding friends abroad? InterNations is here for you! 
With communities in 420 cities around the world, InterNations is the world’s largest network for people living and working abroad — making it easy for YOU to meet expats and global minds both online and face-to-face. 
With our app, you can: 
• Connect with internationals in your city and around the world 
• Discover a range of curated events and experiences 
• Meet people who share your interests at activities you’ll love 
• Get real-life tips from experienced expats 
• And more! 
Membership information: 
You can download this app for free, but an InterNations membership is required to use it. 
InterNations offers free and paid membership options. Availability and pricing depend on your location and selected subscription period. 
Subscription terms: 
Paid subscriptions automatically renew 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your iTunes account will be charged in full for the selected duration. To prevent auto renewal, you need to turn it off in your iTunes account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. 
Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription. 
Privacy policy: [https://www.internations.org/privacy-policy/] 
Terms of use: [https://www.internations.org/terms-and-conditions/] 
We are present in 420 cities around the world, including: Amsterdam (Netherlands), Bangalore (India), Bangkok (Thailand), Barcelona (Spain), Brussels (Belgium), Doha (Qatar), Dubai (UAE), Geneva (Switzerland), Ho Chi Minh City (Vietnam), Hong Kong, Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), Kuwait City (Kuwait), London (UK), Manama (Bahrain), Mexico City (Mexico), Munich (Germany), New York (USA), Panama City (Panama), Paris (France), Quito (Ecuador), Riyadh (Saudi Arabia), Rome (Italy), San José (Costa Rica), Shanghai (China), Singapore, Sydney (Australia), and Toronto (Canada). 
Enjoy the international experience!

bluejetty:00074179:ios.name: pwSafe 2 - Password Safe
bluejetty:00074179:ios.summary:
pwSafe 2 offers Dark Mode, Touch ID, Face ID, Safari and apps autofill, iPhone landscape mode, adaptive text, a new design and much more on top of pwSafe 1.
Easy, secure and full featured password management across devices and computers. p
bluejetty:00074179:ios.description:
pwSafe 2 offers Dark Mode, Touch ID, Face ID, Safari and apps autofill, iPhone landscape mode, adaptive text, a new design and much more on top of pwSafe 1.
Easy, secure and full featured password management across devices and computers. pwSafe uses iCloud or Dropbox to keep your password databases backed-up and synced between your iOS devices and computers. It is compatible with open source Password Safe. No in-app purchases are needed for unlimited usage, including iCloud sync (see below).
Now available for the Mac with iCloud Sync - https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/pwsafe-password-safe-compatible/id520993579?mt=12
This application is not related to any application developed and/or marketed by PSafe Tecnologia S/A, including PSafe Total.
== What people are saying about pwSafe:
***** "Brilliant! - Passwords in sync at last!" -- Daddio1946 from Australia
***** "Great integration and support - PasswordSafe is great and this app makes it even better! Easy to setup and use. Their support for big fixes is great and the turn around time is short." -- Joeartz from the USA
***** "Very good, better than it's rivals, does what it's supposed to do AND the copy-feature is EX-CELLENT!" -- WaiWera from New Zealand
***** "I highly recommend this app for anyone who has a large number of usernames or hard-to-remember passwords." -- razor11401 from Canada
***** "Excellent tool for multiplatform password storage - Excellent tool that enhances my online security by creating complex and long passwords without the inconvenience of retyping them time and time again." -- AmberTiara from Neaderland
== List of features:
- TouchID unlocks
- Safari and apps autofill (extension)
- Smart Pasteboard: tilt your device face down to switch between username and password when using other apps
- Can open safes from any cloud service with an iOS 8 Storage Provider Extension
- Print a hardcopy of your data
- New iPad with Retina display & iPhone 5 support 
- iCloud sync, realtime and bi-directional
- Dropbox sync**, fully automatic and bi-directional
- Password generation
- Passcode protection
- Universal binary - iPad, iPhone and iPod Touch optimized
- Compatible with the famous open source Password Safe desktop app
- Search all fields
- Organize entries in groups
- Single tap password copy to clipboard
- Single tap password copy to clipboard and open website
- Clear password from clipboard after one minute
- Multiple fields (title, username, password, URL, email and notes)
- Define custom fields
- Full unicode support
- iTunes file sharing
- Receives safes as e-mail attachments (please name your safes with a .psafe3 extension)
- Opens safes from Dropbox (free without sync, paid otherwise)
- Export to PDF (encrypted, of course)
- Password history (per safe and per entry settings)
- Named password policies
- Fully compatible with Password Safe version 3.31 file format
- Multiple safes
- Unlimited passwords
- Unlimited password groups
- Two-factor authentication using YubiKey security token
- Generate TOTP authentication codes (two-factor authentication)
- Create and use Passkeys for password-free authentication
** Syncing via Dropbox is an In-App purchase.
Instead of trusting on a single developer security knowledge, pwSafe borrows all its encryption code directly from the famous Password Safe open source password manager (https://pwsafe.org). 
Password Safe has been originally created by security guru Bruce Schneier and nowadays is maintained by Rony Shapiro. Since it has been around as an open source project for more than two decades now, it has been extensively reviewed by many experts.
Apple’s standard end user license agreement (EULA) applies to the pwSafe app (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/)
The (optional) services provided by pwSafe Cloud are subject to our Terms of Use (https://pwsafe.app/terms-of-use/)

bluejetty:00165974:ios.name: Coffee Mania - Sorting Jam
bluejetty:00165974:ios.summary: Ready to dive into the ultimate coffee adventure? Welcome to Coffee Mania, the game that brings you the perfect blend of fun, strategy, and caffeine! Get ready to color sort, stack, match, and brew your way to success. Can you keep up with
bluejetty:00165974:ios.description:
Ready to dive into the ultimate coffee adventure? Welcome to Coffee Mania, the game that brings you the perfect blend of fun, strategy, and caffeine! Get ready to color sort, stack, match, and brew your way to success. Can you keep up with the coffee craze and sort the block jam in your coffee shop?
In Coffee Mania, you'll experience the thrill of running your very own match factory managing the coffee craze. Whether you're a fan of color sorting puzzle challenges or simply love a good coffee game, you'll find yourself captivated by the excitement of managing orders, tackling the block jam, keeping the queue organized, and ensuring every cup is the perfect coffee.
From bottle sorting in bottle jam mode to managing chaotic traffic in car jam and traffic escape scenarios, Coffee Mania is full of unexpected challenges. You'll even face tricky tasks like helping the bus navigate through a block, all while keeping your coffee shop running smoothly. The game is more than just a coffee pack simulator – it's an exciting test of your multitasking skills!
Whether you're managing the match factory, organizing the coffee stack, or helping a bus escape from traffic, every moment in Coffee Mania is filled with fun twists and turns. Enjoy the satisfaction of making each cup just right, and become the ultimate barista everyone admires.
Key Features:
Sort and Match: Enjoy exciting puzzles as you sort and match different ingredients to brew the perfect coffee.
Coffee Stack Challenges: Master the art of stacking cups and creating the perfect coffee pack.
Brew and Serve: Experience the thrill of crafting delicious coffee drinks while managing a busy queue.
Traffic and Jam Fun: Face unexpected challenges like car jam, traffic escape, and even bottle jam scenarios.
Match Factory Management: Run your own match factory and keep up with the coffee craze.
Color Sorting: Solve unique color sorting puzzles to keep the excitement brewing!
Are you ready to take on the coffee craze and prove your skills? Let’s brew some fun!
*In-App purchases may include random items.
To opt out of CrazyLabs sales of personal information as a California resident, please visit the settings page within this app. For more information visit our privacy policy: https://crazylabs.com/app

bluejetty:00171605:ios.name: Discover Lake Tahoe Audio Tour
bluejetty:00171605:ios.summary:
Welcome to the narrated driving tour of Lake Tahoe and find out why the dazzlingly blue waters of Lake Tahoe have been named America’s most beautiful lake! Start and stop the tour whenever you like, and explore Tahoe at your own pace.
Lake
bluejetty:00171605:ios.description:
Welcome to the narrated driving tour of Lake Tahoe and find out why the dazzlingly blue waters of Lake Tahoe have been named America’s most beautiful lake! Start and stop the tour whenever you like, and explore Tahoe at your own pace.
Lake Tahoe South/North:
Want to find out how Lake Tahoe earned the title of America’s Most Beautiful Lake? You’ve just gotta see it to understand! This driving tour loops around this dazzling lake and shows you the best vistas and hiking trails along the way, including some that most people miss.
Gaze across pristine waters as you learn about wacky characters who’ve lived here, like a bumbling 1800s stock broker and a guy who insisted on calling his house The Vatican! Plus, dive into the lake’s Gilded Age history and admire the lavish mansions which encircle it, from a viking-inspired Great Hall to a summer estate that once ran entirely on steam power.
Along the way, you’ll pass too many beaches to count, all of them perfect for catching some sun and surf. And don’t forget the trails, where you can experience untouched wilderness, sparkling waterfalls, and nature in its purest form. So what are you waiting for? Jump on in!
Featuring riveting stories, a phenomenal narrator, and easy automatic audio, this app puts exploration in the palm of your hand!
This self-guided driving tour of Lake Tahoe includes:
■ Tahoe South Visitor Center 
■ America’s Most Beautiful Lake
■ California vs Nevada 
■ Pope Cabin
■ Baldwin Cabin 
■ Pope Beach
■ Tahoe Yellow Cress at Pope Beach
■ Tallac Historic Site
■ Fallen Leaf Lake
■ Mount Tallac 
■ Fannette Island
■ Eagle Falls Trailhead
■ Knight’s First Tahoe Home
■ Emerald Park
■ The Lindbergh Connection
■ Rubicon Trail
■ Emerald Bay’s Hidden Secret
■ Fremont’s Adventures
■ Meeks Bay
■ Sugar Pine Point Details
■ Hellman-Ehrman Mansion
■ Tahoe Pines
■ Alpine Meadow
■ Olympic Valley
■ Carnelian Bay 
■ Kings Beach State Recreation Area 
■ Cal Neva Lodge & Casino 
■ Top Gun: Maverick
■ Memorial Point
■ Sand Harbor 
■ Shakespeare Festival
■ Thunderbird
■ Secret Cove 
■ Hauntings of Tahoe
■ Logan Shoals Vista Point 
■ Lady of the Lake 
■ Cave Rock 
■ 10+ Alternate Stops
HOW IT WORKS:
As you travel, audio stories play automatically based on your location. Simply go to the starting point of the tour and begin following the given route. Each story begins playing on its own, usually just before you reach a point of interest. 
TOUR FEATURES:
▶ Freedom of travel
No scheduled tour times, no crowded buses, and no rush to keep moving past stops that interest you. You have total freedom to skip ahead, linger, and take as many photos as you’d like.
▶ Automatic play
No muss, no fuss. Just follow the app’s built-in route to all the must-visit spots — the audio stories about everything you see will play automatically!
▶ Works offline
Download the tour in advance and then use it seamlessly, even in areas with no service!
▶ Incredible stories
Immerse yourself in the history, culture, and secrets of this famous site with the help of a top-tier narrator and fascinating stories written by experts.
▶ Award-winning app
Featured on Thrillist and WBZ, this easy-to-use app won the Laurel Award for Technology from the Newport Mansions, who use the app for over a million tours per year. 
FREE DEMO:
Check out the free demo to get an idea of what this tour is all about. If you like it, purchase the tour to get access to all the stories.
QUICK TIPS:
■ Download ahead of time, over data or WiFi.
■ Be sure the phone battery is charged, or take an external battery pack. Continued use of GPS can dramatically decrease battery life. This app uses your GPS to allow real-time tracking of your route.
NEW CALIFORNIA TOURS!

Hollywood Celebrity Homes
Joshua Tree
Big Sur & the PCH

bluejetty:00024289:ios.description:
The Best and Most Private Photo and Video App for iPhone and iPad. 
Millions of people trust Private Photo Vault® to keep their photos hidden. 
Top 100 Photography App in USA, Korea, Japan, Taiwan, India, Italy, Finland, UK, South Africa, Egypt, Mexico, Malaysia, Australia, Hong Kong, France, Ireland, Germany and many more countries. 
Reviews for Photo Vault®:
* * * * * 
"Wow, I have been wanting a way to hide some of my photos for a while, this is a perfect solution." 
* * * * * 
"Exactly what I'm looking for, can organize albums and even 'hide' others that I feel I need to." 
PROTECT YOUR "SPECIAL" PHOTOS + VIDEOS
• Password Protected App Entry
     • Pin Lock
     • Pattern/Dot Lock
• Password Protected Photo Albums
      (Keep people out of your private albums) 
• Break-in Report: Photo + GPS 
• Decoy Password
+ Face Down Lock
PHOTO MANAGEMENT
• Create Albums right in the App
• Import/Export from Photo App
• iTunes Syncing
• Wireless Photo Transfer
• Email Photos
• Text Message Photos
PHOTO VIEWING
• Image Gallery
• Slideshow
• Intuitive Interface just like Photo App
VIDEO SUPPORT
• Import/Export from Photo App
• Watch Videos
PRIVATE WEB BROWSER
• Browse the Internet Privately
• Download Photos directly to the app
CLOUD VAULT:
• Encrypted Cloud Backup
• Space Saver
• 100% Private - Yes. Private Photo Vault employees CAN NOT view any of your photos or videos.
When you enable Cloud Vault backup in the app, you are required to provide a Cloud Vault Password. Your Cloud Vault Password is never backed up to our servers and used as a secret value that only you know to encrypt/decrypt your files. This means we have NO ability to view your photos. This also means that if you forget your Cloud Vault Password, you will also not be able to view your Cloud Vault data. Please write it down.
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
Premium will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Terms: https://privatephotovault.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://privatephotovault.com/privacy-policy/
NOTE:
The free version of the app does not backup your files to Cloud Vault. Please ensure you perform backups of your photos and videos to ensure if you lose your device, your data isn't lost.

bluejetty:00070409:ios.description:
Hi ! EnTaga is the leading Tagalog, Filipino Translator with a lot of outstanding features such as accurate voice translator, translate any text in English to tagalog or tagalog to english and extremely useful photo translating feature or support to learn Tagalog, filipino and other languages more easily.
Less data, faster translation
* Convenient for regular use with professional pronunciation
* Translation of Al Camera
* Multilingual app of English and Tagalog, easy to use
* No login required, safe and friendly
Whenever you need translation in your daily life, travel, business or while learning a language English or Tagalog, just use English to Tagalog
Main features
1) Translate text
Real-time English or Tagalog text translation for phrases and words, voice to text translation
2) Translate images
Automatically recognize and translate text in images by taking a photo and pressing a button, can touch a word to know its meaning or see all translated
3) Voice translation
Real-time voice translation to both text and audio, tap-to-play again.
4) Translate conversation
You can speak English, the app will translate to Tagalog and vice versa
Hope that EnTaga will be a good helper in your life
For complete access to all EnTaga features, you will need to allow access to the following:
*Camera & Photo Gallery – Support to translate image easily.
*Microphone & Speech Recognition – so that speech-to-speech translations will work.
*Notifications – so that you can keep informed about new app features and interesting language facts.
Payments and Renewal:
* Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
* You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Account settings at any time after purchase
* No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active period.
Terms of use: https://amazinpro.com/translator-terms-of-use 
Privacy policy: https://www.amazinpro.com/translator-privacy-policy
Support Email: AmazinproService@gmail.com

bluejetty:00063630:ios.name: Letter to Santa for Christmas
bluejetty:00063630:ios.summary:
A WHOLE NEW NORTH POLE - REBULT FOR THE NEXT GENERATION 
Letter to Santa has been completely remade using modern AI technology, new artwork, fresh design, and an entirely new experience that brings Santa to life in a way we’ve never been ab
bluejetty:00063630:ios.description:
A WHOLE NEW NORTH POLE - REBULT FOR THE NEXT GENERATION 
Letter to Santa has been completely remade using modern AI technology, new artwork, fresh design, and an entirely new experience that brings Santa to life in a way we’ve never been able to before.
We’ve always believed that the magic of Christmas begins with a child’s words. Now, with today’s AI, those words create real stories, meaningful conversations, and a warm, gentle world kids can step into - all through their letters to Santa.
And for the first time ever, that magic can leave the screen and arrive right at your doorstep. A real, physical Santa Letter-stamped, sealed, and mailed from the North Pole. Parents can turn their child’s digital Santa letter into a real keepsake. A dream kids have held for generations now becomes real in their hands.
This app is built for families who want connection, positivity, and a little Christmas wonder.
FEATURES:
CHOOSE YOUR WRITING MODE
 • ‘Guided Composer’ for little ones
 • ‘Freestyle Mode’ for older kids
AI-POWERED INCREDIBLE SANTA REPLIES
 • Powered by safe and smart ChatGPT
 • Santa writes back with warm, personal messages based on the child’s own words
 • Parents can write Santa’s note, adding important updates like birthdays, personal messages, or encouragement
 • Choose Santa’s tone: Guided / Balanced / Creative
 • Parents can fully edit the AI-generated letter before sending it out
PARENTS ONLY PAGE
 • Secretly read all letters
 • Edit AI replies before delivery
 • Write your own custom Santa replies
 • View complete conversation history
REAL SANTA LETTER FROM NORTH POLE
 • Turn any Santa letter into a beautifully printed keepsake
 • Official North Pole, Alaska postmark - arrives in 2-3 days
 • Choose from the Santa letters your child has received, or any letter from their past exchanges with Santa
 • A heartwarming surprise that children will remember forever
NORTH POLE CAM
 • Enjoy fun videos from the North Pole
100% PRIVATE & SECURE
 • Your info is never stored or collected
Write to Santa today - and let the magic grow!
PLEASE NOTE
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your Apple Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Service: https://dualverse.com/terms-of-service/letter-to-santa/
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://dualverse.com/privacy-policy/letter-to-santa/

bluejetty:00082388:ios.description:
"My Water" helps you drink water regularly. Calculate your daily water intake and get notifications!
Water is essential for life on our planet. Roughly 70 percent of the body is made of water. We require water for almost every function within our bodies, from flushing out toxins to digestion. Water is essential to good health, yet needs vary between individuals. This app can help ensure you drink enough fluids.
Application features:
* Water requirement calculator
* Reminders
* Units (Metric and fl oz)
* Statistics in graphs
* Motivational awards
* Useful tips about water
You may need to modify your total fluid intake depending on how active you are, the climate you live in, your health status, etc., the calculation is only recommendation.
The application supports Apple Watch and is integrated with Apple Health.
This is one of the first applications with support Apple Watch! Application integrated with Apple Health to get information about your body measurement to calculate your water intake.
For extended features such as different beverages, detailed statistic, custom volumes and other useful features get the My Water Premium.
My Water Premium subscription:
The purchase will be charged to your iTunes account
The subscription will be auto-renewed 24 hours prior to it running out
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
Manage your subscription from User Settings in iTunes after purchasing. Cancel the auto-renewing subscription from there at anytime.
Terms and Privacy Policy: https://mywaterapp.me/privacypolicy/

bluejetty:00185411:ios.name: Heges 3D Scanner
bluejetty:00185411:ios.summary: Create 3D scans using the 3D camera (FaceID or LiDAR) of your iPhone 18, 17, 16, 15, 14, 13, 12, 11, XS, XR, X (and all their Pro/Max/Plus/Air variants) or iPad Pro! Export scans into STL, PLY, OBJ, USDZ, GLB (glTF), share them and more. On
bluejetty:00185411:ios.description:
Create 3D scans using the 3D camera (FaceID or LiDAR) of your iPhone 18, 17, 16, 15, 14, 13, 12, 11, XS, XR, X (and all their Pro/Max/Plus/Air variants) or iPad Pro! Export scans into STL, PLY, OBJ, USDZ, GLB (glTF), share them and more. On older devices, you can use the ordinary camera mode or the Screen Sharing feature.
This app is *PAID* up-front. Why is it free-to-download? To protect people with unsupported devices from buying it (more details at the end).
Heges is divided into two modes:
= 3D Scanner (**PAID**, requires one-time In-App Purchase)
============================
 - Available only for iPhones and iPad Pros with the selfie FaceID (TrueDepth) camera and/or LiDAR sensor as an In-App Purchase (Why? Read more at the bottom.)
 - Create 3D models by scanning everyday objects
 using the selfie TrueDepth camera (FaceID) and/or the rear LiDAR sensor
 - After scanning, export the models into PLY, OBJ, USDZ (all with colors),
 STL, GLB (both without colors) file formats
 - Share exported models e.g. via built-in Wi-Fi server or
 view them in the iOS Files app
 - Use the physical volume buttons to toggle scanning session
 - Double-tap anywhere in the live camera view to Share Screen with another iPhone/iPad,
 so that you can better see what you're scanning
 - View the models in AR
 - You can scan in pitch-dark environment and use Heges as a night vision camera!
 - Choose from the available scanning precisions — the higher
 the precision, the shorter the scanner range
 - To get the most accurate scans, you must use the selfie FaceID camera with 0.5MM Precision settings; do not use LiDAR if you need accurate scans
 - The selfie FaceID camera is much more accurate than LiDAR (approx. one order of magnitude),
 the models in the promo videos were scanned using the selfie FaceID camera of iPhone X
 - Use the selfie FaceID camera for scanning fine details (up to 2 millimeters accuracy with FaceID and 0.5MM Precision settings)
 - Use LiDAR for scanning large areas (e.g. houses, hallways, rooms, etc.), LiDAR is NOT suitable for scanning small objects with detail — use the selfie FaceID camera for this purpose
 - Objects in scanner range are highlighted in the live view
 - Switch to the passive Night Vision where there're no
 explicit restrictions on the scanner range
Instructions for the 3D scanner:
 - Move slowly when scanning
 - Make sure that most of the captured scene is within
 the scanner range
 - Please read the FAQ at https://hege.sh/faq
The scanner isn't perfect and can fail when moving too fast or scanning a challenging environment (e.g. glass surfaces cannot be captured due to the nature of the TrueDepth sensor).
A NOTE FOR iPHONE 13 (and newer) users: Beginning with the iPhone 13 lineup, Apple introduced a new TrueDepth (FaceID) camera design, which produces (slightly) lower-accuracy results compared to older devices.
To get best scan accuracy, consider using any iPhone 12 or older with FaceID.
= Color camera mode
============================
 - Available for all devices
 - Manual camera focus
 - Sharing photos via built-in Wi-Fi server
= Why don't you make the app paid on the App Store? Why the annoying In-App Purchase?
============================
It's for protecting people with unsupported devices. (I wish I could make it paid directly on the App Store.)
Heges needs the 3D-sensing selfie FaceID camera to capture 3D scans. But not all iPhones/iPads have the FaceID camera, so the app needs to check if your device has FaceID before it allows you to buy the app.
The App Store does not allow developers to check if your iPhone/iPad has FaceID, so the only way to check is if you download and open the app. Once you open Heges on your device, it will check if your device is compatible and if isn't, then you will not be able to buy it.
If you have any questions just drop me an email at support@hege.sh and I'll be happy to help you :)!
