bluejetty:00014891:ios.description:
Track your hours, overtime and earnings in one tap.
WorkHours makes clocking in effortless and shows exactly what you've earned today, this week or this month. Made for hourly workers, freelancers, contractors, remote workers and students – anyone who works flexible hours.
TRACK TIME YOUR WAY
• Start and stop timers with a tap or a swipe
• Add or fix entries by hand – set any start, end or length
• Add breaks, notes, tasks and expenses to entries
• Copy an entry to log a repeat shift in seconds
• Round times automatically
• Reminders so you never forget to clock in or out
KNOW WHAT YOU'VE EARNED
• Hourly rates in your currency
• Automatic daily, weekly and monthly overtime rates
• Dashboard with your hours and earnings at a glance
• Reports by day, week, month or any custom period
• Export to PDF, CSV or text and share by email or any app
ALWAYS WITHIN REACH
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island show your running timer
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Apple Watch app with complications – control timers and add entries from your wrist
MAKE IT YOURS
• Give each job its own color
• Light or Dark theme and alternative app icons
• Lock the app with a passcode, Face ID or Touch ID
SYNC AND BACKUP
WorkHours Cloud syncs your data across devices in real time and keeps it backed up, so moving to a new iPhone is painless. Manual backups are included too.
FREE AND PREMIUM
WorkHours is free to use with a limited number of entries and jobs. Premium unlocks unlimited entries, jobs and all features. Try it free for 3 days, then choose a monthly or yearly subscription.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renew in your Apple Account settings after purchase
• Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription
Terms of Use: https://www.whtracker.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://www.whtracker.com/privacyPolicy
Questions or ideas? We'd love to hear from you: support@whtracker.com

· Preterite or Imperfect? Passé Composé or Imparfait?
· Ser or Estar? Avoir or Être?

VerbMaster puts you on the fast track to verb mastery in Spanish AND French. Our Mastery Engine pinpoints your weak spots and drills what you need most, making learning efficient, effective, and actually FUN.
**READY TO CONQUER THOSE TENSES?**
Each Verbs Master Class guides you through three rigorous but rewarding phases:
· The Crash Course: Learn the verb-related grammar covered in a 4-year language program. Finally understand when and how to use each tense and mood.
· The Conjugation Cascade: Master the essential verbs—64 in Spanish, 72 in French—across 12 tenses, until conjugation becomes second nature.
· The Vocab Expander: Now that you've got conjugation down, expand your vocabulary with HUNDREDS more essential infinitives!
**INTRODUCING CONTEXT DRILLS!**
You've mastered the verbs. Now let's put them to work!
Tackle all those OTHER notoriously tricky parts of Spanish and French with targeted practice in real sentences.
Por vs. para? Object pronouns? Subjunctive vs. Indicative? French adjective agreement? Y vs. en? We've got drills for all of them, with more topics on the way!
· Learn with helpful grammar guides that break down the tricky stuff.
· Practice with exercises that progress from multiple choice to fill-in-the-blank and full translation.
· Make a mistake? We'll show you exactly where you went wrong and give you another shot.
· Master what you've learned with spaced reviews designed to make it stick!
**AND THERE'S MORE!**

· Achievements: Earn badges for milestones, consistency, and mastery. Make your family proud. Make your enemies weep.

bluejetty:00124196:ios.name: Russian Car Drift
bluejetty:00124196:ios.summary:
Tired of the look of modern cars? Looking for something unique? You found what you need!
THE LARGEST RUSSIAN CAR PARK
- In this game you will find almost everything: from models from the 70s to modern cars
- Original factory parts and expo
bluejetty:00124196:ios.description:
Tired of the look of modern cars? Looking for something unique? You found what you need!
THE LARGEST RUSSIAN CAR PARK
- In this game you will find almost everything: from models from the 70s to modern cars
- Original factory parts and export modifications
VISUAL AUTO TUNING
- You can replace bumpers, lights, fenders, and many other parts
- Create a unique project from your car using body kits, wheels, etc.
- Deep painting system. Paint every detail of your car in the color you want thanks to the extensive palette and the ability to paint every little thing
- Write whatever you want on the license plate and move it wherever you want! Yes, you can go to the roof too.
- Use stickers to make your car unique. Thanks to the function of downloading stickers from your phone, you are not limited to standard boring sets. Use your imagination to the maximum!
WHEELS EDITOR
Wheels are 80% of a car's style. That is why we have made our wheel editor as detailed as possible:
- Choose the right disc, bolts and even the center cap.
- Adjust the wheel diameter, width, and spacer size you need.
- Install the right tire for your car with the ability to adjust the width and height. You can make a jeep with huge tires or stens with a good tightness.
BIG GARAGE
At your disposal as many as 100 places for cars. Now you do not need to part with an existing car to make a new one. Just buy another one and put it next to the first one. And if suddenly you do not have enough for one more car, then you can sell others and get half the cost back for them.
MULTIPLAYER
- You can drift with your friends in real time! Get together, choose a location and have fun!
- Compete with other players in a tandem drift duel mode, and take his money as a prize!
- Battle of the week: a mode in which you can show everyone who is the best drifter here and get unique cars
OFFLINE GAME
- Keep playing anywhere: train, plane, car. Even in the forest!
The game includes paid and free loot boxes containing random virtual rewards. Items are virtual only and cannot be exchanged for real money.

bluejetty:00121534:ios.summary:

Koala's super intuitive interface helps you make a tra
bluejetty:00121534:ios.description:
Koala is the ultimate pocket-sized sampler. Record anything with your phone's mic or load your own sounds. Use Koala to create beats with those samples, add effects and create a track!
Koala's super intuitive interface helps you make a track in a flash - there is no brake pedal. You can also resample the output of the app back into the input, through the effects, so the sonic possibilities are endless.
Koala's design focuses totally on making the music-making process instant, keeping you in the flow and keeping it fun, not getting bogged down by pages of parameters and micro-editing.
"Been putting that $4 koala sampler to good use lately. Undeniably great tool that puts some of these expensive beat boxes to shame. A must cop."
-- flying lotus, twitter
* Record up to 64 different samples with your mic
* Transform your voice or any other sound with 16 superb built-in fx
* Load your own samples
* Choose from one of 250 built-in sounds
* Resample the output of the app back into a new sample
* Export loops or entire tracks as professional quality WAV files
* Direct export to Ableton Live Set
* Copy/paste or merge sequences just by dragging them
* Create beats with the high-resolution sequencer
* Import samples from the Files app or even from videos
* Keyboard mode lets you play chromatically or one of 9 scales
* Quantize, add swing to get the right feel
* Normal/One-shot/Loop/Reverse playback of samples
* 6 Choke groups
* Attack, release and tone adjustable on each sample
* Mute/Solo controls and note repeat
* Add any (or all) of the 16 effects to the entire mix
* AUv3 compatible - use in GarageBand, Logic, Cubasis etc etc
* MIDI controllable - play your samples on a keyboard, map the effects to knobs
* Jam with others over WiFi with Ableton Link
* Free copy of Ableton Live Lite included
* AudioShare compatible
* Use AI to separate samples into individual instruments (drums, bass, vocals and other)
* Set your own background image and choose from a growing list of background visual FX
8 Built-in Microphone FX:
* More Bass
* More Treble
* Fuzz
* Robot
* Reverb
* Octave up
* Octave down
* Synthesizer
16 Built-in DJ Mix FX:
* Bit-crusher
* Pitch-shift
* Comb filter
* Ring modulator
* Reverb
* Stutter
* Gate
* Resonant High/Low Pass Filters
* Cutter
* Reverse
* Dub
* Tempo Delay
* Talkbox
* VibroFlange
* Dirty
* Compressor
Features included in SAMURAI In-App Purchase
* Pro-quality Timestretch (5 modes: Modern, Retro, Beats, Re-pitch and Cyclic)
* Piano roll editor
* Auto-chop (auto, equal, and lazy chop)
* 3 Band EQ
* Pocket operator sync out
* Quokka Synth - powerhouse polyphonic synthesizer
* MIDI Out - control external MIDI hardware with Koala's sequencer
* Chopper - multimodal sample chopping instrument
Features included in MIXER In-App Purchase
* Mix your beats professionally with a 4 channel mixer + main bus
* Route any sample to any channel
* Mute/solo, faders and accurate metering on every channel
* 5 effect slots per channel
* 29 high-quality effects - compressors, filters, phasers and more, with new effects to come
* Host AUv3 plugins - both audio effects and instruments

Key
bluejetty:00072425:ios.description:
Coolthemes is a free application that offers a vast collection of awesome phone themes, stylish app icons, useful widgets, and a massive collection of DIY Wallpapers and Charging Wallpapers to to help you personalize your home screen.
Key Features：
【Trendy Phone Theme】
More than 13,000 meticulously curated themes covering a vast range of styles: Glitter, Aesthetic, Popular Anime, Top Celebrities, K-Pop Groups, Cool Racing Cars, iOS 26, and much more.
Each theme is crafted by professional designers and can be applied with just a few taps, instantly refreshing your home screen. With weekly updates, there's always something new to discover!
【Charging Wallpapers & Widgets】
● Dynamic charging wallpapers that come to life while your phone powers up
● Beautiful charging icons and animated stickers
● A rich collection of decorative elements to make charging more fun
【DIY Wallpapers】
Create your own static or live wallpapers using our rich template library, including Polaroid-style photo layouts, heart collages, cool anime designs, Labubu animated backgrounds, and much more. 
Plus, personalize your device with diverse battery icon stickers and widgets to customize your status bar, adding even more fun and personality to your screen. Give your home screen a one-of-a-kind design that’s truly yours.
【Stylish Widgets】
Enhance functionality and aesthetics with a variety of widgets:
● Dynamic Battery Widget
● Real-time weather displays
● Quick control panels
● Photo and calendar widgets
● And many more handy tools
【Control Center Customization】
Give your Control Center a personalized touch with matching icons and themes that integrate seamlessly with your overall setup.
【More Content】
We also offer keyboard themes, Fonts, Kaomoji, Textrat, and many other content to fully meet all your customization needs.
Premium Subscription
Unlock full access to all features of Coolthemes with our premium subscription.
● Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
● Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
● Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
● You can manage or turn off auto-renewal at any time in your iTunes Account settings after purchase.
Term of Use: https://ios-fontsapp.firebaseapp.com/TermOfUse
Privacy Policy: https://ios-fontsapp.firebaseapp.com/Privacy
Contact: fontsappcs@outlook.com

Get back to the world of Beeland and join the singing Babees, the crazy Busy Bees and the cheeky spiders in another buzzing FREE puzzle game. Get ready to blast colourful tiles, make brilliant combos and have some buzz-tastic fun! Find your inner puzzle bee and join a new beedazzling adventure!

• Loads of different game modes: Pop the cheeky spiders' web, collect flower tiles, save the babees and much, much more! 
• Last, but not least: A lifetime's supply of bee puns! 
We are always working hard to update the game and satisfy your puzzle needs! Already played and enjoyed the game? Stay tuned for updates and do drop us a review! Also, check out these sources for all the latest news:

Twitter: twitter.com/beebrilli 
Instagram: instagram.com/beebrilliantgame/ 
See you in Beeland! THANK YOU!

bluejetty:00018736:ios.name: Oh She Glows
bluejetty:00018736:ios.summary: New York Times bestselling cookbook author Angela Liddon, shares her most popular plant-based recipes from the award-winning recipe blog, OhSheGlows.com, and stunning, vibrant food photography for each recipe. Angela has been creating healt
bluejetty:00018736:ios.description:
New York Times bestselling cookbook author Angela Liddon, shares her most popular plant-based recipes from the award-winning recipe blog, OhSheGlows.com, and stunning, vibrant food photography for each recipe. Angela has been creating healthy, veggie-packed recipes for more than 10 years, and she only shares recipes that are hits with her family, friends, and recipe testers, so you can be confident that the recipes in this collection will win over even the biggest skeptic. One thing is for sure, this healthy recipe app will have you glowing from the inside out and bursting with cooking inspiration! Be sure to unlock the free recipe bundles on the bundles page, including a delicious Cookie Lover's holiday bundle.
FEATURES:
 • Trending Recipes - see which recipes others are cooking right now. If a recipe is trending, you’ll see “trending” below the recipe title
 • Recipe list is now sorted by season and holiday so the most relevant recipes show up first in the recipe list. If you wish to see the recipes in chronological order (our previous way of displaying them), visit the Settings app, click on Oh She Glows, and tap “show newest recipes first”
 • Browse through beautiful full-screen high-resolution photography
 • Search for recipes with ease using ingredient keywords or by recipe title
 • Find detailed nutritional information available for each recipe located in the "tips" section
 • Filter your recipes based on dietary/allergy info, season, dish type, and more
 • Strikeout ingredients and directions as you cook so you don’t lose your place
 • Customize your own favorites list with your most-loved recipes
 • Add your own notes to the recipes if you make any changes
 • Take recipes with you on the go with convenient offline access
 • Cook without worry that your device will go to sleep with our anti-lock feature
 • Enjoy split view on your iOS 12+ iPad Air 2, iPad Mini 4, and iPad Pro
 • Synchronize favorites and notes between devices using iCloud
 • Browse recipe thumbnails by category (e.g., view all breakfast recipe titles and photos in one spot)
We hope you enjoy cooking with the Oh She Glows - Healthy Plant-Based Recipes app. For any questions please feel free to email us at app_support@ohsheglows.com, and we are happy to help!
From our kitchen to yours,
The Liddon Family
TESTIMONIALS:
“This is the GO TO app for vegan friendly recipes!!! You don't even have to be vegan to enjoy them because each recipe is so full of flavor. The app is perfectly laid out so you can make the recipes with ease. The search feature and the filters make it easy to make recipes with dietary concerns in mind or to use items you currently have on hand. Best recipe app ever!!!”
~ C.P.
“This is everything I could ask for in a food app. Every recipe I have tried was absolutely delicious. The layout of the app is gorgeous and the features are on point. It is so easy to use and makes me want to cook! Thank you Oh She Glows for another amazing product!”
~ Sierra J.
“I love love love this app. In my opinion it's the best recipe app out. It's easy to read and understand and the recipes are oh so good. The app makes me want to cook more. I highly recommend it.”
~ Jodie F.

PERSONALIZED
bluejetty:00123490:ios.description:
Subscribe to Jillian Michaels | The Fitness App and get beach body ready with the most comprehensive customizable fitness, nutrition, and mindfulness features all on one seamless platform.
Try a 7-day trial of Premium Access!
PERSONALIZED FITNESS PLANNER
Over 1000 + workout exercises in HD video to stream on your phone, tablet, or TV! The Fitness App offers personalized workout programs for any fitness level from beginner workouts to advanced! Meet any goal from weight loss to toning up trouble areas! Train with at home workouts, in the gym, exercise outside, or choose audio only workouts!
The Fitness App includes all your favorite workouts: yoga, HIIT, kickboxing, walking & running programs including 5K & 10k training with GPS tracker, pre & postnatal options, ab workouts, butt workouts & more!
The premium subscription also has a Workout Generator to build unique targeted workouts with 10, 20, 30 or 45 minute options to create customized ab workout, leg workout, butt workout, or total body workout just for you!
• Adjust workout intensity
• Select fitness goal
• Select Available Fitness Equipment
• Select fitness preferences
• Select workout length
• Swap and ban exercises
• Adjust transition time between exercises
• Play your own music during workout
• Let Beat Sync adjust the beat of music to pace of workout
• Siri shortcuts to open, pause, stop workouts
• Apple Watch for Heart rate tracking
• Apple Rings and activity integration
• Integrates with Apple Health
DVD WORKOUT LIBRARY
Plus, subscribers have access to stream Jillian's DVD workout library including the full Bodyshred and Body Revolution programs.
CUSTOMIZED MEAL PLANNER
Try the Advanced Meal Planner!
The Fitness App is your personal diet coach with the Advanced Meal Planner system that helps you reach your weight loss goals or maintain a healthy lifestyle. Beyond just planning your own meals, the Advanced Meal Planner System features tools to help plan meals for the whole family!
• Meal Plans for every preference: Omnivore, Vegan, Vegetarian, Paleo & Gluten Free, Pescatarian, Keto, 5 Minute Meals and more!
• Hundreds of quick delicious nutritious recipes
• Ban ingredients
• Grocery lists
• Dynamically adjust recipes for weight loss, maintenance, or muscle gain
• Pick the meals and days to eat on or off plan
• Dynamically adjust number of servings in a recipe
• Options for batch cooking so you can plan to eat delicious leftovers
• Mark favorite recipes
MINDFULNESS
Sleep better. Stress less with mindfulness exercises & meditations ranging from sleep to stress management. Relax & unwind with nature sounds, motivational practices, body scans, mindful eating meditations & more.
TRACKING
Track your progress: weight, calories, activity, workout history and more. You can even take weekly side by side progress pics with the selfie photo tracker and share data with My Fitness Pal.
SUPPORT
Get daily custom health & fitness tips from Jillian to help you stay on track!
Download now & start your 7-day trial of premium access to personalized workout programs, meal plans, meditations & mindfulness, community, support, and more.
SUBSCRIPTION & PRICING TERMS
We offer 3 premium subscription plans: Monthly (1 month), Quarterly (3 months), Annual (12 months). Unless canceled or auto-renew is turned off 24-hours before the end of subscription term or the 7-day trial period, you will be billed automatically based on your chosen subscription plan at the end of the free trial or on your subscription renewal date.
Manage your subscription and disable auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase or trial start. Read full Terms of Service and Privacy Policy at: https://www.jillianmichaels.com/policies/terms

bluejetty:00134261:ios.name: Evermusic Pro: music player
bluejetty:00134261:ios.summary:
Evermusic Pro - Cloud & Offline Music Player for iPhone and iPad.
Stream your music library from the cloud, listen offline, and take full control of your sound — no limits, no ads. Evermusic Pro combines a powerful audio player, equalizer,
bluejetty:00134261:ios.description:
Evermusic Pro - Cloud & Offline Music Player for iPhone and iPad.
Stream your music library from the cloud, listen offline, and take full control of your sound — no limits, no ads. Evermusic Pro combines a powerful audio player, equalizer, playlist manager, and file organizer in one beautiful app.
• PLAY ALL AUDIO FORMATS
Evermusic Pro supports the most popular audio formats: MP3, AAC, M4A, WAV, AIFF, ALAC, M4B, and many others.
• CONNECT YOUR CLOUD
Create your own music streaming service by moving your music library to the cloud. Listen to your music directly from the cloud, freeing up space on your iPhone for photos and new apps. Access music from popular cloud services like iCloud, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, pCloud, and many others. Privacy-focused services like MEGA, Internxt, and Proton Drive are supported as well.
• CONNECT MEDIA SERVERS
Connect Plex, Subsonic, Navidrome, Jellyfin, and Emby media servers with your library easily.
• CONNECT YOUR COMPUTER OR NAS
Connect using SMB, WebDAV, DLNA, FTP, SFTP, and NFS protocols. Advanced buffering technologies ensure smooth playback. Connect to personal NAS storage using native APIs for QNAP, WD My Cloud Home, Nextcloud, and Synology Drive. Import audio files from your computer using iTunes File Sharing and Wi-Fi file transfer.
• OFFLINE MUSIC
Download your favorite songs, albums, and artists to listen offline. Enable the audio player cache to automatically download recently played songs.
• AUDIO EQUALIZER
The built-in equalizer offers presets for popular music genres, plus manual settings to fine-tune your sound and boost your audio.
• GAPLESS PLAYBACK
Enjoy smooth playback with no pauses between songs, perfect for concept albums and classical music.
• CROSSFADE PLAYBACK
Enjoy continuous playback with the crossfade feature, where the next song starts before the current one ends.
• AUDIO EFFECTS
Make your music sound the way you like with built-in audio effects. Turn on volume normalization to keep every track at the same loudness, and adjust playback with reverb, delay, distortion, and spatial audio.
• MUSIC VISUALIZER
Watch full-screen animated visuals that react live to your music. Choose from a large library of presets, or let them cycle.
• LYRICS AND COMMENTS
View embedded timed lyrics and comments for your audio tracks. Activate the lyrics widget on the Home Screen for quick access.
• AIRPLAY & CHROMECAST
Stream music to Apple TV, smart speakers, or other devices with AirPlay or Chromecast.
• APPLE CARPLAY
Drive and listen safely with an interface designed for CarPlay.
• WIDGETS
Activate interactive Home Screen widgets for fast access to your playback queue and continue playback from the last saved position.
• AUTOMATIC SYNCHRONIZATION
Your music library automatically syncs between the cloud and your device, grouping songs by artist, album, and genre.
• AUDIOBOOKS
Use the app as an audiobook player with features like audio bookmarks, playback speed control, and media position saving.
• PLAYLISTS MANAGER
Create and manage playlists, reorder songs, and make playlists available offline. Sort songs by name, size, track number, or album.
• ID3 TAGS EDITOR
Edit audio tags to view detailed metadata or correct corrupted information in your files.
• FILE MANAGER
Organize, move, rename, and manage your audio files directly in the app.
• ADVANCED SEARCH
The smart search engine helps you find your favorite albums, artists, and songs in your music library.
• USB FLASH CARDS
Connect external card readers like the SanDisk iXpand and listen to music directly from your SD card.
----------
Evermusic Pro is your all-in-one music player, cloud streamer, downloader, and file manager for iPhone and iPad. 
Great for music lovers, bands, producers, audiophiles, students, and audiobook listeners.
Privacy Policy: https://www.everappz.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.everappz.com/terms-and-conditions

Thekr App is a comprehensive Islamic application for everything a Muslim needs, with an easy and simple user interface.
Application features:
• Remembrances for morning, evening, and sleep, and all the remembrances that a Muslim needs from the book Hisn al-Muslim.
• Dua’s from the Qur’an and Sunnah.
• Prayer times with Athan.
• Full athan feature, and pre athan notification.
• High quality quran with meanings and Tafseer .
• Audio recitations of the Holy Qur’an voiced by the most famous reciters in the Arab world, such as (Yasser Al-Dosari, Mishary Al-Afasy, Al-Minshawi...)
• Tasbeeh counter, with the ability to set a target for daily tasbeeh.
• Qiblah.
• Various remembrances with beautiful backgrounds.

bluejetty:00023179:ios.summary: Warhammer 40,000: Combat Cards is a card battler and deck building strategy game set in the eternal conflict of Games Workshop's Warhammer 40,000 Universe. Choose from all the Warhammer 40k factions and experience intense card battles of th
bluejetty:00023179:ios.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Combat Cards is a card battler and deck building strategy game set in the eternal conflict of Games Workshop's Warhammer 40,000 Universe. Choose from all the Warhammer 40k factions and experience intense card battles of the Space Marine, Imperial, Chaos, mighty Ork WAAAGH!, and more on the go!
In Warhammer 40k Combat Cards, ready your decks to skirmish battles with some of the universe's most iconic Warlords, dominate with powerful Space Marines, and defend the Aeldari Worlds with superior card tactics. Expand your deck collection across multiple factions to craft new tactical strategies as you sweep the galaxy, delivering swift victory.
New players and 'Eavy Metal fans of the Warhammer universe will find challenges in Combat Cards, as they ready their decks and prepare to dominate the Warhammer 40k leaderboard! Be a part of the Psychic Awakening in Warhammer Combat Cards - 40K and lead your favorite Warhammer 40000 faction to compete in various game modes, including PvE and PvP Campaigns, live events, and more in epic card wars.
TACTICAL CARD WARS
Build your card battle deck of Warhammer Combat Cards - 40K and duel other players in PvP card war. Make key strategic choices, compliment Warlord abilities with army cards to maximize your chances, and dominate the war board to victory.
CREATE THE ULTIMATE DECK
Build your card collection to create the ultimate Warhammer 40,000 card battler deck. Enhance your army around iconic Warlords and challenge other players in turn-based PVP strategy duels.
TEAM UP AND SOCIALIZE IN CLANS
Engage and collaborate in Clan guilds dedicated to favorite factions in the Games Workshop Warhammer 40,000 Universe. Use Citadel trading cards' special rules and team up with friends to create a cunning raid strategies to dominate the field of war.
ENGAGE IN ICONIC STORY CAMPAIGNS
Take part in CCG campaigns based on iconic Warhammer 40K battles. Increase your might as a Warlord to unlock new trading cards and to maximize your decks into card battle. Adapt your CCG strategy as your Warhammer card collection grows.
COLLECT THEM ALL
Build the ultimate CCG collection: every card features a miniature from the Warhammer 40K universe 'Eavy Metal painted character. Promote each card through its upgrade path to complete its arsenal and fight in epic PvP card battles and Warhammer 40K campaigns.
CHOOSE FACTION ALLEGIANCES
Collect miniatures from Games Workshop's Warhammer 40K Universe. Each army is equipped to fight with unique 40,000 Warlords, special rules, and unique tactical abilities.
Learn more:
https://www.combatcards.com/
https://www.facebook.com/WarhammerCombatCards/

bluejetty:00127240:ios.summary: Be Informed is a mobile application that keeps you in the know. Stay safe in South Australia. We tap into the latest incidents, warnings and fire ban information feed from the CFS, and fuel data from data provided by the State of South Aust
bluejetty:00127240:ios.description:
Be Informed is a mobile application that keeps you in the know. Stay safe in South Australia. We tap into the latest incidents, warnings and fire ban information feed from the CFS, and fuel data from data provided by the State of South Australia*.
We will show you the status and location of important events such as:
* Burn offs
* Bushfires
* Animal rescues
* Vehicle accidents
* Gas leaks
* Fallen trees
* Floods
* Storms
* Bushfire “Safer Places” and “Last Resort Refuge” information
… and many more!
In addition to the incidents and warnings feed, Be Informed displays the CFS’s Fire Ban information for the State
* Each region in South Australia mapped out and listed
* Four-day fire ban forecast
You can use the fire ban and incident information to be prepared whenever you go travelling and camping in South Australia
Features
* Fuel Prices
* Major Incident display on the main screen so you can focus on what’s important
* List of all incidents in South Australia
* Refreshes list of incidents automatically
* Clusters incident icons so you can zoom in further and learn more
* Satellite, terrain and regular map tiles
* Display Safer Place and Last Resort Refugee information around South Australia
* Dark/Light UI mode compatibility
* Full screen UI
The application can use your location to show you the closest incidents.
Stay Informed with Be Informed!
---
* This app is based on or contains data provided by the State of South Australia (Office of Consumer and Business Services 2021-2023. Copyright of the State of South Australia.)

You’ve made it this far. You know your CPTs from your ICD-10s, and you can navigate a procedure code faster than most people can find the mute button on Zoom. Now all that stands between you and your Certified Professional Coder credential is the CPC exam. Fun.
EZ Prep’s CPC Study App is the fastest, smartest, and least miserable way to prep for the AAPC exam. Whether you’re reviewing at home, in the office, or pretending to relax in the park while low-key panicking about modifiers, the app goes with you and helps you focus on what actually matters.
It was built by certified professional coders who’ve been through the wringer. You won’t get recycled quiz content or vague flashcards. You’ll get personalized learning paths with adaptive questions that increase in difficulty as you improve. The better you do, the harder we push. The app doesn’t care about your feelings. • Foundational Medical Knowledge
• Compliance and Guidelines
• Procedure and Service
• Advanced Clinical and Procedural Coding
• Evaluation and Management
Every section is broken down so you’re not buried under vague terminology or legal-sounding nonsense. Just straightforward questions with straightforward answers.

EZ Prep is designed to cut the fluff and help you focus. No gimmicks. No filler. Just the fastest way to get CPC-certified and move on with your life.

bluejetty:00137270:ios.description:
Simple Stocks brings your stocks, ETFs, funds, crypto, and cash into one portfolio tracker for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch. No account needed; everything stays on your device.
Since 2021, Simple Stocks has helped tens of thousands of investors easily track all their assets in one place on all their Apple Devices. Try it now to check all your investments clearly and understand your performance.
Whether you are tracking your first investments, building a diversified portfolio, or managing holdings across brokers and currencies, keep a clear view of what you own. Follow your balances at a glance, then explore the income, costs, and market movements behind your returns.
CONNECT YOUR HOLDINGS
• Connect to more than 40 supported brokers, including Robinhood, Fidelity, Schwab, Vanguard, Trading212, and Interactive Brokers. • Import transactions using CSV files or record positions manually. • Combine linked accounts, imported transactions, and manual entries across your portfolios. • Export your transaction records to CSV.
UNDERSTAND YOUR PERFORMANCE
· Compare your performance against the S&P 500, Nasdaq, or any index or ETF.
· Review gains and losses to identify which holdings contributed to your results. · Explore profitability, win rate and volatility metrics. · Understand how fees, dividend income and exchange rates affect your returns. · Track and record dividend payments automatically. · Account for stock splits and other corporate actions automatically.
SEE YOUR COMPLETE PORTFOLIO
- Monitor several portfolios and your combined net worth. - Track investments in different currencies and display values in your preferred currency. - Include cash balances, savings, and interest alongside your investments. - Access more than 50 exchanges, plus major market indexes and commodities. - Follow over 2,500 cryptocurrency pairs.
FOLLOW MARKET DEVELOPMENTS
+ Monitor prices throughout the trading day.
+ Set price alerts and get notified when an asset reaches your target + View U.S. stock prices before the market opens and after it closes.
+ See analyst ratings and price targets for U.S. stocks. + Read a concise AI summary explaining the day's portfolio movements. + Follow news related to the assets you hold. + Build watchlists for investments you want to monitor.
BUILT FOR YOUR APPLE DEVICES
► Access your portfolio on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. Now with iPhone Duo support. ► Use more than 10 widgets and watch complications for quick updates. ► Review your investments in a dedicated Mac app designed for larger screens. ► Keep your portfolio synchronized through your personal iCloud.
KEEP YOUR PORTFOLIO PRIVATE
No Simple Stocks account or sign-up is required. Your portfolio is stored on your devices, and calculations run locally. Use your own iCloud to keep everything synchronized.
Build a clearer picture of your investments. Download Simple Stocks and understand your portfolio at every stage of your investing journey.

Unlock all functions, including unlimited portfolios, price alerts, and AI news summaries, with Simple Stocks +. Try free for 7 days. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled and can be managed or canceled in your Apple Account settings.

bluejetty:00047866:android.description:
Since May 1992 on the market, 93 FM has been bringing the best of contemporary Christian music. The radio went on air at midnight on May 25th and over the years it established itself in the gospel segment.
In 1994, the station changed its address. It went from Rua dos Artistas, in Vila Isabel, to Rua Gothenburg, São Cristóvão. In 1997, the radio reformulated its transmission system and became one of the pioneers in the digital system.
In 20 years, events with great public mobilization became successes and consolidated themselves as a brand for the broadcaster. We held Canta Brasil, Rio and Zona Sul (bringing together hundreds of thousands of people); Praise; Gospel Sound; and live broadcasts of the Book Biennial, Marches for Jesus and special programs held outside the studio.
According to consolidated data from IBOPE, 93FM is among the 5 most listened to radio stations in Rio, reaching 1st place at specific times in recent years. An audience that grows every day, and has been reinforced with the repeater antenna, which now takes the signal throughout the west zone, with the quality that our listeners deserve.
93FM stands out for its 24-hour gospel programming, without neglecting its commitment to social, information and the satisfaction of our listeners and advertisers. We are a transformative vehicle for ideals, opinions and we know the role we have in mass mobilization. Therefore, over the 20 years, we have developed projects in all sectors of our production with the aim of not only entertaining, but also educating, raising awareness and helping.

bluejetty:00168332:ios.description:
Step into a fresh football experience on mobile — you're not scoring goals, you're protecting the game in a fun stadium simulation. Command in-game stadium security, control massive virtual crowds, and keep every simulated match safe from kickoff to the final whistle.
Football Security Game 2026 is a stadium security simulation game where your leadership, strategy, and fast decisions decide whether match night runs smoothly or descends into chaos. Everything in this app is a game simulation for entertainment only — it does not provide real security, surveillance, or scanning functions. Take charge of the operational side of professional soccer as a game and experience packed arenas from a side you've never played before.
WHY PLAYERS ENJOY IT
• A fresh security concept for football fans
• Fun and engaging matchday action that's perfect for downtime
• Varied levels: ticket checks, catching intruders, VIP escorts and more
• Clean, easy-to-read visuals built for quick pick-up-and-play sessions
RUN THE OPERATION (IN-GAME)
Control arena gates, inspect supporter tickets, monitor simulated camera feeds, and coordinate patrol teams in real time — all as part of the gameplay. Respond quickly to in-game emergencies before the pressure spreads through the stadium. Every event throws a new challenge at you — a blocked turnstile before kickoff, suspicious activity near a tunnel, or aggressive supporter movement in a restricted zone.
SIMULATED STADIUM SYSTEMS (GAME MECHANICS)
• Simulated camera monitoring and virtual crowd tracking (not real surveillance)
• Simulated ticket inspection and access control mini-games
• Tactical radio dispatch communication within the game
• Emergency response coordination challenges
• Referee escort and player protection missions
• In-game incident tracking and crowd heatmaps
PROTECT THE PEOPLE WHO MATTER
Escort virtual referees safely between dressing rooms, technical zones, and the pitch during emotionally charged fixtures. bluejetty:00131995:ios.description:
Glow is the most comprehensive period tracker and fertility app in the world. With Glow, you can track your menstrual cycle, ovulation, and fertility signs, all in one place. Glow also provides you with personalized insights and advice to help you understand your body and improve your chances of getting pregnant.
FEATURES
- Track your menstrual cycle: Glow makes it easy to track your menstrual cycle. Simply input the start and end dates of your period, and Glow will do the rest. Glow will track your cycle length, flow, and symptoms, and provide you with insights into your unique cycle patterns.
- Ovulation tracking: Glow's ovulation tracker is one of the most accurate on the market. Glow uses advanced algorithms to predict your fertile window and ovulation day, so you can know when you're most likely to get pregnant.
- Fertility sign tracking: In addition to tracking your menstrual cycle and ovulation, Glow also allows you to track other fertility signs, such as basal body temperature, cervical mucus, and sexual activity. This information can help you to better understand your fertility and make informed decisions about your reproductive health.
- Personalized insights: Glow provides you with personalized insights and advice based on your cycle data. This information can help you to understand your body better, improve your chances of getting pregnant, and manage your menstrual cycle.
- Community support: Glow also has a large and supportive community of users. You can connect with other women who are trying to conceive, get advice from experts, and share your experiences.
- Apple Health Integration: Sync data between Glow and Apple Health app.
BENEFITS
- Improve your chances of getting pregnant: Glow's ovulation tracker and fertility sign tracking tools can help you to better understand your fertility and make informed decisions about your reproductive health. This can help you to improve your chances of getting pregnant.
- Manage your menstrual cycle: Glow's menstrual cycle tracking tool can help you to track your cycle length, flow, and symptoms. This information can help you to better understand your cycle and manage your menstrual symptoms.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Glow is free to download and use. Upgrading to Glow Premium will unlock: 
- Advanced Cycle Chart
- Cycle Analysis
- Comparative Insights
- Forecast
- Advanced BBT chart
- Premium Articles
- Private messaging
- Custom profile
- Premium support
- (More premium features will be coming soon!)
Glow offers quarterly and yearly subscription options: 
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at the confirmation of purchase. 
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. 
- Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. 
This is modern care for your fertility. Track your cycle with our ovulation calculator and learn more about your reproductive health every time you log on. Easily record your physical symptoms, sexual activity, and day-to-day moods to help you increase your chances of getting pregnant. The Glow app allows users to track their menstrual cycles, and to make informed decisions about the optimal time to conceive. The Glow App is intended as an aid in ovulation prediction to facilitate conception ( not to be used for contraception ).
For full Privacy Policy and our Terms of Service:
https://glowing.com/privacy-policy/
https://glowing.com/terms-of-service/
**Note: The information provided by Glow should not replace professional medical advice. Always consult with a healthcare provider for medical advice. If you are having technical issues or have any questions about your cycle or period, we're here to help. Please send us an email to: support@glowing.com

- Data security differentiates us from popular to-do list apps

-
bluejetty:00126206:ios.description:
*** Your security is our priority ***
- Data security differentiates us from popular to-do list apps
- All note contents are encrypted at rest on our servers
- Notes can be Vault Encrypted with a password that's never sent to our servers
- Your note content is available for download at any time
*** Built on seamless syncing ***
- Along with data security, accurate syncing is at our core
- Designed for heavy users who often switch between the same notes on mobile and desktop
- Our sync is fully compatible with Vault Notes (even though we can't decrypt their content)
***Expression is our cornerstone ***
- Rich Footnotes that hold text, code, images, or all the above is our flagship feature
- Easily insert images into notes, or even into text within notes
- A range of the finest markdown stylings at your disposal
*** Notes and tasks: better together ***
- Text, code, to-do tasks, and images all live inside the same note
- Tasks can be customized to recur at flexible intervals or hidden until later
- Tasks are automatically removed from your to-do list when completed
*** As organized as you are ***
- Connect notes with bi-directional linking
- Note tags allow multi-level taxonomy to organize notes
- Browse these taxonomies like directories
- Recreate OneNote browsing hierarchies seamlessly
*** Flair for sharing ***
- Any note can be instantly shared and edited by multiple parties
- Publish notes (including their Rich Footnotes!) to the web with one tap
- Shared to-do lists can help a team stay on top of shared responsibilities
*** Built for personal productivity ***
- Set up any task to repeat relative to when you last got it done
- Track how much you're getting done over time with our automatic task graph
- Designate tasks as "Urgent" or "Important" to use proven priority techniques
*** More than ample enough for power users ***
- Simplified, clean UI is efficiently functional
- Contextual keyboard toolbar puts the relevant actions at your fingertips
- Quick opener allows opening any recently used note in ~3 taps
- *** No internet? No problem ***
- Continue working offline within new or cached notes
- All work will automatically sync once back online
*** Ample: no more, no less ***
- We won't settle for becoming bloated with non-essential features
- We work across mobile and web.
*** Get started instantly ***
- Use our Evernote Importer to bring your notes from the olden times
*** Account required ***
- An active Amplenote account is required to use Amplenote.
- New accounts automatically receive a 14-day free trial of the Pro plan.
- At the end of the trial period, you may choose between the free plan (Personal) or one of the paid plans.
- You may purchase an auto-renewing subscription through an In-App Purchase.
- 1 month and 1 year durations are available for Basic, Pro, and Founder subscription levels.
- Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Current subscriptions may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase
- Privacy policy: https://www.amplenote.com/privacy_policy
- Terms of use: https://www.amplenote.com/terms_of_service

bluejetty:00167891:ios.description:
Welcome Aboard
Skip the stress of traffic and parking. Freebee’s on-demand transportation service is safe, reliable and 100% free!
Freebee’s unique platform is transforming the way people experience their communities by inspiring local mobility and seamlessly connecting them with their destination by way of our fully electric vehicles.
Here’s how to get started:
1. Discover: Download the Ride Freebee app to browse our local recommendations and exclusive deals.
2. Explore: Request a ride and wait for your friendly driver to arrive.
3. Connect: Enjoy the ride and share your experience in The Hive. Redeem your Freebee deal once you reach your destination.
#RideResponsibly
Freebee is connecting people with the world around them, while aiding the economic development of local communities and advocating for a greener, safer earth. We do this by ensuring that our service is always free, convenient and most importantly, great for the environment.
Free: Transportation can be expensive. By riding with Freebee, you can reallocate money saved on transportation to spend on local dining, shopping and entertainment.
Convenient: Public transportation can be a hassle. Parking can be tricky to find and lugging heavy bags of groceries is sometimes too much to handle. With Freebee, you can enjoy the excitement of your local community, without the inconvenience of traditional transportation.
Electric: Freebee vehicles are 100% electric, making them the most environmentally responsible transportation choice for you and your community.
Love the app? Let us know by leaving a review!

bluejetty:00024085:ios.description:
Have a MAGIC-ally good time in the new My Little Princess kingdom! We’ve opened a new location for you to explore and the wizard and his elves have so much to show you – visit the wizard’s cave, help the elves around the garden, seek out the hidden mini game – you can even grow your very own baby dragon!
When you download My Little Princess : Wizard, you can add new characters and clothing to ALL the other My Little Princess games. Maybe the wizard would like a tour of the princess’ castle? If you have all three games, your characters can move between all of them!
Features:
- New hidden mini game – can you find it? How long can you fly?
- Magical blue rocks to test out and discover what they can do
- Many new rooms and fun locations to plan fun adventures in! 
- So many cool new clothes for playing dress-up and now you can put makeup on your favorite My Little Princess people!
- Move between other My Little Princess games! By connecting all of the My Town games, we are encouraging kids to build an infinite number of new adventures.
- We update our older games every month, so please wait for the updates to connect these games to My Little Princess. 
- If you are just starting out with My Town, no worries! You can create your own characters inside My My Little Princess.
- The ability to save your progress and pick up where you left off next time you open the app
- Multi-touch Feature: Play with your friends and family on the same device!
If you can imagine it, you can make it. Everything is possible in My Little Princess!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. Younger kids will enjoy playing together with there parents while the older kids can play alone or with a friend using our new multitouch feature!

The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com or visit us on the MY TOWN Facebook page and twitter!
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get privacy-related information at https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00080910:ios.description:
Welcome to Type Hype 2D, an exciting and addictive typing game where your keyboard skills are put to the ultimate test! In Type Hype 2D, players are tasked with typing letters as they cascade down the screen, aiming to reach a target at the bottom. Sounds simple, right? Think again!
As you progress through the game, the word becomes challenging your reflexes and typing speed. But here's the twist: you must type the correct letter for each falling character to successfully guide it to the target.
Type Hype 2D features multiple levels of increasing difficulty, each with its own unique challenges. From basic single-letter drops to intricate word formations! You'll need razor-sharp accuracy to conquer them all.
But it's not just about speed – precision is key! Make too many mistakes, and you lose. Can you keep your cool under pressure and achieve the high score?
With its simple yet addictive gameplay, vibrant graphics Type Hype 2D is the perfect game to test your typing skills while having a blast. So grab your phone and get ready to type your way to victory in Type Hype 2D!

bluejetty:00078279:ios.summary: AZ511 works in conjunction with the Arizona Department of Transportation's AZ511.gov, the Arizona Traveler Information website, to provide the latest information on conditions along the state highway system. Users will receive information o
bluejetty:00078279:ios.description:
AZ511 works in conjunction with the Arizona Department of Transportation's AZ511.gov, the Arizona Traveler Information website, to provide the latest information on conditions along the state highway system. Users will receive information on delays, crashes, construction and closures, as well as alternate routes to help drivers avoid backups. Motorists may view ADOT’s statewide network of cameras on the app. Drivers can get real-time information on their routes by entering their destinations into the app. Travelers may also save regularly used routes and receive alerts along those routes.
The app includes these features:
• Traffic cameras
• Real-time updates on highway incidents and delays
• Personalized routes
• Travel times
• Alternate routes
• Drive mode
• Speed map
Reminders:
It is not safe to use your phone while driving. Please enter drive mode for audio alerts while on the road.
Suggested alternate routes shown on az511.gov are generated automatically by a third party and can include local roads. For official ADOT alternate routes, which in most cases will involve state highways, please consult ADOT’s Twitter account at twitter.com/ArizonaDOT and the information provided by the free ADOT Alerts app at ADOTAlerts.com.
COMMERCIAL VEHICLE DRIVERS: Large trucks are prohibited on State Route 89A between Flagstaff and Sedona, State Route 89A between Clarkdale and Prescott Valley, and State Route 89 between Prescott and US 93 northwest of Wickenburg.

bluejetty:00144025:ios.description:
The brand new mobile game Trials of Heroes: Idle RPG is an action-packed fantasy RPG with massive hero summon and epic idle style gameplay. You will be gaming with millions of players around the world in this glorious adventure for the throne in the championship arena.
Game Features:
[Idle Battle Gameplay - Auto Battle mode is in!]
Feeling tired of grinding resources for level ups? Fingers getting numb tapping excessively in combat?
No need to worry, try out the offline auto battle mode anytime and everywhere! Your heroes will train and fight automatically for you, even if you go offline and AFK! 
You can order your favorite heroes to adventure on steppes, in forests, labyrinths and dungeons to fight with idle evils while you are enjoying the never-ending battles. Your squad would bring back the needed resources in return.
[Summon Massive Heroes - Enormous Hero Collection]
Over 100 epic heroes and monsters from 6 different races are available in the gallery! Upgrade and improve your heroes & monsters by raising their power and unlock special skills, craft and forge ultimate weapons, legendary gears and equipments for their fancy outfit and evolutionary strength!
Collect as many as you can!
[Assemble The Right Squad and Practice the Right Strategy]
Who you bring to the fights matters. Recruit the right strike force and choose a battle formation of five powerful heroes wisely and manage your lineup to secure your victory! 
[More Than Idle Style] 
Climb up the Dark Tower for nonstop challenges, complete quests from various heroes in Tavern, launch an all-out attack in the Burning Crusade, forge legendary equipment for your heroes, defeat Mythical Bosses in Dark Forest for special rewards, and farm challenging Raids for extra gains! More exciting contents are waiting for you to discover!
[Fight with Your Allies Worldwide] 
One for all and all for one, connect with people and make new allies from all over the world, upgrade Guild Skills in Academy for bonuses, get rewards from Mine orders, win increasing rewards by taking down numerous guild bosses and participate in a week-long Guild Campaign with your guild members. Make it to the Finals for glory!
[Show Your Skills in The Multiplayer Arena] 
Dominate the AFK battle arena, participate in unique Periodic Championships, complete Elite Trials and Team-Up Trials to win massive rewards. Arrange your team, choose the right strategy and smack the top players!
Summon your hero now and let’s begin an epic adventure in this mysterious yet unknown land!
PLEASE NOTE 
Network connection is required.
Trials of Heroes: Idle RPG is free to download and play, some in-app items can also be purchased for real money. In-app purchases can be disabled through your device’s settings.
By downloading this app, you agree to our privacy policy and terms of use. http://toh.jupiterltd.net/Privacy_Policy.html
Follow us on Facebook for updates, reward events and more!
https://www.facebook.com/trialofheroes.page/

Exciting news! Your gateway to the unique beauty experience is now just a tap away on your phone. Dive into a world of unparalleled elegance, where a vast array of beauty products awaits, with fast delivery and the latest updates on promotions and exclusive offers.
Embark on a journey through over 600 global brands and more than 20,000 beauty essentials. Our online store showcases exclusive beauty and perfume brands that you won't find anywhere else but at Gold Apple. From luxurious perfumes to transformative skincare, and hair care essentials to the latest makeup innovations, it's all here, waiting for you to explore.
Brand & category varieties:
We are a rapidly growing beauty retailer with an extensive range of makeup, skincare, perfumery, K-beauty, and exclusive brands from all over the world. At Gold Apple, you'll discover bestsellers and the latest collections from popular brands like Lancôme, Estee Lauder, Clarins, Roberto Cavalli, Thalgo, Tom Ford, YSL, Giorgio Armani, Moschino, Versace, Davines, Kilian Paris, Clinique, Cosrx, Essential Parfums Paris, L'Oreal Professional, Kenzo, Paco Rabanne, Shiseido, Narciso Rodriguez, Serge Lutens, Juliette has a Gun, Eau Thermale Avene, Etro, Institut Esthederm, La Roche-Posay, L'Oreal Paris, Organicals, and hundreds of other brands. 
Find all your favourite products in one place. Professional haircare brands, unique derma collection, a combination of niche perfumery and bestselling fragrances, and a stunning makeup selection.
Loyalty Program
It’s time to get your points working for you with our Gold Apple Beauties loyalty program. Register in the program in the mobile app or on the website and get up to 10% points back on all purchases and use all the benefits. Earn points with every purchase and redeem them to cover up to 100% of your next order online or offline. It's our way of saying thank you for choosing us. Our loyalty program has 3 levels — lime, silver, and gold. You can earn more points and gifts on each of them. Enjoy free makeovers, hair styling, monthly giveaways, and special offers.
Online Shopping and Delivery 
Enjoy a world-class shopping experience. Unlimited beauty shopping experience with free and fast delivery, ensuring your purchases reach you promptly and securely, with no extra cost, and in luxury packaging. More brands online, with an easy way to add favourite products, search, and simple and fast checkout and track orders. In our online store, you can check out for the next-day delivery! Just add products to your cart and receive your order the next day. We offer free delivery across Qatar. We understand that sometimes you need to return orders- don’t worry, it’s easy with us.
Payments
100% secured online payments. Choose any payment method option you prefer cash on delivery, online payment, points payment, or mix them. We accept Visa, Mastercard, and Amex for your comfortable online journey. 
Favourites 
Create your own wish list within our app with our "Favorites" section. Easily save and revisit your cherished items with just a tap, making your shopping experience even more personalized.
Order History
Keep track of your beauty journey effortlessly with our intuitive purchase history feature. Review previous orders and reorder your favourite products with ease, all at your fingertips.
Orders Reviews
Your voice matters! Share your product feedback and experiences through reviews and ratings, helping us shape a better experience for you and our community.
Customer Care
We’re here for you and ready to make your shopping experience even better! Our customer care specialists will assist you with all the questions you might have – call us or use our WhatsApp chat to get a quick response. 
We are developing and improving every day if you encounter any challenges or have innovative ideas, we'd love to hear from you at mobile_app@goldapple.com
Download Gold Apple app now to change your idea of beauty shopping!

bluejetty:00032157:ios.description:
Embrace the Blitz, the ultimate test of your matching skills and abilities. 
Blitz Factory 3D is a fun, addictive triple-match puzzle game that will train your brain and help you kill time. 
Clear and merge items off the playing field by finding the items in the pack and tapping them away to whittle down the pile.
Explore and master our levels, which range from a relaxing, easy game to our more challenging brain teasers. Tap your way through our relaxing levels and help you pass the time with our fun, creative, and exciting game that helps stimulate your mind as you play.
Pick off the triple items in our match game challenges to clear the levels and master your way through our tricky boards.
Get lost in the exclusive in-game challenges that will have you scrambling to find and tap the missing items in our various match puzzles.
- Objective: Match the 3D Objects to perfect your vision and challenge your mind
- Engage: Collect items in Triples to clear them from the board, and pay close attention to the goal items.
- Challenge: Race against the clock in our challenging yet addictive stages.
- Clear The Levels: Match and clear the items to unlock additional level
- Bonuses: complete exciting side quests and reach the goal to unlock in-game rewards and prizes.
- Difficulty: Levels range from easy and relaxing to real brain stimulators.
So what are you waiting for? Join the Blitz Factory 3D Crew and start having fun with us today.
Note that Blitz Factory 3D ads do not necessarily show actual gameplay.

bluejetty:00076106:ios.description:

Ahlam was developed with great love and attention to details. Our team has more than 10 years of experience in dating sites and we tried to combine most important features without overloading. If you are looking for USA arab dating, UK arab chat, arabs in Canada, Europe, GCC and other arab countries you came to right place. Please send us feedback, questions, ideas to support@ahlam.net
تم تطوير تطبيق الدردشة والتعارف Ahlam بشغف وحب والاهتمام بالتفاصيل.
بخبرتنا التي فاقت 10 سنوات في مواقع التعارف، جمعنا لكم أهم المميزات الفعالة .
اذا كنت تبحث عن تعارف للعرب، دردشه بالعربي، للحب والصداقة والعثور على شريك مناسب للزواج - نحن في "Ahlam" يمكننا مساعدتك كما ساعدنا بالفعل الاف المستخدمين السعداء الذين وجدوا الشريك المناسب لهم عن طريق تطبيقنا. (يمكنك ان تجد بعض التعليقات في https://ahlam.net/testimonials) 
الميزات الرئيسية: 
- تتم مراجعة جميع الصور والنصوص يدويا من قبل المدقيقين لدينا بحيث تكون قاعدة البيانات ذات جودة عالية
- يمكن الإبلاغ عن اي إسائة من قبل المشتركين بسهولة (عن طريق النقر على "شكوى" في حساب المشترك)
- يمكن حظر المشتركين في حالة الإساءة بسهولة (بالنقر على "حظر" في حساب المشترك)
- التسجيل الفوري والدخول عبر الشبكات الاجتماعية (لا يتم نشر اي معلومات)
- توثيق الحسابات في 4 خطوات: صور شخصية، بريد الكتروني، شبكات التواصل الاجتماعي، رقم الهاتف. يتم تمييز الحسابات التي تم التحقق منها بشارة خاصة وتحظى بالأولوية. نوصيك بتوثيق الحساب (مجانًا) بعد تحميل التطبيق مباشرةً
- تحميل ما يصل إلى 30 صورة بجودة عالية وتغيير ترتيب الصور
- يمكن للمرأة الحفاظ على إخفاء الهوية واختيار واحد من الصور الرمزية الجميلة التي تعكس شخصيتها 
- البحث عن أشخاص قريبة منك (الموقع الجغرافي) مع خيار لتحديد مسافة البحث
- البحث بنقرة واحدة فقط عن المعايير المهمة مثل: الصور، الشهادات، مع / بدون أطفال
- "لعبة معجب او غير معجب" - تطابق سريع بالصور. مشاهدة الصور, اختيار معجب أو غير معجب - سيتم إخطار كلا الجانبين في حالة الاعجاب المتبادل
- تصفية نتائج البحث لرؤية المستخدمين الفعالين فقط (من سجل الدخول في آخر يومين)
- تصفية نتائج البحث لرؤية المستخدمين المتصلين الآن

bluejetty:00086517:ios.description:
نلتزم بتقديم افضل الخدمات الطبية في جميع التخصصات الرئيسية والفرعية من خلال الكوادر الطبية المتميزة المؤهلة من أرقى الجامعات المحلية و العالمية باستخدام أحدث ما توصلت إليه التقنية في مجال التجهيزات الطبية لتحقيق أفضل مستوى من الجودة والسلامة للمرضى.
يتيح تطبيق المواساة للهواتف الذكية لكم الحصول على مجموعة واسعة من الخدمات الإلكترونية الفريدة والتي نهدف من خلالها الى جعل تجربتكم أسرع وفي منتهى السهولة.
حجز المواعيد، استعراض المواعيد القادمة والسابقة، الأدوية الحالية والسابقة، النتائج الطبية، الموافقات الطبية، الفواتير، ربط أفراد العائلة
We are committed to providing the best medical services in all major and sub-specialties through distinguished qualified medical cadres from the most prestigious local and international universities using the latest technology in the field of medical equipment to achieve the best level of quality and safety for patients.
The Mouwasat application for smartphones allows you to access a wide range of unique electronic services, through which we aim to make your experience faster and easier. Integrated with the Health app (HealthKit) to seamlessly access and track your health data. This allows us to present your information in an intuitive and visually appealing way while enabling our doctors to provide you with more accurate and personalized assessments.
Appointment Scheduling, Appointments Histories, Medications, Medical Approvals, Invoices, Sick leaves, Dependents.

bluejetty:00175015:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00175015:ios.description:
Welcome to the self-guided Salem Witch Trials Tour in Salem, Massachusetts!
The Salem Witch Trials:
Get ready for a seriously harrowing tale. The quaint, picturesque town of Salem, Massachusetts hides a dark, chilling history, and we’ll tell you all about it. Walk these historic streets and uncover the story of the 1692 Salem Witch Trials, where paranoia and superstition turned townspeople against one another, driving them to accuse and execute their neighbors.
Journey back to the 1600s and meet those responsible for the witch panic, from vengeful children to cruel men of the law. Meet the innocent victims who were suddenly swept up by the plague of fear and paid the ultimate price.
Retrace these tragic events and discover why they have fascinated and terrified people for hundreds of years, inspiring movies, shows, and even Arthur Miller’s famous play The Crucible.
To walk through Salem’s haunted history is to peer into the dark corners of the human mind—a place where good people became capable of great evil. Who knows what we can unearth when we shine a light on these dark corners?
Featuring haunted stories, a phenomenal narrator, and easy GPS audio, this app puts exploration of Salem's history in the palm of your hand!
Learn about Salem’s Witch Trials, the perpetrators, the innocents caught up in it all, and more.
Salem Visitor Center
The Salem Militia
Samuel Pickman House
The 1692 Memorial
Bridget Bishop
Sarah Good
Rebecca Nurse
George Burroughs
Giles Corey
Old Burying Point
The Peabody Sisters and the Grimshawe House
Old Town Hall
Joshua Ward House
Hollywood in Salem
Lyceum Hall
St Peter's Episcopal Church
Old Witch Gaol
Salem Jail
Martha Corey
Howard Street Cemetery
Roger Conant & Witch Museum
John Bertram House
Ann Pudeator
Melba Apartments
Dorothy Good
Salem’s Survivors
Salem Common
BONUS STOPS! Salem’s Historic Homes:
Gedney House
Broad Street Cemetery
Hamilton Hall
The Ropes Mansion
The Witch House
AND MORE! 
Hawthorne’s Legacy in Salem:
Nathaniel Hawthorne Statue
Mercy Tavern
The House of the Seven Gables
HOW IT WORKS:
As you travel, audio stories play automatically based on your GPS location. Simply go to the starting point of the tour and follow the route. Each story will play as you approach a point of interest.
TOUR FEATURES:
▶ Freedom of travel
No scheduled times, no crowded buses—just explore Salem's haunted sites at your own pace.
▶ Automatic audio
Follow the app’s built-in route, and audio stories play automatically at each stop!
▶ Works offline
Download the tour in advance and use it seamlessly, even without service.
▶ Lifetime purchase
No subscription. No time limits. Enjoy this GPS-guided walking tour as often as you like.
▶ Incredible stories
Immerse yourself in the history of Salem, guided by an expert narrator.
▶ Award-winning app
Featured on Thrillist and WBZ, this app won the Laurel Award for Technology from Newport Mansions.
FREE DEMO vs FULL ACCESS:
Try the free demo to get a taste of the experience. If you like it, purchase the full Salem Witch Trials tour for complete access to all the stories.
QUICK TIPS:
Download over data or WiFi ahead of time.
Keep your phone charged or bring an external battery pack.
Note: Continued use of GPS in the background can decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00154282:ios.name: Callipeg: 2D Animation App
bluejetty:00154282:ios.summary: Callipeg is a professional 2D hand-drawn animation app for iPad and Apple Pencil, offering both frame-by-frame and keyframe animation tools within a comprehensive, studio-grade environment. Enjoy full access with a one-time purchase—no subs
bluejetty:00154282:ios.description:
Callipeg is a professional 2D hand-drawn animation app for iPad and Apple Pencil, offering both frame-by-frame and keyframe animation tools within a comprehensive, studio-grade environment. Enjoy full access with a one-time purchase—no subscription required.
Turn your iPad into a powerful creative workspace where you can draw, craft, and refine your animation with a fully manageable timeline and advanced onion skin features—tailored for professional and aspiring animators, illustrators, and creatives.
Whether developing complex shots or full-length films, Callipeg provides the tools and flexibility for you to animate effortlessly.
Have suggestions or feedback? Join our Discord community and help us build a better animation tool together!
Key Features
 Hands-on Animation Studio
- Organize your work with shots, scenes, and folders
- Drag and drop assets, use color tags, and advanced search for efficient project management
Intuitive, Gesture-Based Interface
- Fully manageable timeline with customizable frame rates: 12, 24, 25, 30, or 60 FPS
- Decluttered workspace optimized for touches combined with the Apple Pencil
- Left-handed mode and floating menu for seamless workflow
Full Drawing & Brush Tools
- Extensive brush set: pencil, charcoal, ink, and more
- Create custom brushes with adjustable smoothing, tip, and texture
- Color picker, custom palettes, and color history for fast, accurate coloring
- Fill tool with adjustable range for controlled coloring
 Advanced Layer System
- Multiple layer types: drawing, video, transformation, audio, and group layers
- Import images, videos, and audio for rotoscoping, lip-sync, or reference
- Organize layers with color coding and grouping
Animation-focused Controls & Features
- Multi-touch gestures for flipping, playing, pausing, and transforming animation
- Onion skinning with customizable color and opacity (up to 8 frames before/after)
- Out of Pegs feature for advanced onion skin control
Customization & Flexibility
- Import unlimited reference images
- Move the sidebar, invert the canvas, and customize your workspace
- Export animation in .mp4, .hevc, .gif, .png, .tga, .psd, .peg, and more
- Import/export JSON, XDTS, and OCA for cross-platform compatibility and import in industry standard software
High Performance
- Animate in up to 4K resolution
- Add unlimited layers for complex projects
- Automatic saving every 30 seconds and reliable backup/version control
---
Why Choose Callipeg?
- All-in-one 2D animation studio for iPad—no subscription, just a one-time purchase
- Designed for Apple Pencil for the most natural hand-drawn animation experience
- Constantly updated with new features and improvements
- Trusted by professional animators, illustrators, and studios worldwide
Start animating anywhere. Download Callipeg and transform your iPad into a powerful 2D animation studio today!

bluejetty:00046796:ios.description:
Chega de planilha de gastos. O Dinzo organiza seu dinheiro sozinho: bancos conectados via Open Finance, cada despesa categorizada automaticamente e o Dino — um assistente de IA que funciona direto no seu WhatsApp.
DINO, SEU ASSISTENTE NO WHATSAPP
Mande "mercado 184" e a transação entra categorizada no extrato. Grave um áudio com vários gastos de uma vez. Tire uma foto da nota fiscal e ela entra itemizada. E pergunte o que quiser — "posso comprar um PS5 de R$ 3.500?" — que o Dino projeta seu saldo e responde. Tudo sem abrir o app.
SEUS BANCOS, CONECTADOS
Nubank, Itaú, Bradesco, Santander, C6 Bank, Inter, Caixa, Banco do Brasil, BTG Pactual, Mercado Pago, PicPay, XP e mais de 100 instituições, via Open Finance regulado pelo Banco Central. Contas, cartões e investimentos importados automaticamente — acesso somente leitura.
O QUE VOCÊ GANHA
• Gastos categorizados automaticamente, em mais de 100 categorias
• Fatura prevista do cartão sempre atualizada, com a projeção que o app do banco não mostra
• Assinaturas (Netflix, Spotify...) e parcelas detectadas sozinhas
• Limites por categoria, com alerta antes de estourar
• Metas com previsão de chegada
• Investimentos: ações, FIIs, Tesouro, CDB e mais de 26 tipos de ativos
• Fechamento do mês em formato de story
• Dashboard web incluído, com relatórios e exportação em CSV, Excel e PDF
• Contas manuais ilimitadas para o que não estiver no Open Finance
• Widgets de saldo e ofensiva na tela de início
CUIDAR DO DINHEIRO VIROU UM JOGO
Missões, XP e ofensiva constroem o hábito que a planilha nunca conseguiu.
SEGURANÇA DE VERDADE
A autorização acontece no app do seu próprio banco — o Dinzo nunca vê sua senha. Acesso somente leitura: é impossível movimentar dinheiro pela plataforma, e você revoga quando quiser. Dados criptografados, conforme a LGPD.
POR QUE O DINZO É PAGO?
Porque aplicativo de finanças "grátis" se paga de outro jeito: vendendo seus dados, empurrando cartão de crédito ou enchendo a tela de anúncio. O Dinzo é sustentado só pela assinatura — sem anúncios, sem venda de dados. Teste grátis no plano anual, garantia incondicional de 7 dias e cancelamento em 1 clique.
Seu dinheiro, claro como nunca. Suporte humano no WhatsApp e central de ajuda em ajuda.dinzo.com.br
EULA https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Snowball Analytics combines portfolio analysis and dividend tracking for long-term investors. Bring your investment accounts together and see your whole portfolio in one place: stocks, ETFs, funds and crypto across 70+ exchanges and 30+ currencies.
TRACK ALL YOUR INVESTMENTS
- Link your brokerage accounts or import broker statements
- Combine several portfolios into one overview
- Watchlists and quotes for the stocks you follow
DIVIDEND TRACKER AND CALENDAR
- Automatic dividend tracking for every holding
- Dividend calendar with upcoming and received payouts
- Dividend income, dividend yield and yield on cost
- Custom withholding tax
- Dividend rating and top dividend stocks
- Alerts for key dividend events (paid plans)
PORTFOLIO PERFORMANCE
- Performance that includes fees, dividends and trades, with money-weighted returns (IRR)
- Diversification by sector, asset class and region
- Metrics such as P/E, Beta and Sharpe ratio
- Compare your results with benchmark indices
- Calendar of earnings, dividends and splits
PORTFOLIO INSIGHTS
A personalized analysis of your portfolio right on the dashboard: spot concentration risks and see which holdings lag the benchmark.
AI CHAT
Ask questions about your portfolio and get answers based on your own holdings.
HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
See your portfolio value, dividends and top movers at a glance.
GOALS
Set a target for portfolio value or passive income and track your progress.
PRIVACY
Snowball Analytics does not store your brokerage usernames or passwords.
PLANS
Every new account starts with 14 days of full access for up to 2 portfolios. After that, you can stay on the free plan with 1 portfolio and up to 10 holdings, or upgrade. Paid plans (Starter, Investor and Expert) unlock more portfolios, unlimited holdings and advanced analytics.
Snowball Analytics is not a broker or a registered investment advisor and does not provide investment advice.

bluejetty:00032173:ios.name: AI Note Taker – VoicePen
bluejetty:00032173:ios.summary: VoicePen is your AI note taker that records and transcribes voice to text, then summarizes it into smart, AI-powered notes. Skip the typing — record meetings, lectures, or voice memos and turn them into accurate speech to text transcription
bluejetty:00032173:ios.description:
VoicePen is your AI note taker that records and transcribes voice to text, then summarizes it into smart, AI-powered notes. Skip the typing — record meetings, lectures, or voice memos and turn them into accurate speech to text transcriptions, summaries, action points, proofread texts and more. Transcribe and summarize any imported audio or video — from local files to YouTube videos, podcasts, and Zoom recordings. Works seamlessly on your iPhone, Watch, iPad, Mac, Vision Pro.
# AI Note Taker for Lectures and Meetings:
- Record unlimited meetings, lectures, interviews — up to 2 hours each
- Record in the background and offline with Live Activities
- Get fast, accurate transcriptions with speaker labels and timecodes powered by OpenAI Whisper
- Get AI notes in multiple formats: Summary, Takeaway, Action Points, Study Note, Definitions, Quiz and more
- Export notes and recordings to PDF or DOC and share via any app
- Organize notes into folders and quickly search through them to recall anything
# AI Note Taker for Personal Notes:
- Skip typing - record quick notes and voice memos on the go and turn them into clear text
- Capture ideas fast with recording widgets and Siri voice commands
- Convert to accurate transcripts instantly with OpenAI Whisper
- Rewrite using AI styles like Clear Text, Proofread, Journaling, and more
- Organize your notes into folders like in any note-taking app
- Automate your workflow with integrations to Notion, Zapier, and Make
# Voice Typing for Emails and Messages:
- Dictate messages instead of typing, then refine with AI to your preferred style
- Start dictating with widgets or by saying “Siri, Dictate in VoicePen”
- Enhance text with AI styles: Proofread, Professional, Casual, Short, Elaborated
- Instantly translate dictations to any language
- Copy, paste, send, or share final output in any app
# Transcription and Summaries for any Audio and Video Files, YouTube, Podcasts, Zoom:
- Upload any audio or video file, or paste a link
- Get accurate transcriptions, AI summaries and key points in seconds
- Build your second brain — store and organize all audio / video content from the internet
----
** Multiplatform Access
- Works on iPhone, Watch, iPad, Mac, and Vision Pro
- Sync between devices securely with your private iCloud
- One subscription covers all your Apple devices
** Features
- Long recordings up to 2 hours each
- Speaker separation and transcript time codes
- Off-screen and Offline recordings with Live Activities
- Widget and Siri commands for quick recordings
- Files, Audios, Videos, Web Links, YouTube, Podcasts support
- Over 25 built-in ai rewrite options
- Personal rewrites with custom prompts
- Over 80 languages, translations, multi-language notes
- Folders and Search through all notes
- Share and export to other Apps, Pdf, Doc
- Zapier, Notion, Make, n8n integrations via webhooks
** Accessibility Built In
- Voice typing for motor difficulties
- Live transcription for hearing difficulties
** Privacy First:
- No audio or transcripts are stored on our servers
- Your recordings stay in your private iCloud
- We only collect anonymous usage analytics (like button taps)
** Supported languages:
Afrikaans, Arabic, Armenian, Azerbaijani, Belarusian, Bosnian, Bulgarian, Catalan, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, Galician, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Kannada, Kazakh, Korean, Latvian, Lithuanian, Macedonian, Malay, Marathi, Maori, Nepali, Norwegian, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Tagalog, Tamil, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu, Vietnamese, and Welsh.
** Up to 2-hour recordings and imports available with a Premium subscription
** Terms of Use
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
