bluejetty:00180539:ios.summary:
Widget Art Gallery allow you to view over 10,000 beautiful works of art on your home screen or today view.
Add an Art Gallery widget to your home screen and then choose to view pieces from a gallery, collections, favorites, or specific art
bluejetty:00180539:ios.description:
Widget Art Gallery allow you to view over 10,000 beautiful works of art on your home screen or today view.
Add an Art Gallery widget to your home screen and then choose to view pieces from a gallery, collections, favorites, or specific artwork. Add helpful overlays like time, date, battery, or add your own text.
In the app you can browse or search all of the included artwork from several of the world's best art galleries. Tap the play button to view a slide show containing pieces from the current gallery or collection. You can add any piece to your favorites list for easy viewing later in the favorites gallery or in a widget.
Featuring artwork from world famous galleries, such as the National Gallery of Art, Getty Museum, Art Institute of Chicago, Rijksmuseum, and Mauritshuis, as well as spectacular photos from NASA.
Widget Art Gallery is free to download and contains no ads. The free version allows the use of one widget. There is a one-time in-app-purchase that unlocks an unlimited number of widgets and helps support further development of the app. Please upgrade to Art Gallery Premium today.
Widget Art Gallery is available on iOS and macOS and its sister app TV Art Gallery is available for tvOS. Widgets are only available on iOS 14 and macOS 11 Big Sur and higher.

bluejetty:00069124:ios.description:
The GizmoHub app lets you locate, call and stay in control of your child’s wearable device. Speak, exchange messages and invite trusted contacts to communicate with your child, all while managing their Gizmo Watch and keeping their information safe.
GizmoHub lets you:
- Monitor your child’s location and receive alerts while they’re out and about.
- Call, text and video your child’s GizmoWatch easily.
- Ensure that only trusted contacts call or text your child’s GizmoWatch.

- Track your child’s steps and set up daily exercise reminders.
Download the GizmoHub app and get a little peace of mind along with it.
To get started:
1. Download the GizmoHub app on your smartphone.
2. Follow the instructions to create a GizmoHub account.
3. Pair your smartphone with the Gizmo Watch.

bluejetty:00126995:ios.description:
Get powerful tracking and analytics of your Instagram followers.

bluejetty:00037982:ios.name: Habit Tracker - HabitKit
bluejetty:00037982:ios.summary: Big life changes do not start big. They start with one small habit, done today, done again tomorrow. HabitKit turns those daily wins into a colorful grid of tiles, one square for every day you show up, so you can finally see yourself becomi
bluejetty:00037982:ios.description:
Big life changes do not start big. They start with one small habit, done today, done again tomorrow. HabitKit turns those daily wins into a colorful grid of tiles, one square for every day you show up, so you can finally see yourself becoming the person you want to be.
That visible progress is the whole secret behind HabitKit, a beautifully simple habit tracker. When your grid looks this good, you will not want to stop. Fill the tiles, protect your streak, and let consistency do the heavy lifting.
Whether you want to work out more, read every night, meditate, drink more water, save money, or finally quit smoking, HabitKit gives every goal the same simple loop: do it, log it, watch the grid grow. No guilt trips, just daily habit tracking that feels rewarding.
BUILD GOOD HABITS, QUIT BAD ONES
Create the habits you want to grow, or flip it around and quit a habit: every day counts as clean until you log a slip, and your streak counts your clean days in a row. You can even set a daily maximum, like two coffees a day, and simply stay under it instead of going cold turkey.
TRACK YOUR HABITS YOUR WAY
Check a day off with a simple yes or no, count reps like glasses or pages, or measure amounts with your own unit, like 2 L of water or 7.5 km of running. Set daily goals and flexible schedules that fit your routine: every day, specific intervals, or a number of times per week or month.
YOUR PROGRESS AT A GLANCE
Every habit gets its own tile grid, like a contribution graph, and every completed day fills in a square. See all your habits together on one dashboard, switch between Classic, Compact, and Split views, and share a beautiful snapshot of your progress when you hit a milestone. One glance tells you the whole story: what you did, what you missed, and how far you have come.
WIDGETS FOR YOUR HOME SCREEN
Put your favorite habits right on your home screen with small, medium, and multi-habit widgets. Your grids stay in sight, so your goals stay on your mind. Widgets follow your theme too, all the way to pure black dark mode.
REMINDERS AT THE RIGHT TIME
Get a friendly nudge exactly when you need it, and never forget a habit again. Add a daily check-in to review your whole day, and with Pro, up to three reminders per habit.
STATISTICS, STREAKS, AND NOTES
Watch your current streak grow, chase your best streak, and set streak goals for extra motivation. Dive into completion statistics and monthly charts, manage past days in the calendar, and add a short note to any day: what went well, what got in the way.
MAKE IT YOURS
Give every habit its own color and icon, or use any emoji. Organize your dashboard with categories and filters, reorder everything with drag and drop, and pick light, dark, or system theme, including a pure black mode for OLED screens.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-up. No ads. Your habit data stays on your device, and the app works completely offline.
HABITKIT PRO
HabitKit is free to use with up to four habits, including streaks, the calendar, notes, reminders, and exporting and importing backups. Pro unlocks unlimited habits, charts and statistics, home screen widgets, restoring archived habits, and up to three reminders per habit. Subscribe monthly or yearly, or pay once and keep Pro forever with the lifetime option. Every upgrade supports an independent developer. Start free, see if the grid pulls you in, and upgrade whenever you are ready.
You do not need a new life. You need one small habit and a place to see it grow. Download HabitKit and place your first tile today.
Terms of Use: https://www.habitkit.app/tos/
Privacy Policy: https://www.habitkit.app/privacy/

bluejetty:00044739:ios.description:
Most journal apps make you fill in someone else's template. Custom Journal is different: you build your own. Write your own prompts and questions, add rating scales and checklists, and end up with a journal that actually fits the way you think.
DESIGN YOUR OWN JOURNAL
• Build templates from questions, prompts, 1-10 ratings, multiple choice, checklists, and banners
• Not sure where to start? Pick from a library of built-in prompts for gratitude, reflection, and self-discovery
• Set templates to repeat, like a morning check-in every day or a review every Sunday
• Share templates you've made with friends
MAKE IT A DAILY HABIT
• One entry per day keeps journaling quick. Most people finish in 5 minutes
• Add photos to capture the moment
• Jump to any past entry from the calendar
• Dark mode and custom background images included
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your entries stay on your device, not on our servers
• Lock the app with Face ID or a passcode
• Back up and restore whenever you want
CUSTOM JOURNAL PREMIUM (7-DAY FREE TRIAL)
• Sync across your iPhone and iPad
• Turn your ratings and answers into charts and watch your progress over time
• Search everything you've ever written
• Export your journal as a PDF to keep or print
PERFECT FOR
Gratitude journaling, habit tracking, five-minute journaling, fitness and health logs, dream journals, travel diaries, daily planning
Start with a blank page, a built-in template, or a single prompt. However you begin, the journal you end up with is completely yours.

bluejetty:00105684:android.description:
When you wake up at the gates of Hell and you don't remember anything except that you have to find answers to your questions... And here they are, these answers, right here, outside the gates of Hell, it seems that you are in a situation "worse than ever". 
But what if the inferno we know isn't what it is? What if all the books on earth lie only to frighten simple mortals? What if demons are not fanged, tailed evil creatures, but friendly people (only with small deviations from earthly standards)? What if the pots of boiling resin are not designed to torture the sinners, but for SPA treatments. And what if the coolest and most incendiary parties are held in the Hell? 
Will you dare to come in? Will you have the courage to go through all the circles of Hell and conquer the friendship of the inhabitants of Hell with your perseverance and charisma? Are you smart enough to deserve the answers you're looking for? After all, for this, you need to perform personal tasks of demons and reach the Lucifer. You will have to use all available methods to get what you want: wit, intelligence, resourcefulness, humor, charm... what else do you have in store? Soul? Hahaha! Hold it for now. Here it is not the best-selling product (and damn the mortal who first came up with such nonsense).
Features of the game:
* Unusually colorful infernal locations
* Interesting tasks and incredible tests
* Charismatic demons with whom there is something to chat
* Exciting otherworldly story 
Still can't make up your mind? Don't be scared! Come on in and enjoy the game!

bluejetty:00157729:ios.description:
Packed!? is an extremely difficult puzzle game which has you guiding two punctual little friends on their journey to escape the depot one box at a time. 
Each box offers a fun, increasingly challenging puzzle to solve in as few moves as possible, as you push, slide and outsmart obstacles that stand between our friends and their path to freedom. They’re great listeners and will follow your direction in unison - for better or worse…
GAME FEATURES
* 120 carefully crafted levels of increasingly difficult puzzles.
* Rating system based on move count and elapsed time.
* A unique mechanic for each world you unlock.
* Simple controls. 
* No text. All communication is conveyed through visuals.
* No ads

Fishing
bluejetty:00180369:ios.description:
FishingBooker is the world's largest online platform for booking fishing trips. Whether you're planning a local outing or an international expedition, our app connects you with thousands of verified captains and charters worldwide.
Fishing Trips Worldwide
Book guided fishing trips in 2,000+ destinations. Whether you're staying close to home or heading somewhere new, find a fishing experience that fits your schedule, location, and style.
Verified Reviews
See what 3.4 million+ anglers are saying to help you find your perfect fishing trip.
Direct Communication
Message your captain directly to customize your trip and get real-time answers to your questions.
Seamless Booking
Book your next fishing trip from start to finish, right in the app. Browse trips, message captains, and lock in your booking – it’s quick, easy, and secure.
Real-Time Catches Feed
Explore recent catches from the FishingBooker community to inspire your next trip.
Loyalty Rewards
Complete a trip and you’ll join our Loyalty Program, unlocking tiered discounts of up to 20%. The more you fish, the more you save!
Why Choose FishingBooker?
We make it easy to find, compare, and book fishing trips – whether you're new to fishing or a seasoned pro. Booking your trip is fast, easy, and secure, so you can focus on what it’s really about: getting out on the water.

Ride the wind, blade in hand, ever charging onward! The new Wanderer class makes its debut! Eight classes venture into Penglai Wonderland and step into an ancient, mysterious world!

From an ancient realm comes the Wanderer—an expert in overwhelming area attacks, using mystical sword energy to pin down foes at range and win battles effortlessly. Promote your class to unlock signature skills and take to the skies with your sword! Switch between eight unique classes whenever you want! With every battle a new experience, there's always a playstyle perfect for you!
- Break Through Level Restrictions!
The new leveling system is here! Team up to challenge deadly foes, defeat Boundary Guards to level up, and say goodbye to boring quest grinding! Unleash the power of new M attributes! Massive damage boosts and new Battle Rating limits await in your next challenge!

 All-new Boundary Assembly gameplay—gather supplies, build fortifications, and sweep through enemies! Take part in preparations for the Boundary War and earn massive item rewards, even while offline!
 - Loads of Revamped Gameplay Features!
 [M Carrotte], [M Slime], [M Draconic Tales]... New modes, new challenges—stronger enemies are waiting for you!
- Collect Pets and Start Your Adventure
 You can capture every pet you encounter in this magical land! Each pet has its own unique evolution path! Raise them well and you might be in for a wonderful surprise! And they're not just for show—pets can explore, gather, farm, fish, and even cook for you! Catch 'em all and kick off your next big adventure!

bluejetty:00200094:ios.name: NostalgicPod
bluejetty:00200094:ios.summary: Remember when a music player was just that: a player? You would scroll the wheel, pick a song and listen. No algorithms deciding for you. No notifications. No endless feed. Just your music, in your pocket, NostalgicPod brings that feeling b
bluejetty:00200094:ios.description:
Remember when a music player was just that: a player? You would scroll the wheel, pick a song and listen. No algorithms deciding for you. No notifications. No endless feed. Just your music, in your pocket, NostalgicPod brings that feeling back, rebuilt from scratch for iPhone. A retro music player for your personal library, home media servers, internet radio and podcasts built in. The soul of a classic music player, with the engine of a serious modern app.
ALL YOUR MUSIC, ONE WHEEL
Bring your library from anywhere and play it all in one place. Import your own files through the Files app, Apple Music, iCloud Drive or whole folders, played in place, with no duplicates. Pull in the music already synced to your iPhone, songs and playlists included, with no subscription needed. Stream from your own server, Plex, Navidrome, Subsonic, OpenSubsonic, Jellyfin and Emby. Your old M3U playlists import automatically.
THE SOUND
Underneath the nostalgia is a serious audio player. FLAC lossless playback up to 24-bit/192 kHz with an automatic Hi-Res badge, gapless playback, and support for MP3, AAC, ALAC, FLAC, WAV, M4A, OGG and more. Server streams direct-play whenever possible, so lossless stays lossless. Shuffle with no unwanted repeats, plus Shuffle Albums for full records. Albums keep playing like the classics did: the last track flows into the next album. Plus star ratings and automatic playlists.
YOUR LIBRARY, YOUR RULES
No in-app purchases, no advertising, no tracking, no personal data collection. Your library stays on your device, and your own files play 100% offline. Pay once and keep it forever. You choose the music, NostalgicPod simply gives you a better way to enjoy it.
MORE THAN A PLAYER
Internet radio with stations from around the world. A full podcast player with RSS support and playback progress. A sleep timer. Classic games including Snake and Brick. Available in English, Spanish, Italian, German, French and Japanese. Audiobook support and additional customization are planned for future updates.
Your music. Your device. Press play.
NostalgicPod is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc. or any media server project. No account is required, and the app does not collect personal data.

bluejetty:00062597:ios.developer: 22LEARN Toddler and Baby Learning Games, LLC
bluejetty:00062597:ios.summary:
***** Parents‘ Choice Awards’ winner
***** Developed by an award-winning education studios, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling apps for kids, in cooperation with educational specialists to best prepare your children for success in pre
bluejetty:00062597:ios.description:
***** Parents‘ Choice Awards’ winner
***** Developed by an award-winning education studios, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling apps for kids, in cooperation with educational specialists to best prepare your children for success in preschool and kindergarten curriculum. 
Numbers, Patterns, Puzzles, Letters, Counting, Sizes, Shadows, Matching, Colors, Shapes, Differences and more -- you are on the right address! 
================================ 
BEST WAY TO PREPARE your kids for SUCCES in PRESCHOOL and KINDERGARTEN CURRICULUM! 14(!) great different exciting proven educational activities to develop your child's skills. 
================================ 
Its simple child-friendly interface offers children an engaging way to master essential preschool skills in the total of 14 (!) DIFFERENT EXCITING EDUCATIONAL ACTIVITIES (twelve educational activities + two creative activities). We sincerely hope your children will enjoy them all! 
PRESS REVIEW: 
* “Like most parents, I know that multitasking is a must, not just an option. That’s why I love kids’ apps that touch on tons of educational topics and do it in style. The new Abby – Basic Skills Preschool app is just such an app . . . Plainly, the tykes in my crew loved this app. Abby – Basic Skills Preschool app is a homerun” - bestappsforkids.com 
* “Completely kid oriented; no complicating menus to navigate, bright colors, fun characters, and prizes make this app extremely easy to use and engaging for young children. The variety helps to keep my three-year-old engrossed” - theiphonemom.com 
The ENTHUSIASTIC MONKEY CHARACTER is going to guide children through the whole game. As a reward after each round, children receive the opportunity to become creative artists and CHANGE THE DESIGN OF THE TRAIN, or obtain STICKERS TO SHOW OFF ON THEIR BOARD! 
================================ 
12 Educational games included 
================================ 
1) NUMBER RECOGNITION 
Number Matching is a fun way to encourage both counting skills and number recognition. It is a great kindergarten or preschool game that is educational without taxing the brain too much. 
2) COUNTING (Full version only)
Count the toys! Hearing the counting pronounced helps children to better remember the order of the numerals as well as get used to the counting procedure. Way to learn how to count! 
3) LETTERS 
Tap on the word that starts with the letter that was pronounced! Great for teaching children to realize the connection of letters to words, understand the position of the first letter, and practise matching the names of letters to their symbolic notation! 
4) PATTERNS 
Gives children practice in the area of common patterns recognition. 
5) SHAPES (Full version only)
Find the right shape! Teaches children recognition of names of common shapes (such as a square, rectangle, triangle and more). 
6) PUZZLES (Full version only)
Fix the broken toy! Enables your children to train fine motor skills and improve their logical thinking. 
7) SIZES (Full version only)
Trains understanding of the comparative nature of concepts of big, small and the same! 
8) MATCHING (Full version only)
Match the toys! Serves to train children's memory and understanding of the concept of the sameness. 
9) COLORS (Full version only)
Find the toy in a given color! Great both for children only beginning to learn and those who need additional practice. 
10) SHADOWS 
Drag the object to its silhouette! 
11) SAME AND DIFFERENT (Full version only)
Tests the ability of comparing pictures and finding differences. Select the different toy among several others or find the same toy as the displayed one. 
12) THINGS THAT GO TOGETHER (Full version only)
This part is designed to help kids learn and practice their ability to recognize things that go together and things that do not. 
Privacy policy: https://22learn.com/privacy_policy.html
Terms of use (EULA): https://22learn.com/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00157643:ios.name: Unscrew 3D - Pin Jam Puzzle
bluejetty:00157643:ios.summary: Get ready to dive into Unscrew 3D - Pin Jam Puzzle, a fun and brain-teasing 3D puzzle game that tests your problem-solving skills! This exciting game combines the thrill of sorting with tricky screw pin puzzles, making every level a true br
bluejetty:00157643:ios.description:
Get ready to dive into Unscrew 3D - Pin Jam Puzzle, a fun and brain-teasing 3D puzzle game that tests your problem-solving skills! This exciting game combines the thrill of sorting with tricky screw pin puzzles, making every level a true brain test. Your mission is simple yet addictive: unscrew colorful pins and sort screws into their matching boxes. But beware! The puzzles get harder, and only a true screw master can conquer them all.
How to Play:
- Look carefully at the screws stacked on different pins.
- Match the colors and move screws to their correct boxes.
- Sort all screws until each color is placed in the right box.
- Clear all boxes to win and become the ultimate screw master!
Key Features:
- Brain-Teasing 3D Puzzles: Every level is a test of logic and strategy! The deeper you go, the harder the puzzles become. 
- Colorful Visuals: Enjoy vibrant, 3D designs that make sorting screws satisfying and fun. 
- Relaxing Yet Challenging: Tap, drag, and unscrew pins with calming gameplay. The puzzles start simple but get hard to master, blending relaxation with brain challenges.
- Simple to Play: Just tap, drag, and sort screws by color.
- Endless Fun: With hundreds of levels and more added regularly, your 3D screw-sorting adventure never stops. Keep sorting, keep solving, and keep mastering every screw pin puzzle!
If you love 3D puzzles, screw pin puzzles, and brain challenges, this is the perfect game for you. Start playing now and see if you can unscrew, sort, and master every puzzle. Download Unscrew 3D - Pin Jam Puzzle today and become the ultimate screw master!

bluejetty:00016604:ios.summary: This is not a fleet battle to the death, but a fight for the tastiest pie! It's a challenge for those hardened in battles with lollipops and candies. A favourite board sea game of many a parent, is now available in a completely new version
bluejetty:00016604:ios.description:
This is not a fleet battle to the death, but a fight for the tastiest pie! It's a challenge for those hardened in battles with lollipops and candies. A favourite board sea game of many a parent, is now available in a completely new version for children. Don’t panic under fire in sea, as many sweets and delicious cakes await instead of a navy fleet, caramel instead of cannonballs.
Develop your own fun games strategy, and don’t give your opponents a shot at livin’ the dolce vita! Gather a team, and get an unforgettable battle in family games! For the very bravest kids, battles against AI players are available, with different levels of difficulty (you can always call your mom or dad for help!).
FREE GAME FEATURES
- Simple, classic rules
- Attractive graphics
- Entertaining soundtrack
FREE GAME RULES
Jolly Battle is played using the rules of a classic board sea game. The players do battle with a fleet of funny, animated cakes. Firepower is brought to bear through caramel bombs, which zero in on the cakes that the players take aim at. Players take turns to attack. So choose where to place your fighting cakes, and try to ‘chow down’ on the enemy fleet faster than the enemy can devour yours!

A favourite board sea game of many a parent, is now available in a completely new version for children. Don’t panic under fire in sea, as many sweets and delicious cakes await instead of a navy fleet, caramel instead of cannonballs.

Develop your own fun games strategy, and don’t give your opponents a shot at livin’ the dolce vita! Gather a team, and get an unforgettable battle in family games! For the very bravest kids, battles against AI players are available, with different levels of difficulty (you can always call your mom or dad for help!).

FREE GAME FEATURES

- Simple, classic rules
- Attractive graphics
- Entertaining soundtrack

FREE GAME RULES

Jolly Battle is played using the rules of a classic board sea game. The players do battle with a fleet of funny, animated cakes. Firepower is brought to bear through caramel bombs, which zero in on the cakes that the players take aim at. Players take turns to attack. So choose where to place your fighting cakes, and try to ‘chow down’ on the enemy fleet faster than the enemy can devour yours!

bluejetty:00123688:ios.description:
Once again, the Powers of Darkness have returned to threaten the Realm of Auria.
Join an epic journey to restore the honor of your guild and save your people, in this fantastic mix of adventure, role-playing, and strategy game.
Choose your adventurers from 10 unique classes and vanquish hordes of orcs, undead, evil sorcerers and a lot more.
Customize your heroes with more than 150 equipment options, learn powerful spells, and use all your strategy skills to defeat your enemies.
Play real-time multiplayer quests with your friends and players from all around the world.
Create and share your own quests! Infinite gameplay hours are guaranteed by the free level editor. 
FEATURES
- Loyal to the classic tabletop games: roll the dice, level up your heroes, acquire new abilities and purchase the best equipment
- Dive into an epic storyline including dozens of quests, find out the secrets of Auria and restore the honor of your guild
- Real-time multiplayer missions to play with other players to obtain great rewards
- Complete quests editor to publish and share your own quests, and play quests created by other players
- Fully translated into English, French, German and Italian
What Arcane Quest players are saying:
- “Excellent adaptation of the HeroQuest board game. Brings back many childhood happy memories.”
- “If you are looking to play a simple D&D board game for your phone, this is the game. Easy and fun, love it.”
- “If you have been looking for a fantasy board game this is the best.“
- “If you were a fan of Hero Quest, Dragon Strike or D&D, board games, this is the perfect app to bring you back.”

Hatch dinosaur eggs and feed baby dinosaurs; play basketball with tyrannosaurus! Play with sea lions and put on a sea show; deliver messages with pigeons and reach destination safely! 
Experience the four seasons
Bring delicious food and go on an outing in the woods; chase butterflies and have a picnic in the meadows; run a farm to harvest wheat and fruits; go skateboarding, build snowman, and have snowball fights in the snow!

bluejetty:00043730:ios.description:
The USSFCU app is like having a Credit Union branch at your fingertips. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what you can do with the USSFCU app:
• Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
• Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
• Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
• Transfer money between your accounts
• Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
• Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
• View and save your monthly statements
• Find branches and ATMs near you
• Aggregate your financial accounts
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode or biometric on supported devices.

bluejetty:00166388:ios.description:
Clue Master: Solve Crimes, Uncover Secrets, and Find the Criminal!
Enter the gripping world of Clue Master, a unique blend of brain games and logic puzzles where your deduction skills are put to the ultimate test. Dive into challenging mysteries to identify criminals, protect the innocent, and unravel complex webs of romance, family, and friendship entangled with betrayal. This is the perfect brain game for adults looking to challenge their IQ and enjoy cryptic crosswords, word puzzles, and mystery games all in one!
Features:
- Immersive Logic Puzzles: Each level presents unique clues, requiring sharp logic and deduction skills to piece together. Identify criminals, clear the innocent, and make tough calls that could save lives.
- Betrayal and Loyalty: Navigate puzzles where personal relationships play a central role—discover secrets of romance and betrayal, unravel tangled family trees, and uncover friends who deceive.
- Heart-Pounding Mysteries: Engage in suspense-filled scenarios with hidden hints that reveal not only the culprit but also motives of love, envy, and revenge, perfect for fans of detective games and clue games.
- Strategic Clue Gathering: Read clues carefully, pick up on subtle details, and think critically to solve each mystery. Whether you’re into problem-solving or riddles, one wrong move could lead to the wrong suspect or missed danger.
- Intense Crime-Solving Missions: Track down cunning criminals, gather evidence, and make careful decisions to bring them to justice. Each solved case brings you closer to becoming a master detective!
- Diverse Gameplay: With gameplay inspired by IQ tests, cross logic, and crypto brain puzzles, you’ll enjoy puzzles with increasing complexity that keep you guessing and thinking deeply.
- Captivating Storyline & Characters: Experience the thrill of finding "the one" who betrayed, dealing with the consequences, and exploring character stories woven with gossip, secrets, and romance.
Ready to solve the toughest cases, uncover hidden betrayals, and use your logic to save lives? Download Clue Master now and start your journey with cryptograms, memory games for adults, and word puzzles designed to challenge your brain!
Are you prepared to face the truth? Enter Clue Master and discover the secrets that lie beneath!
Visit https://lionstudios.cc/contact-us/ if you have any feedback, need help on beating a level, or have any awesome ideas you would like to see in the game!
From the Studio that brought you Hexa Sort, Family Tree, Wordle!, Match 3D, and many, many more!

bluejetty:00022998:ios.description:
Hello and welcome to the space program! Fly your galactic spaceship, avoid collisions with asteroids, gravity fields, dodge missiles & shoot back! Try to survive 2 Minutes in Space!
YOUR MISSION
You are an astronaut exploring the universe in your new spaceship in this fun 2D survival game. Fly to the Moon, Asteroid Belt, Nebulas and Gravity Fields. Navigate your spacecraft alone or with a personal fleet. Your main goal is to guide & manoeuvre your spaceship through challenging obstacles and survive at least 2 Minutes in Space! This simple arcade game will engage you to the fullest and turn your free time into an exciting space adventure, full of deadly battles and challenges!
SPACESHIPS / SPACECRAFT
As an astronaut you can choose one of 13 different spaceships equipped with lasers, guns & laser turrets. Different spacecraft have different speed, angles of rotation & ammunition. Collect gold pieces while flying in space & unblock your favourite spaceships! Dodge missiles sent by invisible space invaders, avoid collisions with asteroids & nebulas to survive!
COMPETE WITH OTHER PLAYERS
Play our space game and compete against your friends & other astronauts from all over the world! Check your own high score on the Leaderboard. Accept the challenge, live adventure and fulfil the mission!
TIPS & TRICKS
Control your spaceship with the joystick, whole screen or left/right buttons.
Check for red & blue triangles appearing on the screen. They signalise enemies or bonuses located in that direction.
Use bonuses like protection shields, space weapons, EMP (electromagnetic field), Speed Boost and other power-ups to help destroy & evade missiles.
Avoid incoming homing missiles aiming to terminate you, dodge missiles and make them collide each other to increase your final score.
Fly around the Moon to make missiles crush it with.
Are there still questions or doubts from your side? Contact us per email: contact@rarepixels.com or join us on Discord
2 Minutes in Space is an addictive survival game that will make you experience unforgettable adventures! Download it for free and start your own galactic survival! A trip to space has never been quite so tempting!
Escape the missiles, if you can!

bluejetty:00153036:ios.description:
The #1 viral digicam app on TikTok. 
Yes — this is the one you saw.
You know the look: hyper-saturated colors, direct flash, and that perfectly imperfect feeling that proves something actually happened in the room. People used to get outbid on eBay chasing an overpriced G7X. Now, it just lives in your phone. 
WayShot is an aesthetic photo editor and camera app for bold direct flash, rich color, subtle grain, warm portraits, and timeless black-and-white photography. Choose a camera style for the scene, then shoot or edit in a few taps.
FIVE CAMERAS. FIVE DISTINCT LOOKS.
DIGICAM — AFTER-DARK ENERGY
Bold flash, visible grain, saturated color, and a perfectly imperfect digital-camera feel. Made for nights out, parties, concerts, and late-night memories.
DIGILITE — VINTAGE COLOR IN DAYLIGHT
Lighter grain, warm color, and no-flash ease for travel, beach days, group photos, and casual photo dumps.
CLEAN GIRL — WARM, SOFT PORTRAITS
Soft-looking skin, balanced exposure, and golden-hour warmth for outfits, coffee runs, brunch, and everyday lifestyle photos.
B&W — TIMELESS MONOCHROME
High contrast, deep texture, and atmospheric black-and-white tones for portraits, street photography, and visual storytelling.
PROCAM — CLEAN, POLISHED FINISH
Refined color and crisp detail for profile photos, creator portraits, and editorial-style images.
WHY WAYSHOT
- Vintage digital camera and film-inspired looks
- Direct-flash, grain, warm color, and monochrome styles
- Shoot with the camera or edit photos from your library
- Clear camera choices for different lighting and moods
- Fast, one-tap workflow designed for iPhone
- Made for Instagram posts, photo dumps, portraits, travel, and everyday memories
FIND THE LOOK FOR THE MOMENT
Going out? Start with DigiCam.
Shooting in daylight? Try DigiLite.
Want a warm portrait? Pick Clean Girl.
Need a timeless frame? Go B&W.
Polishing a profile photo? Choose ProCam.
A single filter cannot fit every memory. WayShot gives each moment its own camera feel—without a complicated editing process.
Stay in the moment. Find your camera in WayShot.

Welcome to Digital Invitation, your ultimate companion for creating and sending stunning digital invitations effortlessly! Whether you're planning a birthday bash, a wedding extravaganza, or a corporate event, our app ensures your invitations stand out and leave a lasting impression. 
App categories:
1. Birthday Invitations:
Celebrate life's milestones with our vibrant and diverse collection of birthday invitation templates. From the excitement of a child's first birthday to the elegance of a milestone celebration, our designs cater to all ages. Choose playful and colorful themes for kids or opt for sophisticated and stylish designs for adult celebrations. Personalize with photos, favorite colors, and special messages to create an invitation that reflects the personality of the birthday honoree.
2. Wedding Invitations:
Capture the essence of love and commitment with our exquisite wedding invitation templates. From classic and timeless to modern and chic, our designs cater to every couple's unique style. Incorporate details like venue images, wedding colors, and personalized vows. Whether you're planning an intimate gathering or a grand celebration, our wedding invitations set the perfect tone for the most special day of your life.
3. Baby Shower Invitations:
Welcome the newest member of the family with our adorable baby shower invitation templates. Choose from cute and whimsical designs featuring baby animals, playful themes, or elegant pastels. Personalize with ultrasound images, baby bump photos, or the chosen nursery theme. Our baby shower invitations set the stage for a joyous celebration as friends and family come together to shower the parents-to-be with love and blessings.
4. First Communion Invitations:
Mark this sacred milestone with our thoughtful and reverent first communion invitation templates. Our designs capture the spiritual significance of the occasion with symbols like crosses, doves, and chalices. Choose from a range of elegant and simple designs that reflect the solemnity of the ceremony. Add a photo of the communicant and customize the text to convey the spiritual significance of this important event.
5. Baptism Invitations:
Celebrate the beginning of a spiritual journey with our baptism invitation templates. Our designs strike a balance between the solemnity of the occasion and the joyous celebration of a new life in faith. Opt for designs featuring water elements, crosses, or angels. Personalize with the date, venue, and a special message to create an invitation that beautifully reflects the sacredness of the baptism ceremony.
Each category is carefully curated to provide a range of options, allowing users to find the perfect invitation that aligns with the unique themes and sentiments of their events.

Elegant Designs: Choose from a vast collection of professionally designed templates to suit every occasion.

Instant Sharing: Forget snail mail – share your digital invitations instantly via text, email, or social media. Reach your guests wherever they are with just a few taps.
Environmentally Friendly: Go green with digital invitations! Reduce paper waste and environmental impact while still delivering a touch of class.
Why Choose Digital Invitation:
 User-Friendly Interface: Intuitive design makes creating invitations a breeze, even for tech novices.
 Time and Cost-Efficient: No more printing costs or postage fees, it is totally free. Save time and money with our hassle-free digital solution.
 Unlimited Creativity: Express your creativity without limits. Change designs as many times as you want until you find the perfect fit.
Make every event memorable with Digital Invitation. Download now and start crafting invitations that leave a lasting impression!

bluejetty:00016893:ios.name: Onkyo HF Player - Hi-Res Music
bluejetty:00016893:ios.summary:
***************************************************************************
*
* This app is a free download version "Onkyo HF Player".
* If you want to use the full-featured, purchase a paid version that supports family share,
* Or purchase
bluejetty:00016893:ios.description:
***************************************************************************
*
* This app is a free download version "Onkyo HF Player".
* If you want to use the full-featured, purchase a paid version that supports family share,
* Or purchase "HD library" of in-app purchase which can take over EQ and playlist.
*
***************************************************************************
Get greater control of how your iTunes music sounds with our touch-adjustable linear-phase FIR equalizer, which offers 16,384 discrete bands of high-definition equalization with zero loss in audio quality. Name and save your own custom EQ presets or select optimized filters created by professional musicians. You can upgrade to the HD Player Pack via in-app purchase and take your 192 kHz/24-bit Hi-Res Audio albums on the road with support for FLAC, WAV, and DSD enhanced for headphone use and fully supported on iPhone, iPod touch, and iPad.
Features 
• High-precision equalizer (16,384 discrete bands, linear-phase FIR filter)
• Selectable HD equalizer mode (64-bit)
• Automatic upsampling function
• Crossfade playback option
• Album artwork and song lyric display
• Repeat function (songs within a list)
• Resume Playback Function
• Shuffle function (within a list)
• Selectable equalizer presets optimized by musicians for Onkyo headphones
• Easily add songs to playlists and Up Next list
• Real-time DSD conversion function (supported on paid version only)
Note: Paid version enables playlists from both HD Library and iPod Library.
• Subscription music service AWA
 - Login, Music list(FOR YOU/ FOCUS/ FAVORITES/ TRENDS), Streaming Playback
• Link into Qobuz(where available) and download purchased music directly
Supported Formats 
Free Version (iPod Library)
• MP3/ALAC/AAC/WAV/AIFF (up to 48 kHz) 
*DRM-protected files are not supported.
Paid Version (HD Library and iPod Library)
• Above formats plus DSF/DSD-IFF [DSD(2.8 MHz) / Double-rate DSD(5.6 MHz) / Quad-rate DSD(11.2 MHz), DoP / PCM conversion], FLAC/ALAC/WAV/AIFF (up to 384kHz), Ogg-Vorbis (up to 192 kHz)
* MP3 not supported in HD Library.
Release Notes 
• Upgrade to HD Player Pack via in-app purchase and experience 192 kHz/24-bit high-resolution FLAC, WAV, and DSD playback
• Hi-Res Audio files can be output to the Onkyo DAC-HA200 headphone amplifier via Lightning cable, and to other compatible USB DACs using a Lighting-USB camera adapter or the iPad Camera Connection Kit
• Supports DSD-to-PCM conversion and DoP output
• Transfer audio formats including FLAC and DSD to your device via the iTunes Apps menu on your personal computer
• Audio with a sampling rate exceeding 88.2 kHz output via the device’s headphone connection is downsampled to 48 kHz. Equalizer and crossfade functions are disabled when playing audio via DoP, and frequency response is not displayed.
• The ad will be hidden.
Languages 
English, French, German, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese 
Requirements 
Requires iPhone/iPad with iOS 13.0 or later.

bluejetty:00024063:ios.name: Climbing Games: for Kids
bluejetty:00024063:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00024063:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
CLIMB MATHS
Press and hold your finger to go down the mountain! Sometimes press and release quickly to land faster.
It's one-touch mayhem!
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00047064:ios.description:
An award-winning 2016 indie game!
Sally is making her way to her childhood home in order to see her critically-ill father. So unfolds the journey of Sally, the girl for whom nothing can stand in her way.
A journey teeming with unbelievably-good fortune. Could Sally's luck be a mere coincidence?
Roll and jump throughout the journey home, revealing Sally and Father's past.
Description
Sally's Law is the opposite of Murphy's Law. Consider a particularly lucky moment of your life when everything fell into place, that is Sally's Law! It is that very notion of supernaturally good fortune - as though guided by some invisible force - upon which Sally's Law the Game was designed.
Follow along with Sally as she effortlessly rolls and leaps towards home. Discover Father's story through flashbacks along the way.
Immediately replay each scene as the spirit of Sally's Father, granting Sally the gift of a reality with extraordinary fortune.
Race...no, ROLL to solve a variety of puzzles!
Experience a unique puzzle-platformer, encountering a variety of fun tricks while at the same time enjoying a story.
***Notice
Sally's Law is optimized to run on iPhone4 or later. Please note it may not run properly on earlier versions or devices.
********************************************************
Awards
App Store Best of 2016
Busan Indie Connect Festival 2016 : Excellence In Narrative Finalist
OGN G-rank Seoul Award Grand Prix
The 17th Grand Prix in the Gamein
KOCCA 2016 Excellent Game of the Month
GIGDC 2016 Indie Game Awards : Gold Award 
Features
Story and Game: Experience the story first-hand as you play through the game.
2D Puzzle-platformer: Time your jumps while solving a series of puzzles!
Circles and Squares: Beautiful artwork encased in simple shapes.

- On-the-spot photo translation—snap a picture with your phone and get an instant AI translation 
- Real-time messaging translation—translate as you type in any of your favorite messaging apps
KEY BENEFITS
GET INSTANT VOICE & TEXT TRANSLATION
Make every conversation a breeze with real-time voice translation. In text-to-text mode, get helpful translation hints as you type—so you can communicate faster and more confidently.
SET TRANSLATION TONE AND SPEED 
Use AI Magic to choose а friendly, formal, or romantic tone for translated texts, and control how fast or slow the audio plays.

Use the extensive offline phrasebook to help you communicate anywhere, even without a connection
TALK TO ANYONE, ANYWHERE

Read menus, street signs, manuals for overseas purchases, and more when traveling in a foreign country with your AI language translator. 
TRANSLATE ANYTHING YOU SEE
Snap a photo to translate any text, just point your camera for instant real-time results, or use AR mode to tap and translate objects on the spot.
MAKE LANGUAGE LEARNING EASIER
Learn new phrases and hear correct pronunciations with this indispensable language learning tool for kids and adults alike.
TALK TO YOUR BESTIES
Have some laughs with our human-to-pet and pet-to-human modes (for entertainment purposes only).

listings.name: Voice Translator: AI Translate
listings.description:
Meet Voice Translator—an advanced AI translator that lets you communicate with anyone, anywhere.

With the power of AI, Voice Translator has delivered over 50 million translations for users worldwide—empowering people everywhere to communicate seamlessly at airports, hotels, gas stations, supermarkets, or anywhere else. It’s like having a live translator in your pocket! 

With Voice Translator, you get:
- Instant voice translations—just speak any phrase, and your AI language translator will pronounce the translation out loud
- On-the-spot photo translation—snap a picture with your phone and get an instant AI translation 
- Real-time messaging translation—translate as you type in any of your favorite messaging apps

KEY BENEFITS

GET INSTANT VOICE & TEXT TRANSLATION
Make every conversation a breeze with real-time voice translation. In text-to-text mode, get helpful translation hints as you type—so you can communicate faster and more confidently.

SET TRANSLATION TONE AND SPEED 
Use AI Magic to choose а friendly, formal, or romantic tone for translated texts, and control how fast or slow the audio plays.

GET COMMUNICATION HELP ANYWHERE
Use the extensive offline phrasebook to help you communicate anywhere, even without a connection

TALK TO ANYONE, ANYWHERE
Communicate with ease in 100+ languages and convert text from languages with non-Latin alphabets.

LEAVE LANGUAGE BARRIERS BEHIND
Read menus, street signs, manuals for overseas purchases, and more when traveling in a foreign country with your AI language translator. 

TRANSLATE ANYTHING YOU SEE
Snap a photo to translate any text, just point your camera for instant real-time results, or use AR mode to tap and translate objects on the spot.

MAKE LANGUAGE LEARNING EASIER
Learn new phrases and hear correct pronunciations with this indispensable language learning tool for kids and adults alike.

TALK TO YOUR BESTIES
Have some laughs with our human-to-pet and pet-to-human modes (for entertainment purposes only). 

Say goodbye to language barriers. Download Voice Translator today, and easily communicate with anyone, anywhere.

Our AI translator currently supports the following voice-to-voice languages:
Arabic (Saudi Arabia)
Catalan (Spain)
Chinese (Simplified)
Chinese (Traditional)
Chinese (Cantonese)
Czech (Czechia)
Danish (Denmark)
Dutch (Netherlands)
English (Australia)
English (Canada)
English (India)
English (United Kingdom)
English (United States)
Finnish (Finland)
French (Canada)
French (France)
German (Germany)
Greek (Greece)
Hebrew (Israel)
Hindi
Italian (Italy)
Japanese (Japan)
Korean (South Korea)
Norwegian Bokmål (Norway)
Polish (Poland)
Portuguese (Brazil)
Portuguese (Portugal)
Romanian (Romania)
Russian (Russia)
Slovak (Slovakia)
Spanish (Latin America)
Spanish (Mexico)
Spanish (Spain)
Swedish (Sweden)
Thai (Thailand)
Turkish (Turkey)
and more

FREE TRIAL
Get a free trial with access to all features and experience the power of our AI voice translator.

UNLIMITED ACCESS 
Subscribe to get unlimited access to all features within Voice Translator. Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, or annually, according to the plan chosen.

FAQ
Q: How do I use Voice Translator to translate a real-time conversation between two people?
A: Voice Mode makes it easy—just set both languages, tap the mic, and start talking! Your translation appears in the text field below.
Q: Do I need an internet connection to use Voice Translator?
A: 27 popular languages work offline! For all others, you'll need an internet connection.
Q: Does Voice Translator require a subscription or offer paid features?
A: Voice Translator is a subscription-based app, but you can try it out for free when you enable the free trial.

bluejetty:00180624:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00180624:ios.description:
Consulte veículos e preços FIPE com rapidez e precisão
O aplicativo Consulta Placa e FIPE é o app ideal para quem quer tomar decisões com segurança na hora de comprar, vender ou avaliar um veículo. Consulte informações pela placa, acesse a tabela FIPE, descubra se há registro de roubo ou furto, simule financiamentos e compare preços de combustíveis em todo o país.
Ideal para quem vai comprar, vender ou simplesmente quer entender melhor a situação de um veículo.
Principais funcionalidades:
Consulta de veículos pela placa
- Verifique rapidamente dados cadastrais, situação de roubo/furto e histórico de um veículo registrado em qualquer DETRAN do Brasil.
Tabela FIPE com histórico de preços
- Consulte valores médios de veículos por marca, modelo e ano com base na tabela FIPE, incluindo variações de preço ao longo dos meses.
Calculadora Flex
- Informe os preços de álcool e gasolina e descubra automaticamente qual opção é mais vantajosa para seu veículo.
Simulador de financiamento
- Faça simulações para entender o valor das parcelas e o custo total de um possível financiamento.
Preços médios de combustível por estado
- Veja os preços atualizados de álcool e gasolina em todos os estados e no Distrito Federal, com dados oficiais da ANP.
Histórico de consultas offline
- Consulte informações salvas mesmo sem internet, facilitando o acesso em qualquer momento.
Por que usar o Consulta Placa e FIPE?
- Visualização clara e organizada das informações.
- Ideal para quem deseja comprar veículos usados com segurança.
- Ferramentas úteis para motoristas e revendedores em um único app.
Observação:
Este aplicativo não possui vínculo com o DETRAN ou com o Sinesp, apenas utiliza dados públicos disponíveis para auxiliar o usuário nas suas consultas de forma prática e acessível.

bluejetty:00040562:ios.name: SailboatData
bluejetty:00040562:ios.summary:
The world’s most recognized database for production sailboat specifications.
This is the must-have app for those looking to purchase a sailboat as well as for DIYers, sailmakers, yacht brokers, marinas, riggers, and all other marine profes
bluejetty:00040562:ios.description:
The world’s most recognized database for production sailboat specifications.
This is the must-have app for those looking to purchase a sailboat as well as for DIYers, sailmakers, yacht brokers, marinas, riggers, and all other marine professionals.
Unlike our website, the app allows access to our database without the need for an internet connection.
After downloading, you can experience the full app functionality for the first 2 hours. After that, continue on with the free basic version or subscribe to keep full access. This costs as little as a good coffee (for a yearly subscription, our cheapest option) and supports us adding more useful features and extend the database.
The current features include:
• Scrollable list containing over 9,200 sailboat models.
• Side-by-side sailboat model compare.
• Scrollable lists with all designers, builders, and associations.
• The scrollable lists have an alphabetic index for quick access.
• Each list has a name search bar which updates the list as you type.
• Ability to select sailboats, designers, builders, and associations as your favorite.
• Toggle button to quickly switch between showing all or only your favorites.
• Ability to add your personal remarks for each sailboat model.
• Favorites and remarks are shared between all your devices using Apple iCloud.
• Refined search by LOA, LWL, Hull type, Keel type, Displacement, Beam, Draft, Rig type, Years Built and all our Ratios.
• Ability to sort the refined search results on any of the search parameters.
• Settings to personalize displayed units and other features.
As you scroll through the sailboat list and look at sailboat and designer details, the corresponding images are downloaded via internet. Once an image has been downloaded it is stored on your device; the maximum storage used is about 500MB.

bluejetty:00037834:ios.description:
Marrow Edition 8.5 is now live.
What’s inside Marrow Edition 8.5 
1. The best of Edition 8.5 Videos and more
Integrated conceptual content across all 19 subjects, curated by India's top medical faculty. Includes new World of Revision videos and Interactive MCQ Discussion Videos. The videos are fun & engaging, you won't be able to resist binge-watching them!
2. A supercharged QBank
Revamped QBank with a 60-30-10 approach - with 60% clinical questions, 30% application-based and 10% one-liners, improved Custom Modules & ‘Schema’ feature (all important topics in one place). Prepared in line with the changing exam pattern.
3. GTs that are as close to the real exam as possible
We observed a common trend among the top 10 rankers in NEET PG 2025 - they heavily relied on Marrow GTs to identify their weaker subjects before the exam. In Edition 8.5, GT Analytics has been rebuilt to give students a much deeper understanding of their preparation. Beyond the existing subject-wise performance view, students can now dive into topic-wise breakdowns, pinpointing exactly which topics need more attention.
4. Notes with 60% more high-quality images
An exciting set of Notes, based on Edition 8.5 videos. Includes high-quality images, original illustrations, tables & flowcharts, designed to be your primary handwritten notes. There is a lot to love in the Edition 8.5 Notes!
6. World of Revision videos & Interactive MCQ Discussion Videos
New special videos that will help you revise quickly. Contains topics that are strictly exam-focused.

bluejetty:00122204:ios.description:
TodoMovies - Your Ultimate Movie Companion
The most beautiful and comprehensive movie tracking app for iOS. Manage your watchlist, discover new films, and never miss a great movie again.
Smart Movie Management
• Create "To Watch" and "Watched" lists with ease
• Build custom collections like "Best Action Movies" or "Movies to Download"
• Rate movies and sort by your ratings
• Add watched dates and personal comments to track your movie journey
Rich Movie Information
• Browse by genres, in-theaters, and upcoming releases
• Explore curated lists by the TodoMovies team
• Detailed cast profiles with actor/director filmographies
• Bonus scene indicators for movies with post-credit content
Powerful Discovery
• Search-as-you-type through tens of thousands of movies and people
• Browse stunning edge-to-edge movie posters
• Watch HD trailers in fullscreen without leaving the app
• Browse movie photos and fan artwork in full-screen
Stay Updated
• Movie news feed with the latest industry updates
• Release notifications for when movies hit theaters
• Celebrity news and entertainment updates
Data Management
• Backup and restore your watchlists as a single file
• Restore from clipboard for easy data transfer
• No accounts required - your data stays private
Global Experience
• Localized in 11 languages
• Global release dates and localized trailers
• iTunes Store integration for movie-related downloads
Why TodoMovies?
Featured by Apple, Empire Magazine, 9to5Mac, AppAdvice, and BeautifulPixels, TodoMovies puts movie artwork front and center with its stunning iOS design. Whether you're a casual moviegoer or a film enthusiast, our app helps you discover, track, and enjoy movies like never before.
Perfect for:
• Movie enthusiasts who want to track their viewing history
• Film buffs looking to discover new releases and classics
• Anyone who wants to organize their movie watching experience
• Users who appreciate beautiful, intuitive iOS design

bluejetty:00121569:ios.summary: Your TV. Always with you. With Live TV, you can watch German and international television on your iPhone and iPad – at home and on the go. Discover channels and see at a glance what’s currently playing. LIVE TV, EASY EVERYWHERE. News, sport
bluejetty:00121569:ios.description: Your TV. Always with you. With Live TV, you can watch German and international television on your iPhone and iPad – at home and on the go. Discover channels and see at a glance what’s currently playing. LIVE TV, EASY EVERYWHERE. News, sports, series or entertainment: Choose from over 200 TV streams and find your favorite channels with search, favorites and filters by language, country and topic. The Live TV quote shows you which programs are particularly popular right now. PAUSE, REWIND, CONTINUE WATCHING. With Timeshift, you can pause and rewind supported streams. The clear timeline helps you find a specific point or a program that is already running. TELEVISION IN PORTRAIT FORMAT. Adjust the size of the TV picture. On the iPhone, you switch between the channel list and program details under the running picture. Smart Zoom helps you follow the action even with a narrow image section. YOUR CHANNELS DIRECTLY IN VIEW. With widgets for the Home and lock screen, you can see what’s playing on your channel. Additional widgets show your favorites, popular channels or open your saved TV Wall. FOUR CHANNELS SIMULTANEOUSLY. With TV Wall 4x, you can keep up to four streams in view and switch to the channel that currently interests you. THE WAY YOU WANT TO WATCH TV. • Continue watching while using other apps with picture-in-picture. • Stream supported streams via AirPlay to a larger screen. • Adjust picture quality and data consumption to your connection. • Select available subtitles and audio tracks. • View program information and discover more about the connection to TV Pro and TV Pro Mediathek. In addition, Live TV offers an integrated clip editor with precise editing tools and customizable image formats. Live TV does not add its own commercials when changing channels. The streams come directly from the channels; advertising within the broadcast program remains. You can try a selection of channels without registration. Additional channels and features are available via in-app purchases. You need an internet connection. Channel availability, picture quality and available functions depend on the respective source and your package. Widgets require iOS 17 or later. Privacy and terms of use: https://www.tvproapp.de/rechtliches/

bluejetty:00084155:ios.summary:
Receiptify offers an innovative way to showcase your favorite Spotify tunes by generating a music receipt displaying your top 10 songs over various periods: the past month, the last six months, or all-time.
This user-centric app not only p
bluejetty:00084155:ios.description:
Receiptify offers an innovative way to showcase your favorite Spotify tunes by generating a music receipt displaying your top 10 songs over various periods: the past month, the last six months, or all-time.
This user-centric app not only personalizes your music experience but also makes it shareable on social platforms like Instagram. To dive in, head over to the Receiptify homepage, sign in using your Spotify credentials, and authorize the necessary access. After a brief data processing period, you'll be able to admire and share a unique receipt that mirrors your musical journey.
Receiptify for Spotify goes beyond being merely visually appealing by offering valuable insights into your listening patterns, appealing to fans of Spotify and Apple Music alike. This platform caters to those eager to flaunt their musical taste on social media or those just interested in exploring their listening habits. 
Explore Insights into Your Musical Preferences!
Everything about your music, consolidated:
-Dive into your favorite tracks, artists, albums, and genres.
-Discover your listening habits, including the time of day you're most likely to listen.
-Measure your engagement through play counts and the total time you've spent streaming.
-Identify the mood of your music, whether it's upbeat, energetic, and more.
Unleash a treasure trove of data and engaging visuals.
Show Off to Your Friends
Not just for solo exploration, but also for social comparison. Look up your friends' profiles, add them to your list with Receiptify Spotify, and see how your musical tastes stack up against theirs!
-Embark on a Personal Musical Exploration
-Get in-depth and precise statistics for your most cherished songs, artists, or playlists:
-Track play counts and listening duration.
-Gauge the popularity of any song, artist, or playlist on Spotify.
-For artists and albums, discover which tracks you play the most.
Understand the vibe of your music—whether it's lively, danceable, instrumental, and beyond.
-Identify the biggest fans of a song, artist, or album.
-Access a comprehensive overview of your all-time streaming history for specific songs, artists, or albums.
-Plus, indulge in even more detailed stats and captivating charts.
With a commitment to user privacy, Receiptify for Spotify doesn't retain your streaming data and safeguards your information with robust encryption. This ensures a safe and personalized experience for users looking to create unique music receipts that reflect their audio preferences without risking their privacy.
Disclaimer:
To utilize our music statistics application, we need your authorization to interact with the Spotify application on your device and the associated account. This access enables us to monitor your music listening activities, and also permits the creation of playlists and direct playback of tracks within Spotify.
NOTE: Please be aware that this application is independent and not affiliated with Spotify AB or its subsidiaries in any manner.
Subscription Terms for Receiptify Spotify:
Please note that when you subscribe through Apple, your payment will be processed and charged to your App Store Account upon confirmation of your purchase. Your subscription will renew automatically unless you turn off the auto-renew feature at least 24 hours before your current subscription period ends. Your account will be charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, at the price of the plan you have selected. You can manage your subscriptions and auto-renewal settings by accessing your App Store Account Settings after making a purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.receiptify.us/terms-of-use-for-receiptify/
Privacy Policy: https://www.receiptify.us/privacy-policy-for-receiptify/

bluejetty:00074603:ios.description:
ATI TEAS & NCLEX RN/PN app will help you increase your NCLEX score and past exams successfully. Access to 2000+ exam questions with detailed explanations. Each prep test or practice NCLEX test section contains enough questions that the test can be retaken and will be different each time, so you can practice test as many as you need.
Features:
NCLEX PRACTICE QUESTION
Practice over 2000+ NCLEX RN and NCLEX PN nursing test questions for your test prep and review. Customize how many free practice questions you want to study regards to your study schedule. All practice questions include detailed explanations so that you can learn from your mistake.
Covered NCLEX-RN and NCLEX-PN practice questions by 8 major categories: 
--Health Promotion and Maintenance
--Safe and Effective Care Environment 
--Management of Care/Coordinated Care
--Safety and Infection Control 
--Psychosocial Integrity 
--Basic Care & Comfort
--Pharmacological Therapies
--Reduction of Risk Potential
--Physiological Adaptation 
This app also include 1000+ nursing practice questions covering a wide range of nursing topics for HESI A2, ATI TEAS 6th exam-like questions. 
Covered TEAS ATI 6TH practice questions by 4 major categories:
English and language usage
Mathematics
Reading
Science
Covered HESI A2 practice questions by 7 major categories:
Mathematics
Biology
Chemistry
Anatomy and Physiology
Reading 
Vocabulary
Grammer
PRACTICE TEST
ATI TEAS & NCLEX RN/PN app provides different test level and follows the same format and structure as the computerized version of the real exam. After you finish the CAT format national council licensure examination for practical nurses test, NCLEX app will show detailed explanations of wrong answers and help you track your progress and performance to improve your skills
PREMIUM 
You can access following advantages as a paid subscriber of premium, free version will have limited number of practice questions. Paid subscription is required to access all practice question, quiz and exams.Unlock 1000+ ATI TEAS 6th and other nursing school questions, build custom own quiz and study each subject, access all exam simulator helps you pass exam easily
CUSTOM QUIZ
There are numerous resources, tips and quick quiz you can take to help you prep for the exam. Take quick quiz on the go, use quiz to measure your knowledge and ability in different sections. There are numerous connect resources, tips and quick quiz you can take to help you prep for the exam. Take quick union test prep on the go, use quiz to measure your knowledge and ability in different sections. It also contain quiz screener feature, which enable you create personal quizzes as many as you want. 
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at the confirmation of purchase. Accounts will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan above. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of the term will be forfeited once purchased.

bluejetty:00187510:ios.name: LinkedIn: Community & Network
bluejetty:00187510:ios.summary: Welcome professionals! The key to getting in is getting started. Begin your career journey with LinkedIn today. Are you searching for the right job opportunities to advance your career? LinkedIn is one of the largest social networking apps
bluejetty:00187510:ios.description:
Welcome professionals! The key to getting in is getting started. Begin your career journey with LinkedIn today. Are you searching for the right job opportunities to advance your career? LinkedIn is one of the largest social networking apps for online job searches that also provides content that can help you grow. 
Build your resume, nurture your professional relationships, connect with recruiters, and apply for your next job. You can establish job alerts for local or remote positions, expand your network of business contacts, stay informed about the latest industry news, read articles, and stay up-to-date with companies and industry leaders to enhance your workplace and career- builder experience.
Get business insights before you apply for the job, including company information and job responsibilities. Then quickly and safely apply to any position through the LinkedIn app with your resume or professional profile.
Why You’ll Love the LinkedIn App:
- Job search and recruiting: Research companies you’re interested in and find positions suited to your skills, then apply to a new job with your LinkedIn profile or resume.
- Resume builder: Create your online resume, showcase your experiences, and highlight your skills to enhance your career opportunities.
- Business news: Get relevant news delivered to you and join the conversation.
- Professional network: Create your profile, update your resume online, and make connections.
LinkedIn App Features:
JOB SEARCH
• Find jobs and connections through your LinkedIn network.
• Search for opportunities and set up job alerts for companies that are currently hiring.
• Job openings: Submit job applications across a wide range of professions and secure interviews for your dream job.
• Find local jobs in your area or online opportunities that let you work from home.
• Job App: Easily apply for jobs and set up job alerts for any full-time or part-time jobs you might be interested in.
BUSINESS NEWS AND INSIGHTS
• Stay up-to-date by following business news and company content from related industries.
• See what your connections are saying in posts and conversations.
• Share articles and newsworthy topics with your LinkedIn community and business contacts.
SOCIAL NETWORKING
• Utilize LinkedIn's profile-building tools to enhance your connections and expand your social network for career growth.
• Connect with members from across the globe on the world's largest social network.
BUILD YOUR BUSINESS COMMUNITY
• Easily find groups or communities that share your interests on LinkedIn.
• Network on the go: Connect with new contacts and industry experts.
• Follow companies, top voices, and professionals.
• Social networking for businesses: Gain new opportunities through showcasing your company or product.
RESUME AND PROFILE
• Job finder: Apply for jobs using your LinkedIn profile.
• Social network: Build your professional profile and make business connections.
• Resume: Create your online CV and use it as a resume for job applications.
Whether you're seeking new job opportunities, aiming to expand your business network, or staying updated on the latest business news and industry buzz, LinkedIn has you covered.
Want to make the most of LinkedIn? Upgrade to a Premium subscription for exclusive tools.
We ask for a few permissions when you use this app. Here’s why: http://linkd.in/1l0S8Y
-
LinkedIn members have the option to verify their identity by securely uploading a government ID and/or taking a live selfie using certain trusted partners. For more information about the data collected by our trusted partners through this process and the periods for which it will be retained, see: https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a1359065

bluejetty:00175127:ios.description:
Tired of cooking the same 3 meals on repeat? Zest integrates a mind-blowing cooking education into your routine. Learn to cook with us through step-by-step explanations of foundational cooking concepts in fewer than 10 minutes and dishes that bring the concept to life. Our recipes are created by two former Michelin star chefs, distilled by a home chef, and cooked by you, the superstar home cook that you are (or will be). We don't assume any prior culinary knowledge. We meet you where you are and help you improve.
Stop copying traditional recipes - start learning from Zest. We've cooked those delicious Bon Appetit dinners. But when we took away the recipes we felt like lost puppies. Zest is designed to teach you the how's and why's of cooking. So when the recipe is gone you can confidently navigate the kitchen. The promise: Taste improvement after one dinner with Zest.
FEATURES:
STEP-BY-STEP INSTRUCTIONS
We've all tried cooking a TikTok recipe. You rewatch the video 13 times to figure out what the hell is going on. Zest embeds videos throughout recipes so you can click into content when you need it. No more pausing and restarting. Learn at your own pace.
CONCEPT VIDEOS
Watch a short video on a new concept at your own pace and then cook recipes that reinforce what you've learned. We dive into topics like the science of tasting and the basics of seasoning, sautéing, roasting and more!
SKILL VIDEOS
Don't know how to dice an onion? Don't be embarrassed, we got you covered. Skill videos are linked in each recipe to guide you along, so you don't have to watch Gordon Ramsey on YouTube (we love his accent too).
CURATED MENU
Choose a menu to fit your preferences. Tired of wasting produce? Search for dishes including what’s already in your fridge. Got allergies? Compile safe recipes in your menu to find them when you’re ready to get cooking. 
GROCERY LIST
Shop your menu with our automated grocery list. Plus, utilize our helpful tips while you shop. Don't know what a neutral oil is? We got you covered.
PERSONALIZED RECOMMENDATIONS
Rate the recipes you cook, so we can recommend similar ones.
Feedback? Technical Issues? Killer ideas you want to contribute to make our app better? Email us at support@zestapp.co. We're always here to help and would love to chef up new ideas together!

bluejetty:00169701:ios.description:
DogCat App – The Ultimate Free Pet Care Tracker Tailored to Furry Friends, Schedule, Track and Record, Dogs Cats & More.
Welcome to DogCat App, a one-stop solution for managing animal health plus happiness of beloved dogs & cats. Created out of love for animals, this comprehensive pet care tracker meets every need of dogs or cats, ensuring they receive optimal care.
Empowering Pet Parents through a Comprehensive Pet Care Tracker and a beautiful gallery of pictures.
For pet parents, maintaining a dog & cat's demanding schedule can be challenging. DogCat App simplifies life, providing an intuitive pet care tracker via a calendar managed like an agenda. This feature-rich application includes personalized schedules, daily reminders, health records, plus activity logs for pets and the best part: it is free!
Keep Track of Pet Vaccinations & Health
Health management is key to pet well-being. DogCat App provides a detailed health log with a vaccination tracker, ideal for dogs along with cats. Users can document, then track all health aspects, starting with initial puppy vaccinations through regular adult check-ups. The same applies to kittens. With a vaccination reminder feature, this app ensures vaccines are administered on time, keeping animals safe and healthy.
Diet, Weight, Symptom Tracker
Maintaining a balanced diet plus a healthy weight is crucial for animals. The DogCat App's diet & weight tracker assists in monitoring a pet’s nutritional intake, facilitating focus on weight changes. Additionally, the symptom tracker aids in identifying potential health issues early, guaranteeing timely veterinary care.
Vaccines & Medication Agenda Schedule
Scheduling medication (meds) can be overwhelming. DogCat App offers a convenient free calendar to schedule reminders for medication or pills, vaccines etc, making pet care hassle-free.
Enhance Animal Lives Through Tailored Features
This App goes beyond basic pet care. Track pet's growth milestones, manage breeding information, and keep a log of daily activities like pee, poop & potty habits.
Capture & cherish every moment with our pet monthly pictures gallery, our automatic reminder will help and you will see it in the agenda.
Beyond Pet Care: An Organizer Tailored to Every Pet Parent
Its not just a pet care tracker; it's an organizer for every facet of animal life. Schedule pet's activities, oversee breeding cycles, and manage all your duties as foster parent, breeder or shelter in a calendar view.
Dont forget to attach a photo to the events so you can check later.
The Trusted Partner in Pet Care
A single commitment: ensuring animals enjoy a healthy, happy, organized life. This app includes features specially designed for dog and cat care, positioning it as the ultimate choice for furry family members.
More than 21 pet species
This app also supports tracking medical health care records of: hamsters, guinea pigs, rabbits, ferrets, chinchillas, mice, rats, hedgehogs, sugar gliders, birds, lizards, snakes, turtles, tortoises, frogs, crabs, insects, spiders, fish, cattle, cows, horses
Download DogCat App today – your animal's health and happiness are just a click away and is free!
Terms of service: https://dogcat.app/terms_of_service
Privacy Policy: https://dogcat.app/privacy_policy
