bluejetty:00182888:ios.description:
During World War II, weapon development advanced rapidly in all areas, including ship building, military aircraft and vehicles, artillery and small arms. At the beginning of the war, the rate of evolution was gradual, based in large part on lessons learned during the First World War. However, just six years later, the face of warfare was transformed significantly by the arrival of jet aircraft and nuclear weapons.
Test your knowledge on World War II weapons. The app includes all the important armoured fighting vehicle, military aircraft, firearm and battleship from each nation which took part in the conflict. Challenge yourself to see how many you can recognize!
SIMPLE, FUN AND ADDICTIVE
Hundreds of questions with different levels of difficulty await you. Do you think you can beat all of them?
DETAILED INFORMATION ON EACH WEAPON
Service history and technical details provided for each weapon.
HELP TOKENS TO THE RESCUE
If you get stuck on a level, you have three types of tokens at your disposal to help you reach the next one: reveal a single letter, remove extra letters or skip the level.
WEAPON GALLERY

Strategic Merge Meets Epic Combat
Build
bluejetty:00167049:ios.description:
Merge! Battle! Explore! Survive! 
Step into the fast-paced, brain-tickling world of Mini Merge Champions—a thrilling blend of strategy, puzzle, and action where every move can mean victory or defeat!
Strategic Merge Meets Epic Combat
Build your squad by merging heroes on the battlefield. Smarter formations win tougher battles—are you clever enough to crack the perfect lineup?
- Think fast, merge faster: Upgrade your heroes!
- Every move counts in this real-time puzzle-combat hybrid.
Heroic Battles & Unique Abilities
Unleash a roster of diverse champions, each with wild, game-changing abilities! From fire-wielding warriors to support heroes that turn the tide, your choices define your strategy.
- Create deadly synergies and custom battle styles.
- Deploy heroes with tactical ultimates to crush waves of enemies.
Find & Upgrade Legendary Heroes
Earn chests full of surprises and unlock new champions, each with their own skills and upgrade paths.
- Constantly power up your team.
- Discover rare, epic, legendary heroes and max out their potential.
Epic Boss Fights & Wild Enemies
Face off against monstrous bosses and unpredictable enemy squads in high-stakes combat encounters. Only the strongest strategies survive!
- Battle evolving enemies with randomized attack patterns.
- Outsmart tricky bosses.
Tower of Trials: Roguelike Chaos
Climb the Tower—a roguelike gauntlet of increasingly difficult floors with random buffs and rewards.
- Each run is unique: Different modifiers every floor.
- Outstanding rewards for conquering each tier.
Piggy Dungeon: Gold Rush Time!
Enter the Piggy Dungeon—a limited-time mode where gold rains and chaos reigns.
- High risk, high reward gameplay.
- Maximize your haul and fuel massive upgrades.
Are you ready to merge your way to glory? From casual strategists to hardcore roguelike fans, Mini Merge Champions offers a constantly evolving battlefield full of decisions, depth, and explosive action.
Download now and become the ultimate Merge Champion!

bluejetty:00131950:ios.description:
Welcome to this amazing Differences Journey and enjoy traveling around the world through Find the Difference games!
Are you good at spotting the very hard differences between two things in your daily life? Do you always have confidence in your concentration power and sharp eyesight? Have you dreamed of discovering the rest of the world without leaving your home? How about training your mind with the help of a global Differences journey in loads of beautiful and attractive photos? 
This game caters to all and would be a perfect choice for you! Get ready for a brain-challenging adventure around the world and become an expert at finding and seeking all differences!
Game Features - Why you should choose the Differences Journey
- Brain Trainer and Attention Booster. Improve your detective and observation skills while finding the differences.
- Free to Challenge! Enjoy this picture puzzle for free anytime & anywhere.
- Simple and clear rules to follow. Examine all differences side by side and tap on the spots to mark them on the given image.
- No Timer in Gameplay. Relax and take your time to inspect each difference and hidden object.
- Unlimited Hints. Use the hint button when you are looking for a clue or get stuck.
- Zoom functionality. Enlarge images to observe the small elements and items more easily.
- Plenty of high-quality images! Related to various topics: architecture, landscapes, animals, drinks, cuisine, customs, and more which will make your gaming experience more enjoyable.
- Different Difficulties. Unlock tons of challenges from easy to hard levels.
- Spot the differences during a World Tour. Start your World Travel which is designed in this Seek & Find Game in a set number of popular Most Popular Travel Destinations.
- Powerful stress buster for adults and kids. An excellent stress relief game to practice mindfulness and bring you peace of mind.
As a Find Differences game and photo hunt puzzle, this FREE and addictive game app is designed to develop your memory, focus, and thinking. What you need to do is to compare 2 thematic pictures and find all differences between them. What is distinct between the two items? Some of these are easy to detect, while some are relatively difficult to spot. Be a detective and come to seek as many details as you can!
Ready to start this Differences journey? Now download the game and create your travel route in the relaxed Find the Differences games!
Privacy Policy: https://d2.gurugame.ai/policy.html
Terms of Service: http://gurugame.ai/termsofservice.html

bluejetty:00077059:ios.name: Turmoil+
bluejetty:00077059:ios.summary: Turmoil+ offers players a visually charming, tongue-in-cheek take on the simulation genre inspired by the 19th century oil rush in North America. Get a taste of the rush and rivalry of the time as you earn your way to become a successful oi
bluejetty:00077059:ios.description:
Turmoil+ offers players a visually charming, tongue-in-cheek take on the simulation genre inspired by the 19th century oil rush in North America. Get a taste of the rush and rivalry of the time as you earn your way to become a successful oil entrepreneur. As you make money digging up and selling oil, the town will grow along with you.
Lease land at the town auction and search for oil. Build a rig, create an efficient pipe network and bring up the oil to store it in silos. Sell the oil at the best times to maximize profits. Then buy essential upgrades in town to cope with rock, gas and ice. Acquire more town shares than your competitors in a bid to become the new mayor.
- A campaign where you build your rags-to-riches oil baron career and beat your rivals.
- Dozens of upgrades and new tools to improve your oil mining operations.
- Maximize your profits by using natural gas to boost the oil price.
- Outbid your competitors at the stock auction.
- Meet the town’s characters in the saloon and make shady business deals.
- Play single game mode to get one of literally millions of procedurally generated levels and earn as much as you can in one year.
Turmoil+ - The Heat Is On is a new campaign with tons of oil to dig up and convert into cash! It is designed to make you feel right at home, but at the same time offer lots of new mechanics and fun features. Here's what you can expect!
- A new town (and mayor!) and a new oil-rich map divided into three areas.
- In each area, new drilling mechanics are introduced, powered by a new underground substance: magma.
- You'll see familiar faces like Edward and Fred and William. They brought their goods with them in train wagons, so you can instantly stock up on all your favorite drilling gear.
- There are also new people, like Philip, who runs a shady card game in the saloon.
- Jack is a new character that runs a magma tools operation from his shed. He likes chicken.
- Anthony is also back from last time. Instead of dealing in diamonds, he has his own store where you can sell and buy all sorts of underground treasures.
- The new mayor is not quite like the old one. His tips are free, and he uses a different auction system. But shares still cost money!
- There's a cat walking around the village! He doesn't do a whole lot, but what can you expect from these creatures?
- And last but not least: a couple of brand new music tracks!
The metagame in this new DLC-campaign offers more depth. Instead of diamonds, a total of 9 underground treasures are available. Collecting them all (by trading or digging them up) will offer great benefits. Besides this, the village offers even more things to do, like playing a card game for money.

bluejetty:00063398:ios.description:
[FrameMagic] enables you to create awesome photo collage, video collage and video slideshow within just a few seconds with tons of layouts, endless options, colors, patterns, powerful text editor, beautiful filter effects, flexible play options, musics and narrations.
[FrameMagic] also supports powerful and intelligent photo editors including object removal, soft skin, dark light, bokeh, sticker, silhouette, outline, hole, background blur, motion blur and color splash.
[FrameMagic] also supports magical funny photo editors including face morphing, crystal(refracted) text and pic warping effect.
[Photo Collage]
• The ultimate photo collage layouts.
- Grid : Combine multiple photos with hundreds of rectangular and polygonal layouts.
- Auto : Create fully automatic collage with a single tap.
- Blended : Blend multiple photos and create stunning collage.
- Free Style : No limitation on how you add and arrange your photos.
- Vertical Stitch : Combine multiple photos into one long. storytelling collage.
- Squared : Create squared photo and video optimized for Instagram.
- Montage: Create montage photo collage with powerful object masking tool.
- 3D Free Style : Free style collage with 3D perspective layouts.
- 3D Mesh : 3D meshed collage with beautiful mesh layouts.
• Load multiple photos at once.
• Unique decoration with rounded corner, margin, border, shadow.
• Background colors and patterns.
• Gradient and shape background color.
• Powerful text editor and beautiful stickers.
• Download and install custom fonts from free font servers.
• Edit photo with aviary photo editor.
• Easy width and height ratio.
• Portrait and landscape mode.
• Save and share in HD (up to 3600x3600).
[Intelligent Photo Editor]
• Object Removal : Remove unncessary objects from your photo in single step.
• Sticker Generation : Create sticker and montage with powerful object masking tool.
• Silhouette Effect : Create beautiful silhouette effect.
• Outline Effect : Create beautiful outline and edge effect.
• Hole Generation : Create holed image and montage.
• Background Blur : Create manual depth blur effect. (aka portrait photo)
• Motion Blur : Create manual panning photography.
• Color Splash : Create selective color and greyscale effect.
• Soft Skin : Create soft skin effect.
• Bokeh : Create circular and hexagonal background bokeh effect.
• Dark light : Create selective light and darkness effect.
[Video Collage & Slideshow]
• 101 rectangular layouts with up to 9 videos
• Photo slides with your own photos
• Video in video with up to 5 videos (PIP)
• Load multiple videos at once
• Trim each video at any time and size
• Apply beautiful filters to each video
• Adjust audio volume of each video
• Add your own song as background music
• Adjust audio volume and start/end time of background music
• Unique decoration with rounded corner, margin, border, shadow
• Background colors and patterns
• Gradient and shape background color
• Powerful text editor and stickers
• Easy width and height ratio
• Portrait and landscape mode
• Save and share in HD (up to 1080x1080)
[Fun Photo Editors]
• Create face morphing effect.
• Add refracted text effect.
• Create warp in/out effect.
[Subscription for Unlocking all features]
- You can subscribe for unlimited access to all features offered for purchase within FrameMagic.
- Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually. Alternatively, you can purchase each item for the life time access.
- Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/site/mobilabios/terms-of-use
- Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/site/mobilabios/privacy-policy

Are you ready to take the 30 day chest challenge? Build a bigger, stronger chest at home with no gym and no equipment — just your own bodyweight. Start training today and see real results in 4 weeks.
This program targets the three key areas of your chest — upper, lower and inner pecs — with a progressive push-up plan built for men. Just 10 minutes a day is enough to build muscle and add serious upper-body strength.
Every day brings a new chest workout, so training never gets boring and your muscles keep adapting. The intensity increases gradually week by week, taking you from your very first push-up to advanced bodyweight sets.

- No equipment needed — train anywhere, anytime, at home
- Bodyweight push-ups, dips and pull-up style moves for a complete chest
- Only 10 minutes a day, fully guided

Pick one of 3 workout plans and 3 difficulty levels, from beginner to advanced. Follow the daily calendar, complete each session, and watch your chest and pecs get stronger every single week. The push-up progression keeps challenging your muscles so you never hit a plateau.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
- 3 chest workout plans across 3 difficulty levels
- A new pectoral workout every day for 30 days
- Gradual intensity increase for steady muscle growth
- Your virtual coach: video exercises, animations and audio guidance for every move
- Calories burned, body stats and progress tracking to keep you motivated
- Clear video instructions for perfect push-up form
Whether you are a total beginner doing your first push-up or an experienced lifter who wants to build a powerful chest with bodyweight training, this 30 day challenge gives you a complete home workout for your pecs and upper body. No excuses, no gym membership, no equipment — everything you need fits in your pocket.
Accept the 30 day chest challenge today and start building the strong, defined chest you want — anywhere, anytime.

bluejetty:00187668:ios.summary: John Calvin’s Bible Commentary app is a must have on your gadget if you desire to study the Word of God deeper and gain different perspectives. John Calvin’s Bible Commentary app offers his commentaries and perspectives on the Word of God f
bluejetty:00187668:ios.description:
John Calvin’s Bible Commentary app is a must have on your gadget if you desire to study the Word of God deeper and gain different perspectives. John Calvin’s Bible Commentary app offers his commentaries and perspectives on the Word of God from Old Testament to the New Testament.
John Calvin Commentary offline app comes with King James Bible. This Holy Bible app comes with audio Bible and can be downloaded for offline use. You also get daily verse which motivates you. When looking for a KJV Bible you only need to change on the menu and you get access to a complete KJV Bible text for your daily study.
Everything in this app can be used offline excluding the online audio Bible which first needs to be downloaded and then can be used later. There is so much from the word of God that brings life.
John Calvin was a French theologian and pastor during the Protestant Reformation. He was one of the influential men of his days and became a principal figure of Calvinism during the development of Christian theology. He was a controversial polemic and apologetic writer and wrote commentaries on every books of the Bible.
The Word of God is an important part of our daily walk as followers of the Lord Jesus Christ. And reading it daily is for the transformation and renewal of strength of your body, soul and spirit protecting you against the works of the devil and of the flesh. The Word of God is a fountain of life, full of God’s promises to all His children. It serves as our hope, our light and our daily communication to the Father. 
And in the light of reading and studying the Word of God, there are aids to help you understand the Bible better such as Bible commentaries from other theologians. A Bible commentary is written by a commentator in a series of notes which explains the meaning of passages of Scripture and or its historical context that may reflect the beliefs and perspective of the writer.
And John Calvin was one of the commentators who studied and contributed his perspectives and insights of the Bible from Old Testament to New Testament. 
Here are some of the famous words of John Calvin:
“However many blessings we expect from God, His infinite liberality will always exceed all our wishes and our thoughts.”
“We should ask God to increase our hope when it is small, awaken it when it is dormant, confirm it when it is wavering, strengthen it when it is weak, and raise it up when it is overthrown.”
“There is not one blade of grass, there is no color in this world that is not intended to make us rejoice.”
Features of this Bible commentary called John Calvin commentary
1. Daily Bible Verses
Get daily Bible verses every day at your desired time when you change the notification time. This will ginger you up for the day.
2. Daily Bible reading
Read a chapter a day as you spend time with the Most High God. Our Father in Heaven.
Download John Calvin’s Bible Commentary app now and enjoy a deeper study, reflection, and meditation of God’s Word for a deeper communication and fellowship with Holy Spirit.

bluejetty:00119112:ios.description:
This app contains both "Old Testament" and "New Testament".
Translations of the Bible into Malayalam began from 1806, and have been to some extent influential on the development of the modern language.
The first attempt to translate bible into Malayalam was done by Kayamkulam Philipose Ramban with the support of Mor Dionatius the Great and Rev. Claudius Buchanan. Rev. Claudius Buchanan, a missionary who visited Kerala in the early 19th century, persuaded church leaders to translate the holy text into Malayalam and gave guidance to local scholars. At that time Syriac was the liturgical language of Christians in Kerala. Kayamkulam Philippose Ramban who was a Malankara Syrian Christian monk firstly translated few books of Holy Bible from Syriac to Malayalam. He was assisted by Timapah Pillay. Using the Tamil version translated by Johann Philipp Fabricius, they made a Malayalam copy. Bible Society of India (then known as an Auxiliary of the British and Foreign Bible Society) paid for 500 copies to be printed in Bombay in 1811. Timapah completed the New Testament in 1813, but this was found to include vocabulary known only to Syriac Christians and not to the general Malayalam population. Now this Bible is known as Ramban Bible.
After the Ramban Bible, it was Benjamin Bailey who continued the effort to transale the Bible to Malayalam and finally translated it enirely. His translation of the New Testament was finished and published in 1829 and the Old Testamen in 1841.
Hermann Gundert updated Bailey's version and produced the first Malayalam-English dictionary (1872). Other sources record that a Phillipose Rampan (c. 1780-1850) also translated parts of the Bible into Malayalam.
Benefits of application:
- The application works without an internet connection (offline);
- Ability to search;
- Ability to increase / decrease the font;
- Ability to create an unlimited number of tabs to a particular verse, one of the books;
- If you are interested in the allocation of poems you can copy or send a message;
- Ability to scroll through the volume buttons.
Our team is not in place, and aims to expand its functional applications.
User guide:
Each menu item is a separate book, and each separate page in one of the books is the chapter.
Place the cursor instead of the chapter number and enter the chapter number. Thus, you will not have to scroll all the chapters, selecting interesting.

apple-macos:6771283790.name: HostBook - Rental Finance
apple-macos:6771283790.description:
HostBook is the financial operating system for co-hosted short-term rentals.
Built for Airbnb, Vrbo, and Booking.com hosts who split income with co-hosts, manage multiple listings, and need complete clarity on where the money actually goes.
HostBook tracks bookings, expenses, co-host payouts, recurring rent, shared costs, multi-currency income, and portfolio profitability — all in one calm, native Apple experience.
No spreadsheets. No bloated accounting software.
— CO-HOST PAYOUTS, DONE PROPERLY —
This is where HostBook stands apart:
Percentage-based revenue splits
Fixed per-booking payouts (Pro)
Tiered rates for short vs. long stays (Pro)
Shared expense pass-through (Pro)
Effective-date rules for agreements that change over time
The Co-host Payout view shows who owes who, how the numbers were calculated, what was already paid, and what remains outstanding.
— TEAM ACCESS —
Invite co-hosts and control what each one sees and does, listing by listing.
Shared calendars, personal reports and fee shares, booking and expense requests that wait for your approval — with real-time notifications.
Available with the Team plans, which include everything in HostBook Pro and add co-host seats.
— UNDERSTAND YOUR PORTFOLIO —
Net profit dashboard with month-over-month comparisons
Waterfall reports: Gross → Expenses → Co-host → Net
Profit & loss and co-host statements
Tax-year reports from your own start date, plus last year and quarters
Occupancy, ADR, and booking performance insights
Year-over-year comparisons and channel breakdowns
— BUILT FOR REAL HOST WORKFLOWS —
Track bookings, expenses, rent, reimbursements, and platform fees
Each transaction in its own currency — now including AUD, NZD, CAD, and CHF
CSV, PDF, and HTML exports
Accountant pack: the CSV and every receipt photo in one zip
Automatic weekly backups to a folder you pick once, keeping the last 8
Listing colors and a full audit log of every change
— PRIVATE BY DESIGN —
HostBook is offline-first. Your data stays on your devices and syncs through your personal iCloud account across iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
No analytics. No tracking. We do not collect your financial data and cannot see your transactions.
Optional Team Access syncs only what you choose to share with the co-hosts you invite.
— FREE VS. HOSTBOOK PRO —
Free: 1 listing, 30 transactions in total (deleting one does not free a slot; sample data does not count), 15 guests, and 1 co-host on a percentage split.
Free for everyone: all reports, every export, the accountant pack, backups, multi-currency, and the audit log.
HostBook Pro unlocks:
Unlimited listings, transactions, and guests
More than one co-host, with fixed, tiered, and pass-through fee rules
Receipt photos — expense receipts are read on your device to suggest the amount and date
Recurring charges (rent, utilities, salaries) that post themselves
Calendar sync with Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, and other iCal links
Connected listings: a block on one blocks its linked listings
Channel earnings CSV import
The sample portfolio lets you try Pro on its sample listings only.
One Pro subscription covers iPhone, iPad, and Mac, monthly or annually. Team plans add co-host seats. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://hostbook.uk/privacy-policy.php
Terms of Use: https://hostbook.uk/terms-of-service.php

Can you rebuild these maps from the past and present? Like a jigsaw puzzle but each piece is a cut-out section of the map which needs to be put back into the right place. Now with 126 available map puzzles ready to play immediately!
EASY TO LEARN
Simple drag and drop interface that works for adults and children. A simple tutorial on "How To Play" is included. Puzzles in each pack start easy and get harder the more you do.

FAMILY FRIENDLY
All puzzles are family friendly with the easier puzzles well suited to your younger puzzlers.
PEACEFUL
An uncluttered puzzle solving space lets you be in the moment as you work your way through the puzzle at your own pace.
HELPFUL
Some of the puzzles are hard. If you get stuck, use the Shuffle button to get new pieces, the Auto Fill feature to put those difficult pieces into their correct places or a Ghost image to help you find the right place.
CONNECTED
Works on your iPads and Macs. In-App purchases of puzzle packs are shared between your devices and you can easily enable synching of Puzzle completion progress between them. Start a puzzle on one device and finish it on another.

firefox-addons:3132326.name: Tessellware Accessibility Checker
firefox-addons:3132326.summary: Free accessibility checker using WCAG 2.2 A/AA rules, a manual-check list and client-ready reports. Sends nothing.
firefox-addons:3132326.description:
Check the page you're on for accessibility issues in one click, then go further than an automated scan.
 Scan this page 
- Runs the open-source axe-core engine (rules for WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2, levels A and AA) right inside the page you are viewing. Content inside frames (iframes) is not checked.
- Results are grouped by impact: critical, serious, moderate and minor.
- Every issue shows the number of elements, each element's selector and a short HTML snippet.
- Plain-English explanations and copy-ready fix snippets cover 25 of the most common issues (missing alt text, unlabeled form fields, empty buttons and links, low colour contrast, page language and title, ARIA mistakes, small targets and more). Other issues show the engine's own help text.
- A Highlight button scrolls to the element and outlines it on the page.
- Items the engine cannot decide are listed separately as "Needs review".
 Manual checks 
Automated tools find only part of the accessibility issues on a page. The extension includes a checklist of key WCAG 2.2 A/AA checks that need a person: keyboard-only use, visible focus, focus order, 200% zoom and 400% reflow, meaningful alt text, captions, error messages, moving content, accessible sign-in, consistent help, status messages, drag alternatives and more. Each item has a one-line how-to. Mark it pass, fail or not applicable and add a note. Your answers are saved for that page in your browser only.
 Client-ready report 
Download a standalone HTML file (or Markdown) with the page address, date, axe-core version, automated results, your manual-check results, fix suggestions and your notes. Add your own name as the preparer. Good for freelancers and agencies who send findings to clients.
 Private by design 
- No account, no tracking, no analytics, no network requests.
- Your scans and notes never leave your browser. The latest 50 scans are kept locally; "Clear saved data" deletes them.

Folbrio is a PDF editor and document scanner for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Edit the text of a PDF right on the page, scan paper documents with the camera, turn photos into a PDF, recognize scanned text with on-device OCR, then sign, highlight and organize the pages. EDIT PDF TEXT ON THE PAGE

SCAN TO PDF, PHOTO TO PDF

OCR: TURN SCANS INTO EDITABLE TEXT

SIGN AND MARK UP

• Read mode for viewing without accidental edits
ORGANIZE PAGES AND COMBINE PDFS
• Reorder, rotate, duplicate or remove pages
• Add pages from another PDF to combine documents
• Search your library, mark favorites, keep deleted documents in Trash
KEEP CONTROL OF YOUR FILES
• Folbrio edits a copy of the imported document; the original stays untouched
• Export the result to any location you choose and share it from there
• Each device has its own library; PDF processing and text recognition run on your device
